taṅkaḷ kaṭcikku cātakamāka vācitta viyācaṅkaḷum – viyākki yāṉaṅkaḷum - kaṇakkukaḷum taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil aṭaṅkiyiruk kiṉṟaṉa. tāṅkaḷ mūṉṟu nāḷ paṭṭa pirayāci yāvum iraṇṭu maṇi nērap pariṭcikku niṟkāmal taḷḷappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu kirāṇikkiḷ pēppar collukiṟatu. “After about two hours trial and discussion the conference came to the conclusion that the scales lid down on the above mentioned Ragas by Mr.Clements did not tally with those of practical artistes” eṉṟu pampāy kirāṇikkiḷ mārccu mātam 23ām tēti pēpparil 5-āvatu pakkattil collukiṟatu. taṅkaḷuṭiya neṭunāḷ pirayāca mum oruṅkē aḻintu viṭṭateṉṟu terikiṟatē. taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil taṅkaḷ kaṇakkiṉpaṭi curaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa. appaṭic ceyyappaṭṭa oṉṟu capiyārāl taḷḷap paṭṭatu. atiyē pēpparil eḻutiyiruntārkaḷ. uḷḷapaṭi itu uṅkaḷ kaṭcikku cātakak kuṟivutāṉ. kirāṇikkiḷ pēpparil eṉṉippaṟṟiyum cila kuṟippukaḷ eḻutiyiruntārkaḷ. atip pārkkiyil kāṉpareṉcil naṭantavikaḷil uṇmiyum cāramumāṉavikaḷiyē colliyiruntārkaḷ.
The Bombay Chronicle, March, 24th 1916.
“The All-India Music Conference met agin this morning. Thakur Nawab Ali Khan of Akbarpur presiding. The work of the day commenced with the reading of the paper entitled “An article on Shrutis” by Rao Sahib M. Abraham Pandither. It was a learned disquisition on the much disputed question of the Shrutis or quarter-tones, which are used in the singing of Indian Ragas, embodying the resuslts of researches that the octave should be divided into twenty-four sub-divisions instead of twenty-two as prescribed by the ancient Sanskrit texts. The lecture was highly technical in character, and full of mathematical calculations and logarithms, but they were enlivened by the excellent discourisve style in which the lecture was delivered and by the interludes of songs of prayer sung in the very finely cultivated and musical voices of the two dughters of Mr. Pandither, who it is understood, are proficient in Indian as well as European music. The most interesting portion of the lecture was the demonstration given by the dughters of Mr. Pandither of the micro-tones used in certin of the South Indian Ragas, by sining to the accompaniment of the Veena. The ordinary frets of the Veena were supplemented by movable ivory frets placed on the board of the Veena at different places in order to produce the micro-tones exhibited, and in this way Mr.Pandither explined what notes were now in use in some of the Southern Ragas. The correctness of the notes sung with those produced on the instrument was vouched for by so distinguished a musician as Mr.Zakr-ud-Din of Udeypore. The paper of Mr. Pandither was the only item arranged for the morning.
pampāy kirāṇikkiḷ : 24, mārccu 1916.
intiyā muḻuvatilum iruntu vantu kūṭiya kāṉpareṉs iṉṟu kāli maṟupaṭiyum kūṭiṉatu. Thakur Nawab Ali Khan avarkaḷ akkirācaṉam vakittārkaḷ. iṉṟu kāli mutal mutal curutikaḷiṉpēril rāvcāyap              M. āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷ oru upanniyācam vācittārkaḷ. intiya rākaṅkaḷil varum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ allatu kāl curaṅkaḷip paṟṟit taṉ caṅkītak kalvit tiṟamiyik kāṭṭumpaṭiyāṉa vitamāy paṇṭitaravar kaḷ coṉṉārkaḷ. curutikaḷ pala apippirāyam ēṟkakkūṭiyaviyeṉpatu yāvarumaṟinta viṣayamē. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ anēka varuṣaṅkaḷāy itu viṣayattil pala ārāyccikaḷ ceytatiṉ palaṉāy oru stāyiyāṉatu camaskiruta nūlkaḷil collappaṭṭa pirakāram 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟirāmal 24 cama curutikaḷākap pirikkappaṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṇpittārkaḷ. inta viyācamāṉatu caṅkīta cāstira viṣayamāṉa ati nuṭpamāṉa viṣayaṅ kaḷiyum, kaṇakkukaḷiyum, turuva eṇkaḷiyum paṟṟic coṉṉatiṉāl karukalāyiruntapōtilum atu collappaṭṭa pōṅkāṉatu oruvariṭam pēcuvatu pōlat teḷivuḷḷatāyiruntatiṉālum, airōppiya caṅkītattilum, intiya caṅkītattilum mikat tērccipeṟṟa avarkaḷuṭiya iraṇṭu kumārattikaḷum taṅkaḷuṭiya mika iṉimiyāṉa cārīrattōṭu iṭik kiṭiyē paktirasamāṉa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷip pāṭiyatālum nēram pōṉatu oruvarukkum teriyavilli. inta viyācattil veku mukkiyamāk kavaṉikkappaṭattakka viṣayam yāteṉṟāl, teṉṉintiya irākaṅkaḷil cilavaṟṟil vaḻaṅkum ati nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷi paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ yāvarukkum viḷaṅkumpaṭiyāy vīṇiyuṭaṉ pāṭik kāṭṭiyatutāṉ. vīṇiyil cātāraṇamāyuḷḷa meṭṭukaḷi yallāmal aṅkumiṅkum camayattiṟkēṟṟa vitamāyt taḷḷi vikkakkūṭiya tanta meṭṭukaḷi vittu ati nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷip pāṭikkāṭṭi ivvita māyt teṉṉintiyā irākaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅkum curaṅkaḷi paṇṭitaravarkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. pāṭiya curaṅkaḷum vīṇiyil vācitta curaṅkaḷum oṟṟumiyuḷḷavitāṉ eṉṟu mikap pirapala vittuvāṉākiya utiyappūr cākruṭīṉ cāyap avarkaḷāl naṟcāṭci peṟṟārkaḷ. kāliyil vācikkappaṭumpaṭi kuṟikkappaṭṭatu inta orē viṣayamāy iruntatu.
mēṟkaṇṭa cila varikaḷi nām pārkkiyil uṇmiyuḷḷa oruvarukku eṉṉa apippirāyam uṇṭākumeṉṟu nāṉ collat tēvi yilli. itu eṉ kaṭcikku cātakak kuṟiveṉṟu taṅkaḷit tavira maṟṟa evarum eṇṇamāṭṭārkaḷ. kiruṣṇa paramātmā turiyōtaṉaṉiyum tarumariyum kūppiṭṭu, ‘ulakattil nallavarkaḷ yār keṭṭavarkaḷ yār pārttu vāruṅkaḷ’ eṉṟu coṉṉār. appōtu tīmiyē uruvāka avataritta turiyōtaṉaṉ ‘cuvāmi! taṅkaḷ coṟpaṭit tēṭi vantēṉ. eṉṉit tavira nallavar vēṟu oruvarum illi. maṟṟavarkaḷ yāvarum pollātavarkaḷāyirukkiṟārkaḷ’ eṉṟu coṉṉāṉ. tarumar vantu ‘cuvāmi! ulakattiluḷḷa yāvarum nallavarkaḷā yirukkiṟārkaḷ. nāṉ oruvaṉ tāṉ mikap pāviyāyirukkiṟēṉ’ eṉṟu vaṇaṅkiṉār. itupōlavē tāṅkaḷ collukiṟatum irukkiṟatu. uṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyam ottuvaravilli eṉṟu coṉṉatupōla eṉ kaṇakkāvatu - vīṇiyiṉ curaṅkaḷāvatu – vāyp pāṭṭāvatu ottuvaravilli eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷā? taṅkaḷ kaṭcikku virōtamāṉa apippirāyam capiyār coṉṉatiyē avarkaḷ kirāṇikkiḷ pēpparil eḻutiyiruntārkaḷ. āṉāl capiyār eṉ viṣayattil enta nalla apippirāyappaṭṭārkaḷō atiyē kirāṇikkiḷ pēpparil eḻuti yiruntārkaḷ. eṉ kaṭcikku cātakak kuṟivāṉa oru vārttiyum avarkaḷ collavilliyē. piṉ ēṉ tāṅkaḷ ippaṭic colla vēṇṭum? itip pārkkum maṟṟavar taṅkaḷi uṇmiyuḷḷavarkaḷeṉṟu niṉippārkaḷā?
ellārum atikamākap piriyappaṭuvatāṉa kāpi taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyat til kuṟintataṉāl ellōrukkum talivali yuṇṭāyiṟṟu. avi cariyāṉa curaṅkaḷāyirukkumāṉāl accuraṅkaḷik kiraka māṟṟum poḻutu karakarappiriyā, aṉumattōṭi (piravi), mēcakalyāṇi (yamaṉ kalyāṇi), arikāmpōti (kāmpōti), naṭapiravi (tōṭi), cutta tōṭi (cutta piravi), caṅkarāparaṇam (pelavāl) mutaliya tāy irākaṅkaḷ āṟum uṇṭāka vēṇṭum. itic caṅkīta aṉupōkamuḷḷa yāvarum aṟivārkaḷ. ic curaṅkaḷukkup piṉṉa eṇkaḷip pōṭṭup piṉṉap paṭuttuvatu paritāpamā yirukkiṟatu. ip paritāpattiṟku iṉṉiṉṉa iṭiveḷikaḷ varavēṇṭu meṉṟu eṉ apippirāyatti iraṇṭāvatu variyil eḻutukiṟīrkaḷ. atu appaṭiyalla. āṉāl avikaḷ nāṉ parōṭā kāṉpareṉsil vācitta iraṇṭāvatu viyācattil āyappāli aṭṭavaṇiyil kāṭṭiyapaṭi irukka vēṇṭum. nīṅkaḷ camīpattil illiyē eṉṟu mikavum varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ. ippaṭippaṭṭa kaṇakkukaḷukkup patil eḻutuvatu yāṉi kaṇṭa kuruṭar pēcik koḷvatu pōlirukkum. oruvaṉ yāṉi ulakkipōlirukkiṟa teṉṟum, maṟṟoruvaṉ ural pōl irukkiṟateṉṟum, vēṟoruvaṉ viḷakkumāṟu pōl irukkiṟateṉṟum colluvāṉ. yāṉiyik kaṇṭavaṉ atik kēṭṭu nakittāl “nāṉ eṉ kiyiṉāl taṭavip pārttēṉ. uṉakkuk kaṇṇiruntum karuttu illāmaṟ pōy viṭṭatē” eṉṟu parikācam ceyvāṉ. ivvāṟē uḷḷati illātatākavum illātati uḷḷa tākavum cātippatu ulaka vaḻakkam.
6. “vantirunta ‘vitvāṉkaḷil’ ettaṉipēr curaṅkaḷip pakuttaṟiyum viṣayattil vāttiyaṅkaḷiṉ utaviyiṉāl paḻakiyiruntavarkaḷ? avarkaḷil ettaṉi pērukku Tempered tone, Major Tone, Minor tone, cātāraṇa ārmāṉik iṭiveḷikaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ nuṭpa vittiyācam teriyum? anēka memparkaḷ taṅkaḷ viyācaṅkaḷil 9/8, 10/9, 5/4, 6/5 eṉṟa iṭiveḷikaḷip paṟṟit taṇṇīrpaṭṭa pāṭamāyp pēciṉārkaḷē, avarkaḷil ettaṉi pērukku inta nuṭpa veḷikaḷiṉ vittiyācaṅkaḷ terintirukkum?”
vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷiṉ vitvattiṟamiyip paṟṟit tāṅkaḷ cila vārttikaḷ colvati muṟṟilum āṣēpikkiṟēṉ. toṭṭaviṭa mellām uṅkaḷik kuṟicolvatu eṉ maṉatiṟkut tiruptiyāyilli. tāṅkaḷ kaṭitam eḻutāmaliruntāl taṅkaḷ nērmikkākap pukaḻntu koṇṭēyiruppēṉ. curañāṉam mika arumiyāṉatutāṉ. Major tone, Minor tone, iṉṉateṉṟu teriyātirukkalām. āṉāl avarkaḷ aṉupōkattil ennēramum avikaḷiyē pāṭikkoṇṭirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟu taṅkaḷukkut teriyavilli.
caṅkītattiṟkuriya nuṭpa vitikaḷiyum peyarkaḷiyum caṅkītam kaṟṟuk koḷḷukiṟavarkaḷukku mēl nāṭṭil colli vippatupōl intiyāvil ceyyāmal mikac ciṟu pirāyattilēyē aṉupōkat tiṟku varumpaṭi pāṭam ceytu vikkappaṭukiṟatu. pala varuṭaṅkaḷ maṉappāṭam paṇṇiṉapiṉ vicārikkum vivēkikaḷukkup pala irakaciyaṅkaḷ veḷiyākum. maṟṟavarkaḷ, kēṭṭatiyē collum kiḷippiḷḷipōlat tāṅkaḷ paṭittavikaḷi māttiram collik koṇṭu niṟpārkaḷ. ippaṭippaṭṭa kiḷippiḷḷikaḷ intiyāvil ērāḷam. Diatonic Scale, Tempered Scale eṉṟāl teriyātu. āṉāl pūrvamāy ulaka carittiram uṇṭāvataṟku muṉṉālēyē atāvatu Haeckele eṉṉum tattuvacāstiri ‘cumār 20,000 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉālēyē lemūriyā nāṭṭiluḷḷōr cakala kalikaḷilum tērntiruntārkaḷ’ eṉpataṟ kiṇaṅka tamiḻmakkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta curamum curutiyum cama iṭiveḷi kaḷuṭiyavikaḷāyirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum cama iṭiveḷikaḷuṭiya muṟippaṭiyē nāḷatu variyum karnāṭaka caṅkītam pāṭappaṭṭu varukiṟa teṉṟum ataṉ citivāka maṟṟum pala tēcattil ac curaṅkaḷiyē pāṭik koṇṭirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟum nāṉ aṟikiṟēṉ.
intiyāviluḷḷa caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ paḷḷikkūṭattilallāmal parampariyāyk kēṭṭup paṭippatē vaḻakkamāyiruppatiṉāl taṅkaḷip pōṉṟavarkaḷ nūlaṟivik kēṭkumpoḻutu patil collat teriyātavar kaḷāyiruntālum tāṅkaḷ kēṭkum ivvaṟpa kēḷvikku mēṟpaṭṭa aṉupōka muṭiyavarkaḷā yirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu nāṉ tuṇintu colvēṉ. carkkari, carkkari eṉṟu ōyāmal collik koṇṭiruppatāl nāvu tittikkumā? oruvaṉ nūl aṟivu peritu eṉpāṉ. maṟṟoruvaṉ aṉupōkam peritu eṉpāṉ. ivviraṇṭu muṭimiyē ciṟantatu.
aṉupōkattil tērntavarkaḷākiya pala kavāykaḷum, karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷum vantiruntārkaḷ. taṅkaḷippōl Major tone, Minor tone, Tempered Scale, Diatonic scale eṉṟu collat terintavarkaḷum palar vantiruntārkaḷ. taṅkaḷippōl 2/3, 3/4 aip perukki ataṉ mūlamāyk kiṭikkum piṉṉa eṇkaḷi ‘ippaṭittāṉ varavēṇṭu’ meṉṟu collum kaṇitavallōrum vantiruntārkaḷ. appaṭik kūṭiyirukkum camayattil ‘uṅkaḷil ettaṉi peyarukkuc curaṅkaḷip pakuttaṟiyum cakti uṇL. uṅkaḷil yār yārukku Major tone, Minor tone teriyum. terintavarkaḷ irukkalām maṟṟavarkaḷ pōyviṭalām’ eṉṟu colliyiruppīrkaḷāṉāl 8/9, 9/10, 4/5, 5/6 pōṉṟa nuṭpa iṭiveḷikaḷi aṟintavarkaḷ iṉṉāreṉṟu teḷivākat terintu koḷḷalāmē.
capiyil vantirunta aṟivāḷikaḷip pārttu ippaṭic colvati nāṉ mikavum aṉpōṭu āṣēpikkiṟēṉ. maṟṟavarkaḷi aṟpamāy eṇṇum inta vārttikaḷ taṅkaḷukkē tirumpa varumē eṉṟu mikavum vicaṉappaṭukiṟēṉ. aṅku vantirunta capiyil nāṉ oruvaṉāka eṇṇap paṭuvataṟkut takutiyuḷḷavaṉō eṉṟu kavalippaṭukiṟēṉ. takutiyuḷḷavaṉāka tāṅkaḷ niṉippīrkaḷāṉāl nāṉ eḻuti vanta mūṉṟu viyācaṅkaḷil tavaṟutal eṭuttukkāṭṭa vēṇṭum. illiyāṉāl tāṅkaḷ coṉṉa vārttikku nāṉ cammatikkavilli. ippaṭiyē vantirunta palar mikunta curañāṉamum aṉupōkamum uṭiyavarkaḷ. eṉṉi eppaṭic coṉṉālum paravāyilli. maṟṟavarkaḷippaṟṟi nīṅkaḷ colluvati nāṉ virumpa villi. ippaṭit teriyātavarkaḷ muṉ taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyatti araṅ kēṟṟa eppaṭit tuṇintīrkaḷ? taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyam kuṟikiṟateṉṟu tāṅkaḷē oppuk koḷumpaṭic ceytavarkaḷ curañāṉamuḷḷavarkaḷ allavō? ivviṣayattil nāṉ atikam colla virumpavilli. ippaṭic capiyiluḷḷa yāvarum kūṭit taḷḷumpaṭiyāṉa apippihyattik koṇṭu vanta tāṅkaḷ ataṟku nēr virōtamāyc collukiṟatu ‘tirāṭcap paḻam puḷikkum’ eṉṟa nariyiṉ katipōlirukkiṟatu. tāṅkaḷum ammuṟi pōl naṭantu koṇṭīrkaḷēyoḻiya vēṟilli.
7. “taṅkaḷuṭiya kuḻantikaḷiṉ kāṉattippaṟṟi iraṇṭoru vārttikaḷ. avarkaḷ pāṭiyatu uṅkaḷuṭiya apippirāyatti nili niṟuttiṉatāka niṉikkiṟīrkaḷ.”
‘taṅkaḷ kuḻantikaḷ pāṭiyatu taṅkaḷ apippirāyatti nili niṟuttiṉatāka niṉikkiṟīrkaḷ’ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ eḻutukiṟīrkaḷ. ‘nīṅkaḷ niṉikkiṟīrkaḷ’ eṉpati nāṉ pārkkumpoḻutu maṉitarkaḷuṭiya uḷḷaṅkaḷiṟ pukuntu avarkaḷ apippirāyattik kaṇṭukoḷḷat tiṟami yuṭiyavarkaḷākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. ippaṭippaṭṭa taṅkaḷukku parōṭāvil vācitta iraṇṭāvatu viyācattil pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ pāṭi vanta muṟip paṭiyē taṟkālamum pāṭi varum karnāṭaka caṅkītam irukkiṟateṉṟum atil 7, 12, 24, 48, 96 pōṉṟa curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum colli utāraṇamāka 67 irākaṅkaḷ kuṟittuk koṭuttiruntēṉ. avikaḷil capiyār virumpiyavaṟṟip pāṭiyum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. avikaḷukku ēṟpaṭṭa kaṇakkiṉpaṭi vīṇit tantiyiṉ cariyāṉa aḷavil varum curaṅkaḷ iṉṉavi yeṉṟum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. karnāṭaka caṅkītam terinta yāvarum mikap piriyamāyk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. kaṇakkiṟkaṇṭa aḷaviṉpaṭiyē vīṇiyiṉ cura stāṉaṅkaḷ amikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. taṟ kālattiṟ pāṭappaṭṭu varum muṟippaṭiyē yāvarukkum paḻakkamāṉa kīrttaṉikaḷi atil vācittu vāyiṉālpāṭi nuṭpa curaṅkaḷik kuṟippiṭṭuk kāṭṭi eṉ apippirāyattiyē pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu coṉṉēṉ. itiyē pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu pala ātāramum eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉēṉ. eṉ vākku oṉṟāyum maṉatu vēṟākavumirukkavilli eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ ēṉ kavaṉittup pārkkāmal pōṉīrkaḷ. eṉ maṉa viruppattiṉpaṭi karnāṭaka caṅkītattil etu uṇmiyāyirukkiṟatō atiyē capiyār muṉ vīṇiyil kāṭṭiṉēṉ. karnāṭaka caṅkītam oṉṟākavum vīṇi vēṟākavumirukkavilli. vīṇi oṉṟākavum kuḻantikaḷ pāṭiṉa kītam maṟṟoṉṟākavum iruntatilli. nāṅkaḷ pāṭiṉa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷi aṅku vantirunta karnāṭaka vitvacirō maṇikaḷ aṟivārkaḷ. aṇuppicakumāṉāl ati oppukkoḷḷukiṟataṟku avarkaḷ tayārāyiruntatilli. tavaṟiṉāl cummā viṭṭirukkavu māṭṭārkaḷ. cāvēri irākattil varum riṣapattiṉ mutal curuti iṉṉum kuṟintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu cariyāyirunta oṉṟi Mr.arināka pūṣaṇamiyar B.A.,B.L., āṣēpaṉi ceytatiyum ati oppuk koḷḷāmal Mr.ciṭṭi pāppu nāyuṭu avarkaḷum, Mr.cīṉivāca aiyaṅkār B.A.,L.T., avarkaḷum capiyiluḷḷa maṟṟum cilarum taṭuttatiyum tāṅkaḷ aṟivīrkaḷē.
tuvāvimcati curuti yeṉṟē cātikkavēṇṭumeṉṟu kaṅkaṇaṅkaṭṭik koṇṭu eṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷukku nēr etirttu niṉṟa (eṉ piḷḷikaḷiṉ upāttiyāyarāṉa) makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ nāṉ capi muṉ vāy tiṟakkum variyum nāṅkaḷ ceyyappōkiṟatu iṉṉa teṉṟu aṟiyātiruntārkaḷ. avar ōyāmaṟ kutarkkam ceyvati aṟinta cilar parōṭāvukku avarik kūṭṭik koṇṭu pōkavēṇṭāmeṉṟu eṉṉit taṭuttārkaḷ. āṉāl nāṉum piḷḷikaḷum ceytu kāṭṭukiṟa curuti muṟiyi avar kēṭṭuc cariyeṉṟu colvati nāṉ peritāka niṉittēṉ. ēṉeṉṟāl ‘parōṭāvil kāṉpareṉs naṭakkiṟatu. tivāṉ cākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavāv avarkaḷ varumpaṭi eḻuti yirukkiṟārkaḷ. kaṭṭāyam nām pōkavēṇṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu nāṉ collumpoḻutu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ ‘ām, ām, karnāṭaka caṅkītam teriyāta vaṭanāṭṭil rāja capiyil taṅkaḷ apip pirāyatti araṅkēṟṟiviṭṭāl atikkoṇṭu ivviṭattuk kāṉpa reṉsilum cātittu viṭalām’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. nāṉ ceyyappōkiṟatu iṉṉateṉṟu aṟiyātataṉāl ippaṭic coṉṉārkaḷ. eppaṭiyiruntālum avarkaḷiyē cāṭciyāka vittuk koṇṭu eṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷi capi muṉ terivikkat tīrmāṉittēṉ.
avarkaḷ eṉ piḷḷikaḷ paṭippatiyum - eṉ apippirāyattiyum mikak kavaṉamāyk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. kūṭṭam muṭintavuṭaṉ taṅkaḷ apippirāyam eppaṭi? uṅkaḷ maṉattiṟku tiruptiyāyiruntatā? eṉṟu nāṉ kēṭṭapoḻutu ‘nāṉ aḻutukoṇṭu irukka vēṇṭiyavaṉ, capi muṉ eṉṉit tiriyap paṭuttik koṇṭiruntēṉ. eṉakku vēṟoṉṟum tōṉṟavilli. eḻuntiruntu kuḻantikaḷi namaskāram ceyyavēṇṭu meṉṟu eṉakkut tōṉṟiṟṟu’ eṉṟu uḷḷam niṟinta aṉpuṭaṉ collip piḷḷikaḷi ācīrvatittārkaḷ. appōtu “ellām taṅkaḷuṭiya kirupitāṉ ellām tāṅkaḷ collikkoṭutta kīrttaṉaṅkaḷiliruntē pāṭikkāṭṭiṉōm” eṉṟu colli cantōṣamaṭintōm.
iṉṉiciyik kēṭṭirunta kallum kariyumē? taṅkaḷ maṉatiṟku māttiram vittiyācamāṉa apippirāyam tōṉṟuvati niṉikka niṉikka nāṉ mikavum āccariyappaṭukiṟēṉ. vīṇiyiṉ iṉiya ōciyik kēṭṭuk kēṭṭu maṉatum iḷaki allatu kāruṇyamuṭiyatāki vīṇi vācippōr vāyc collum mika mirutuvāki viṭukiṟateṉṟu pūrvama tamiḻmakkaḷ colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. ati,
		“cevinērpu vitta ceyvuṟu tivaviṉ
		nalliyāḻ naviṉṟa nayaṉuṭiya neñciṉ
		meṉmoḻi mēvalar iṉṉaram puḷara.”
eṉṉum aṭikaḷāl aṟiyalām.
caṅkītattiṉ curuti viṣayamāka ārāycci ceytu varum tāṅkaḷ ippaṭi māṟutalāṉa apippirāyap paṭuvāṉēṉ. eṉ apippirāyam vēṟu kuḻantikaḷiṉ vāyppāṭṭu vēṟā yirukkiṟateṉṟu nāṉ aṟintēṉāṉāl capimuṉ vantirukkamāṭṭēṉ. vīṇiyiṉ nātam vēṟu taṟkāla aṉupōkam vēṟāyirukkiṟateṉṟu nāṉ aṟivēṉāṉāl taṅkaḷip pōl tuṇikaramāy capimuṉ vantirukka māṭṭēṉ. ārmōṉiyam kuṟikiṟa teṉṟu tōlviyuṭaṉ pōyirukkavu māṭṭēṉ. apippirāyam vēṟu, ārmōṉiyattiṉ curaṅkaḷ vēṟu, taṟkāla aṉupōkam vēṟāyirunta taṅkaḷ aṉu pōkattiṉpaṭiyē eṉṉiyum niṉittu viṭṭīrkaḷ. aṉupōkam vēṟu eṇṇam vēṟāyirukkum enta muṟiyum ulakattil muṉṉukku varamāṭṭā teṉṟu nāṉ aṟivēṉ.
karnāṭaka caṅkītattil etu aṉupōkattilirukkiṟatō, atiyē vīṇiyil aḷantu kāṭṭiṉēṉ. vīṇiyiṟ kaṇṭa ōciyiṉpaṭiyē piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷ. eṉ karuttu iṉṉateṉṟu eṉ piḷḷikaḷ aṟivārkaḷ. nāṉ koṇṭu vantirunta vīṇiyum aṟiyum. appōtu kūṭa irunta kuḻantikaḷiṉ upāttiyāyarāṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷum cila karnāṭaka vitvacirōmaṇikaḷum, Mrs. Atya Begum Fyzee Rahiminavarkaḷum, cākruṭīṉ cāyapum maṟṟum aṅku vantirunta vaṭatēcattuk kaṉavāṉkaḷil mikutiyāṉavarkaḷum aṟivārkaḷ. taṅkaḷukkut teriyāmal pōṉatippaṟṟi nāṉ āccariyappaṭavilli. ēṉeṉṟāl intustāṉ irākaṅkaḷit tavira karnāṭaka caṅkītattik kaṉavilum tāṅkaḷ kēṭṭirukka māṭṭīrkaḷ. āṉāl intustāṉ caṅkītatti eṭuttu niṟutta nīṅkaḷ ceytu koṇṭu vanta ārmōṉiyattiṉ curaṅkaḷ taṟkālam aṉu pōkattilirukkum intustāṉ irākaṅkaḷiṉ curaṅkaḷukku ottirukka villi eṉṟu capiyōrāl tīrmāṉikkappaṭṭatu.
āṉāl ākasṭumātam 19m tēti naṭanta tañci caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattil karnāṭaka vitva cirōmaṇikaḷ muṉṉiliyilum kaṇitam tērnta Professor kaḷ muṉṉiliyilum tamiḻmoḻi valla pulavarkaḷ muṉṉiliyilum piraciṭeṉṭ V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ muṉṉi liyilum colli pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷiṉ ātāramum kāṭṭik kaṇakkiṉ paṭiyē vīṇiyiṉ aḷavum kāṭṭi vīṇiyil varum nātattiṉpaṭiyē pāṭiyum kāṭṭiya eṉ apippirāyam palarālum oppukkoḷḷappaṭṭirukkiṟatu. oru stāyiyil 2/3, 2/3 ākavum, 3/4, 3/4 ākavum pōvatil kiṭikkum curaṅkaḷ cariyāṉavikaḷ alla eṉṟum oru stāyiyil 22 alla irupattu nāṉkākavē varavēṇṭumeṉṟum eṉ apippirāyattic cātittuk kāṭṭiṉēṉ. piḷḷikaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭiyatum eṉ apippirāyamum oṉṟē yoḻiya vēṟilli. pūraṇa curañāṉamuḷḷa vitvacirōmaṇikaḷē iti aṟivārkaḷ. maṟṟavar aṟiyamāṭṭār.
8. “intiya caṅkītam eppōtum oru curattiyum ataṉ pañcamattiyum captittukkoṇṭu (tampurāvi mīṭṭuvatupōl) pāṭukiṟa vaḻakkamāyiṟṟē. uṅkaḷ kuḻantikaḷ appaṭiyēṉ collavilli. avarkaḷ eppōtum iraṇṭu tampurākkaḷi mīṭṭikkoṇṭē pāṭaṭṭum. appaṭip pāṭuvār kaḷāṉāl kētāra kuḷam caṅkarāparaṇam mutaliya irākaṅkaḷil uṅkaḷuṭiya kāntāratti yalla caṭjattukku 11/4 āy irukkappaṭṭa kāntārattip pāṭuvārkaḷ. aṉumattōṭiyil caṭjamattukku 13/5 āy uḷḷa tivatattiyum naṭapiraviyil caṭjamattukku 11/5 āy uḷḷa kāntārattiyum paṭippārkaḷ. tokiyāyc colla vēṇṭumāṉāl appōtutāṉ cariyāṉa caṅkītam paṭippārkaḷ.”
intiya caṅkītattil tampurāvi vittup pāṭukiṟatu pōl uṅkaḷ kuḻantikaḷ pāṭavilli eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. atāvatu taṅkaḷ carīrattiṟ kēṟṟa vitamāy caṭcamamum ataṉ piṉ ataṟkup pañcamamum mēl caṭcamamum cērttukkoṇṭu ataṟkēṟṟa vitamāy ēṉ pāṭavilli eṉṟu kēṭkiṟīrkaḷ. appōtutāṉ cariyāṉa caṅkītam paṭippārkaḷ eṉṟum collukiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ niṉikkiṟapaṭiyē nāṅkaḷ paḻakiyirukkiṟōm. ammuṟippaṭitāṉē capi muṉpāṭik kāṭṭiṉōm. ati aṟintu koḷḷa muṭiyāmal pāṭiyatu vēṟu eṉṟu kuṟṟam collukiṟīrkaḷ.  vīṇiyiṉ nālu tantikaḷilum ca-pa muṟiyāy curaṅkaḷ niṟkavilliyā? vīṇiyiṉ pakkattil curutikkāka irukkum mūṉṟu tantikaḷil ca-pa-ca vāka curuti cērkkappaṭukiṟatē. pāṭum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷukkēṟṟa tāḷaṅkaḷil ca-pa-ca eṉṟu pakkattu tantikaḷ mīṭṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉavē. vīṇiyiṉ pakkattut tantikaḷ curuti mīṭṭum tampurāvākavum tāḷam mīṭṭum tantikaḷākavum amikkap peṟṟirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟiyāmal pōṉīrkaḷē! pāṭukiṟa oruvaṉ tāṉ pāṭum poḻutum vīṇiyiṉ curastāṉaṅkaḷ pēcum poḻutum apacuramuṇṭākāmal tiruttik koḷvataṟku avi utaviyā yirukkiṉṟaṉavē. immuṟiyiyē piḷḷikaḷ curutiyōṭu pāṭiṉārkaḷ. itip pakkattiliruntu kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntum aṟiyāmal eṅkēyō veku tūram kāṭṭil alintu inta yuktiyip piṭittuk koṇṭuvantu viṭṭīrkaḷ. ivvaḷavu yukti collum taṅkaḷukku nāṉ eṉṉa colliyum pirayōcaṉappaṭumō eṉṟu cantēkappaṭukiṟēṉ. nāṅkaḷ paṭittatu cariyāṉa caṅkītamtāṉ. tāṅkaḷ ēṟpaṭuttik koṇṭu vanta intiya ārmōṉiyattiṉ paṭi apacuraṅkaḷil pāṭappaṭumāṉāl atu inta caṅkītattik keṭukkavanta oru kōṭari eṉṟu niccayamākac colluvēṉ. appaṭiyē āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉs capiyārum aruvaruttup payantu taḷḷiṉārkaḷ. atippārttirunta nāṉum tirumpac colla vēṇṭiyatilli eṉṟu niṉikkiṟēṉ.
9. “nāmāyk kūṭak kuṟiya vittuk koḷḷum curaṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu.”
nāmāyk kūṭak kuṟittu vittukkoḷḷum curaṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ eḻutukiṟīrkaḷ. uḷḷapaṭiyē atu aruvaruppilum makā aruvaruppāṉatu eṉṟu nāṉum oppukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. tāṅkaḷ tāṉē appaṭic ceykiṟīrkaḷ. 20, 22, 27, 63, 71, 84, 90, 92 ceṉṭskaḷ iṭiveḷiyākac curaṅkaḷ varavēṇṭumeṉṟu taṅkaḷ kaṇakkiṉāl terikiṟatu. ivikaḷ paṭippaṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varum eṉṟu coṉṉa caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟikku ottirukkiṟatā? muṉṉōruṭiya apippirāyaṅkaḷi muṟṟilum māṟṟi ataṟku virōtamākat tāṅkaḷ kūṭṭik kuṟittu vittuk koḷḷum curaṅkaḷē aruvaruppāṉavi. tāṅkaḷ eḻutiya Introduction to the study of  Indian Music eṉṟa puttakattil Srutis of modern Hindustani Music eṉṟa talippiṉ kīḻ ēḻāvatu, eṭṭāvatu pakkaṅkaḷil curutikaḷukkuc colliya viparēṣaṉ kaṇakkiṉāl avikaḷ teḷivākat terikiṉṟaṉa. 320, 324, 3371/2, 3411/3, 360, 378, 384, 400, 405, 420, 4262/3 eṉṟa viparēṣaṉkaḷukku eṉṉa oṟṟumiyirukkiṟatu? caṅkīta ratṉākarar apip pirāyamā? allatu ataṟku muntiya paratariṉ apippirāyamā? caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ apippirāyatti aṟinta tāṅkaḷ ippaṭic ceytāl maṟṟavar eṉṉa ceyyamāṭṭār? caṅkīta ratṉākarar curuti cērkkum viṣayamāy taṅkaḷ pustakattil eṉṉa collukiṟīrkaḷeṉṟu aṭiyil varum cila varikaḷiṟ pārppōm.
Introduction to the study of Indian Music Page 53.
THE SANGIT RATNAKAR
(ANANDASHRAMA SERIES POONA)
SVARADHYAYA (PRAKARAN 3)
“Verses 3 to 11 are taken up with an attempt to explin the phenomena of sound.
Verse 12 : - Take two Vinas with 22 wires each and tune as follows. Let the first wire give the lowest possible note, the next a note a little higher and so on, so that between the notes given by two adjacent wires a third note is impossible.
Verses 13 to 16 :- These successive notes are the srutis. Sa will stand on the fourth wire being a svara of four srutis; Ri will be on the third wire counting from the fifth; Ga which has only two srutis, will fall on the second counting from the eighth; Ma being of four srutis, on the fourth, counting from the tenth; Pa on the fourth, counting from the fourteenth; Dha on the hird after Pa; Ni on the second after Dha; so Ni will fall on the twenty-second sruti.
caṅkīta ratṉākaram
pūṉā āṉantāsrama cīris
cuvara attiyāyam (pirakaraṉ 3)
“3 mutal 11 aṭikaḷ vari :- captam eṉpatiṉ tōṟṟattip paṟṟic colliyatu”
12-vatu aṭi : - ovvoṉṟum 22 tantikaḷuḷḷa iraṇṭu vīṇikaḷi eṭuttukkoḷ. mutal tantiyil kūṭiyavariyil ārampamāka uḷḷa svaratti vittukkoḷ. aṭutta tantiyil aṭutta svaram pēcaṭṭum. ippaṭi mēlē cel. enta iraṇṭu tantikaḷi eṭuttukkoṇṭālum avikaḷ iraṇṭiṟkum naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākātapaṭi avikaḷi amittukkoḷ.
13-16 aṭikaḷ :- ippaṭi oṉṟaṉ piṉ oṉṟāy olikkum nātaṅkaḷ tāṉ curutikaḷ. caṭjam nālu curuti koṇṭatāl nālāvatu tantiyil atu pēcum. aintāvatiliruntu kaṇakkiṭṭāl mūṉṟāvatu tantiyil riṣapam pēcum. kāntāram iraṇṭu curutiyāṉatāl eṭṭāvatiliruntu iraṇṭāvatu tantiyil atu pēcum. mattimam 4 curutiyāṉatāl pattāvatiliruntu nālāvatu tantiyil atu pēcum. appaṭiyē pañcamam patiṉālāvatiliruntu nālāvatu tantiyil pēcum. tivatam pañcamattiṟku mēl mūṉṟāvatu tantiyilum niṣātam tivatattiliruntu iraṇṭāvatu tantiyilum pēcum. appaṭiyāṉāl niṣātam 22āvatu curutiyākap pēcum.”
itaṉāl oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum avikaḷ ārampa curattiliruntu paṭippaṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal ōciyil cama aḷavāyirukka vēṇṭu meṉṟum teḷivākak kāṇkiṟōm.
Introduction to the study of Indian music Page 22.
“The ancient theorists of India had no knowledge of harmonic ratios; to them to interval termed a sruti appeared to be the smallest interval which the human voice was capable of singing; consequently, they assumed roughly that their 22 srutis divided the octave into equal parts.”
“intiyāviṉ pūrva caṅkīta nūlāciriyarkaḷukku Harmonic ratios eṉṟāl iṉṉa teṉṟē teriyātu. maṉita cārīrattāl pāṭakkūṭiya nuṭpamāṉa iṭi veḷi etuvō atiyē curuti iṭiveḷiyeṉṟu niṉittārkaḷ. āki yāl avarkaḷ oru stāyiyāṉatu ēṟakkuṟiya 22 cama pākaṅkaḷuḷḷa curuti kaḷākap pirikkappaṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟu amittuk koṇṭārkaḷ.”
itaṉāl oru stāyiyi camapākaṅkaḷuḷḷa curutikaḷāka atāvatu cama ōciyuḷḷatāka 22 curutikaḷ varavēṇṭumeṉṟu amittukkoṇṭārkaḷ eṉṟum 2/3, 3/4 āl kiṭikkum Harmonic ratios avarkaḷukkut teriyā teṉṟum veḷiyākiṟatu. atu uṇmiyē. ñalavāyapaḻcayaḷa pōṉṟavar kaḷukkup piṉṉāl ip puraḷiyuṇṭāyiṟṟu. itu cuttamāṉa caṅkītattiṟkuc caṉiyaṉāka vantirukkiṟatu. itu illāmaṟ pōṉāl uṅkaḷukkum eṉakkum ittaṉi nēramum kaṭutāciyum celavāyirukkātu.
Introduction to the study of Indian music Page 76.
“According to Sarangdev’s theory of the equality of the srutis.”
“curutikaḷ camapākaṅkaḷuḷḷaviyā yirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu collukiṟa cāraṅkatēvar muṟippaṭi”
curutikaḷ camapākaṅkaḷuḷḷaviyāyirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu tāṅkaḷum oppukkoḷḷukiṟīrkaḷeṉṟu teḷivākat terikiṟatu.
The Hindu Musical scale and the twenty two Srutis.
“Now as observed by Professor Pietro Blaserna, of the Royal university of Rome, in his valuable treatise on the “Theory of sound in its relation to Music,” by a musical scale is meant “the collection of all the notes comprised between the fundamental note and its octave which succeed each other and are intended to succeed each other with a certin pre-established regularity.”
“Theory of sound in its relation to musiceṉṟa nūli eḻutiya Professor Blaserna of the royal university of Rome  collukiṟateṉṉaveṉṟāl, caṅkīta skēlāvatu ātāracurattiṟkum ataṉ ākṭēvukkum iṭiyiluḷḷa curattoṭarcci. itil curaṅkaḷ eppaṭi oṉṟaṉpiṉ oṉṟāy varavēṇṭumeṉṟāl avikaḷ ovvoṉṟiṟkum iṭiyil muṉ nirṇayikkappaṭṭa oruvita oḻuṅku irukka vēṇṭum.”
itil curutikaḷ oṉṟaṉpiṉ oṉṟāy oḻuṅkāṉa iṭiveḷikaḷōṭu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu teḷivāyt terikiṟatu.
Introduction to the study of Indian music Page 21.
“To avoid misapprehension, it will be advisable to premise that a scale is a collection of notes ranging from a given note to the note an octave above and resembling a ladder in this respect, that array (“that”) of notes must afford a practical means of ascent and descent.
“piṉṉālē nāṉ colluvatic cariyāyk kirakikkāmal tappip pōkātapaṭikku, nāṉ muṉṉatākavē colli vikkiṟateṉṉaveṉṟāl, oru skēlāṉatu eṭuttukkoṇṭa oru curattiṉiṉṟu ataṉmēl ākṭēl varikku uḷḷa pala cura aṭukkukaḷālāṉatu. intac cura aṭukkukaḷ oru ēṇiyip pōṉṟavi. atiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷ lēcāy ēṟuvataṟkum iṟaṅkuvataṟkumāṉa vakiyāy amikkappaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum.”
itil taṅkaḷ pustakatti vācikkiṟavarkaḷukkut tavaṟutalāṉa apip pirāyam uṇṭākātirukkumpaṭi tāṅkaḷ ecrittuc collukiṟatu eṉṉa veṉṟāl ‘oru stāyiyil varum cura aṭukkukaḷāṉavi culapamāka ēṟuvataṟkum iṟaṅkuvataṟkum kūṭiyatāy oru ēṇiyip pōlirukka vēṇṭum’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ koṭuttirukkum cura aḷavukaḷ oru ēṇippaḻuvukku ottirukkiṉṟaṉavā? ēṇiyiṉ kiramatti aṟiyāta varkaḷ illi. oru ēṇiyic ceyyum oru paṭṭikkāṭṭu ācāri mutal mutal ēṇikkuriya iraṇṭu maraṅkaḷit terintu koṇṭu ovvoru paṭiyum oṉpatu aṅkulamāy, allatu pattu aṅkulamāy allatu patiṉoṉṟu paṉṉiraṇṭu aṅkulamāy varavēṇṭumeṉṟum ataṟkut tuḷi ataṉmēl oru aṅkulam allatu 11/2 aṅkulam varavēṇṭumeṉṟum orē kucciyil kuṟittukkoṇṭu (9+11/2) atupōl periya mūṅkilil kuṟittukkoṇṭē pōkiṟāṉ. mutaṟ paḻuviṟkum kaṭici paḻuviṟkum muṉṉum piṉṉum 3/4 aṭikkuk kuṟiyāmal viṭṭut tuṇṭu paṇṇukiṟāṉ. ataṉpiṉ tāṉ kuṟittapaṭi 9 aṅkulam iṭiveḷiyākavum 11/2 aṅkulam tuḷiyākavum vittut tuḷiyaṭitta piṉ maṟṟoru mūṅkilit tuḷiyaṭittatiṉ pakkattil vittu mūlimaṭṭap palaki yiṉāl ataṟkuc camamāka aṭiyāḷam ceytu koñcamāvatu kūṭutal kuṟital illāmal tuḷiyaṭittup paḻumāṭṭukiṟāṉ. ēṉeṉṟāl avikaḷ muṉ piṉṉāka irukkumāṉāl ēṟuvatum iṟaṅkuvatum kaṣṭa mākum. ēṇiyum cīkkiram keṭṭup pōkum. ēṟukiṟavarkaḷ vaḻukki viḻuvārkaḷ.
iv vuvamāṉam coṉṉa tāṅkaḷ, taṅkaḷ curuti muṟikkuk koṭukkum viparēṣaṉiṉ kaṇakki camamāyirukkiṟatā eṉṟu ottup pārkkavilli eṉṟu terikiṟatu. taṅkaḷ puttakam 8vatu pakkattil patiṉmūṉṟāvatu curutiyiliruntu irupattiraṇṭu variyilum patiṉoru curutikaḷ collappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivikaḷil tāṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭitta nūtaṉamāṉa iraṇṭu curutikaḷum 324, 420 eṉṟa viparēṣaṉōṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. ivi tāṅkaḷ terintu koḷḷum aintu mattimaṅkaḷil mūṉṟāvatākavum tāṅkaḷ vittuk koḷḷum aintu niṣātaṅkaḷil mutal niṣātamākavum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivikaḷiṉ ōciyiṉ alikaḷiṉ kaṇakki nām kavaṉippōmāṉāl 320 kkum 324 kkum pētam 4 ōciyiṉ alikaḷum 324 kkum 3371/2 kkum pētam 13.5 ōciyiṉ alikaḷum ippaṭiyē 5. 9, 18, 6, 16, 5, 15, 6.67, 5.31, 18.4, pōṉṟa varicikaḷum kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. ivvaḷavu pētamāṉa ōcikaḷum ēṇip paḻukkaḷum varumāṉāl ēṟi iṟaṅka mikac culapamākumā? mēṟ kaṇṭa oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa aḷaviṉpaṭi oru ācāri ēṇi ceytu koṇṭu vantu koṭuttāl nīṅkaḷ cummā viṭuvīrkaḷā? eṉṉa pāṭu paṭuttuvīrkaḷ? ēṇi ceyta ācārikku oru niyāyamum oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa curutikaḷic collum taṅkaḷukku oru niyāyamumā? caṟṟu nitāṉittup pāruṅkaḷ.
ivikaḷ nāṉ parōṭāvil vācitta iraṇṭāvatu puttakattil 37, 38m pakkaṅkaḷiluḷḷa aṭṭavaṇiyil 7āvatu kalattil pattāvatu variyiliruntu kavaṉippīrkaḷāṉāl teḷivākat teriyum. curutikaḷ mēl pōkap pōka Geometrical Progression paṭi koñcam koñcam kūṭutal aṭiyum eṉpatit tāṅkaḷ aṟivīrkaḷ. atikam terinta tāṅkaḷ aṭṭavaṇiyil teḷivākak kaṇṭu koḷḷalām. ௸ aṭṭavaṇiyil kaṇṭa kaṇitamuṟippaṭiyē vīṇiyil aḷantu curastāṉaṅkaḷ kuṟittu capi muṉ pāṭiṉēṉ. avi karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷumākavē yiruntaṉa. aṅku vantirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷil oruvarāvatu pāṭal tavaṟutalāyirukkiṟateṉṟāvatu vīṇiyiṉ ōci tavaṟutalāyirukkiṟa teṉṟāvatu piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiya kīrttaṉam tavaṟutalāyirukkiṟa teṉṟāvatu collavilli. taṅkaḷit tavira capiyār yāvarum āṉantittārkaḷ. taṅkaḷ kātukkuḷ aruvarukkappaṭṭa ārmōṉiyattiṉ apacuramiruntapaṭiyāl taṅkaḷ kātiṟku māttiram atu aruvaruppāyiruntatu.
Equal Temperament muṟi iṉṉateṉṟum atu 120, 150 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉāl Mozart, Beethoven eṉpavarkaḷāl kaṇṭu piṭikkappaṭṭateṉṟum atu maṟṟavarkaḷāl ēḷaṉam ceyyappaṭukiṟa teṉṟum perumpālum aṉēka vitvāṉkaḷukkut teriyātu. itaṉāl eṉṉa tōṣam? āṉāl pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉ pāṭi vanta irākaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅkum curaṅkaḷiyum, curutikaḷiyum aṇuppiramāṇamum tavaṟāmal kēṭṭup pāṭam paṇṇip paṭikkakkūṭiyavarkaḷ eṉpatil yātoru āṣēpaṉiyumilli. āṉāl nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷil pala curaṅkaḷōṭu cērntu varum poḻutu avikaḷi iṉṉateṉṟu colla muṭiyāmal pōṉatiṉāl kuṟi collukiṟīrkaḷ. karnāṭaka caṅkītattip paṟṟit taṅkaḷukkut teriyātataṉāl ippaṭic collukiṟīrkaḷ. intustāṉ caṅkītattic colla vanta tāṅkaḷ karnāṭaka caṅkītattik kuṟi collāmaliruntāl taṅkaḷi intustāṉ caṅkītattilāvatu tērntavarkaḷeṉṟu niṉikka iṭamuṇL.
tāṅkaḷ koṇṭu vanta ārmōṉiyam intustāṉ curattiṟkum atippōluḷḷa karnāṭaka curattiṟkum ottuvarāmal pōṉapiṉ ati intiya ārmōṉiyam eṉṟu collalāmā? apacuram niṟinta taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil vācittup paḻakiya nimittam iṉimiyuḷḷateṉṟu yāvarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭṭa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ taṅkaḷukku aruvaruppāyt tōṉṟiṉa.
taṅkaḷ curaṅkaḷ cama aḷavuṭiyavikaḷāyt tāṅkaḷ collukiṟapaṭi oru ēṇiyippō lirukkumāṉāl appōtu oru stāyiyil Geometrical Progression paṭi 24 curutikaḷē kiṭikkum eṉṟum atil ca-pa muṟippaṭiyum, ca-ma muṟippaṭiyum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ 24 curutikaḷ, maṟṟum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷum amiyum eṉṟum tiṭṭamāyk kāṇpīrkaḷ. iṉṉum oru taṭavi kāṉpareṉsukku varumpoḻutu eṇkaṇakkiṉpaṭiyē taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattit tiruttik koṇṭu varumpaṭiyākak kēṭṭuk koḷḷu kiṟēṉ. appōtu eṉ muṟi cariyeṉṟu oppuk koḷvīrkaḷ. nāṉākak kūṭak kuṟittu vittuk koḷḷavilli. tamiḻ kkaḷ pāṭi vanta caṅkītattil varum ōcikaḷum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷum varum iṭaṅkaḷi pala varuṭaṅkaḷāka vicārittu ataṉ piṉ ataṟkuk kaṇakku ēṟpaṭuttiṉēṉ.
10. “iṉṉum cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukkuḷ airōppāvil atu muṟṟilum illāmaṟ pōkumeṉṟu nāṉ niccayamāyt tīrkkataricaṉamāy urippēṉ. atil kuṟikaḷum tappukaḷum atikam iruntapōtilum anēka kāriyaṅkaḷ oṉṟu cērnta airōppāvil atu stāpakamāṉatu. Indian Education eṉṟa pattirikiyil Sep-to Nov.1915 namparkaḷil itu viṣayattip paṟṟip pēci yirukkiṟēṉ. ati vācippīrkaḷāṉāl nalamāyirukkum. nāṉ collivanta kāriyattip paṟṟit tirumpac collukiṟēṉ. nīṅkaḷ naṉṟāy vicārittāl teriyum.”
iṉṉum cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukkuḷ Equal Temperament muṟiyillāmal pōkum eṉṟu tīrkka taricaṉam collukiṟīrkaḷ. inta tīrkkataricaṉam orupōtum niṟivēṟātu. mēṟṟiciyil ca-pa muṟiyāy ārmōṉiyam, piyāṉā mutaliyavikaḷil curuti cērkkum poḻutu oru stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. ivikaḷi Equal Temperament muṟiyeṉṟu collukiṟārkaḷ. tantiyil 2/3 āka vikkumpoḻutu kiṭikkum ōcikaḷukku Harmonic series  eṉṟu peyar vittārkaḷ. uḷḷapaṭi ḻayacaaṭilē uṭiyati Equal Temperament eṉṟu ēḷaṉam ceytārkaḷ. Harmonic series  paṭi cellum poḻutu oru stāyi carivara muṭivaṭiyāmal ovvoru curattilum koñcam koñcam kūṭutal aṭintu ōnāy ūḷiyiṭukiṟatupōl aruvaruppuṇṭākiṟateṉṟu caṭcamam pañcamam poruntum muṟiyil 12 curaṅkaḷi stāpittārkaḷ. pañcamam evvaḷavu kūṭa vēṇṭum evvaḷavu kuṟiyavēṇṭumeṉṟu kaṇakkuc colvatu kūṭāta kāriyameṉṟum curañāṉattik koṇṭu tīrkka vēṇṭumeṉṟum muṭittārkaḷ.
The art of tuning the pianoforte by Hermann Smith, Page. 54.
“These trials, as they are called, afford at each step a check by which the correctness of the progress may be indicated, or, unfortunately, probably the incorrectness of your first estimates of “how much” and “how little.”
The last is the severest test, as the two notes of which this fifth is formed have been obtined by different series of fifths, and any imperfection in the gradation of the beatings allotted to the previous fifths will minfest itself here. Hence this fifth, from the frequent harshness and howlings of its beats, has been technically termed the wolf, and strict injunctions are, “Look out for the wolf” Reckon yourself fortunate if no wolf appears.”
“inta nōṭṭukaḷit tirumpat tirumpa vācittup pārttāl evvaḷavu kūṭṭa vēṇṭum ,evvaḷavu kuṟikkavēṇṭum eṉpatu tiṭṭamākuvatu mallāmal, nām nōṭṭukaḷic cariyāṉa curattil vikkiṟōmō allavō eṉṟum namakku niccayamākum. inta aintāvatu aintavatāy (ca-pa poruttamāy) nōṭṭukaḷi curappaṭuttuvatu tāṉ atika kaṣṭam. ēṉeṉṟāl mutalil itik koñcam kūṭavittuviṭuvōmāṉāl atu varavara atikappaṭṭuk kaṭiciyil peruṅkaṣṭatti viḷivikkum. inta aintām poruttam kātukku iṉimiyittarāmal oru ōnāyiṉ ūḷi yip pōl aṭikkaṭi iruppatāl ataṟku “ōnāy” eṉṟē peyar. piyāṉāvi ṟyūṉ paṇṇum oruvaṉukkuk koṭukkappaṭṭa mukkiya kaṭṭaḷi eṉṉaveṉṟāl “ōnāy varāmal jākkiratiyāyiru. appaṭi ōnāy varāviṭṭāl nī pākkiyavāṉtāṉ” eṉpatē.”
itil tāṅkaḷ Harmonic series  eṉṟu kaṭṭik koṇṭu avatippaṭum 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa mēlnāṭṭu ōnāyiṉ ūḷiyip paṟṟi iṅkē collap paṭukiṟatu. mēṟṟēcaṅkaḷil piṟantu vaḷarnta inta ōnāy uruppaṭi iṉṉa teṉṟu teriyāmal taṅkaḷik kiḻittut tiṉṟuviṭumēyeṉṟu mikavum aṉutāpappaṭukiṟēṉ.
Harmonic series  iṉṉateṉṟum Equal Temperament muṟi iṉṉateṉṟum nāṉ itaṉ muṉ kavaṉikkavilli. āṉāl pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta icit tamiḻiṉ cila kuṟippukaḷik koṇṭum nāḷatu variyum pāṭappaṭṭu varum aṉupōkattik koṇṭum tīra vicārittu muṭivāṉa vikaḷic coṉṉēṉ. iti māṟṟa niṉippavarkaḷ caṅkītattiṟkē catturukkaḷāvārkaḷ. nāṉ koṭutta 67 kīrttaṉikaḷil oru piḻiyāvatu kāṭṭavēṇṭu meṉṟu pirayācappaṭṭuk kaṭiciyil ‘aṟupattāṟum cariyā yirukkiṉṟaṉa. taṉṉiyāci kīrttaṉattil māttiram kāntāram kūṭi varukiṟatu’ eṉṟu colli vekunēram vātittum capiyōrāl taḷḷappaṭṭatupōl tāṅkaḷum iruppīrkaḷ. taṅkaḷ 22 curuti muṟiyum 25 curuti muṟiyum aṭutta kāṉpareṉsukkuḷḷākavē māṟippōkum eṉṟu nāṉ niccayamāyc colluvēṉ. itu camayattiṟkēṟṟa vitamāy aruttamākum tīrkka taricaṉamalla.
atōṭu ‘nāṉ collivanta kāriyaṅkaḷit tirumpac collukiṟēṉ nīṅkaḷ naṉṟāy vicārittāl teriyum’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. Equal Temperament muṟiyiyum taṅkaḷ muṟiyiyum tēvāl avarkaḷuṭiya muṟiyiyum naṉṟāy vicārittu iraṇṭu varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉālēyē avikaḷukku maṟuppu eḻutiyirukkiṟēṉ. Indian Education eṉṟa pattirikiyil eḻutiya viṣayaṅkaḷ taṅkaḷ pustakatti aṉucarittēyirukkum. vēṟu viṣayaṅkaḷirukkumāṉāl eḻuti aṉuppuṅkaḷ. kaṭṭāyam pārkkiṟēṉ.
11. “vēṟē vāttiya utaviyillāmal inta artificial iṭi veḷikaḷip pāṭukiṟa allatu Violin vācikkiṟa evarum avikaḷic cariyāyp pāṭuvatu turlapam. taṅkaḷ kuḻantikaḷum appaṭiyē tavaṟukiṟārkaḷ.”
piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷi artificial iṭi veḷikaḷiyuṭiyaviyeṉṟu tāṅkaḷ kuṟivāṉa vārttikaḷic collukiṟīrkaḷ. piṭilil vācippatu kūṭāta kāriyam eṉṟum kuḻantikaḷum appaṭiyē tavaṟukiṟārkaḷeṉṟum collukiṟīrkaḷ. uṇmi maṟintu tulaṅkāmal pōṉapiṉ uṇmiyic collukiṟavarkaḷ pittiyakkārar tāṉē. uṇmikku etir niṉṟu pōrāṭukiṟavarkaḷ piṉṉāl pāpikaḷ eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭukiṟārkaḷ. kuḻantikaḷ pāṭiṉa caṅkītatattiṟku nāṉ kaṇakkuc coṉṉēṉ. ivviraṇṭum uṇmiyuṭiyaviyeṉṟu maṟṟavarkaḷ kāṇumpoḻutu taṅkaḷi ikaḻvārkaḷēyeṉṟu aṉutāpappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
piḷḷikaḷ oru stāyiyil varum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷiyum 24 curutikaḷiyum variciyāyp pāṭik kāṭṭiṉārkaḷē. atil entac curutiyil evvaḷavu kuṟintateṉṟu kavaṉittīrkaḷ? pāṭik kāṭṭiyavikaḷ cama aḷavāṉa ōciyuṭiyavikaḷā yiruntaṉaveṉṟu nāṉ tiṭamākac colluvēṉ. paratar, caṅkīta ratṉākarar pōṉṟa makāṉkaḷ aṅkiruntāl avarkaḷum taṅkaḷ karuttu ‘itutāṉ, itutāṉ’ eṉṟu koṇṭāṭuvārkaḷ. ‘itu viṣayattil nāṅkaḷ tavaṟippōṉōm’ eṉṟu oppuk koḷvārkaḷ. pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷākat tamiḻ makkaḷ pāṭik koṇṭirukkum curaṅkaḷi yum curutikaḷiyum coṉṉēṉē yoḻiya takunta cāstira ātāra millāmal nāṉ oṉṟum collavilli. tāṅkaḷ iti aṟiyāmal pōṉālum maṟṟa yāvarum aṟintukoḷvārkaḷ eṉpatu niccayam.
kōṭi iṭiyiṉ cattamum kēṭkāta ceviṭaṉ kātil caṅku ūti eṉṉa pirayōjaṉam? tāṅkaḷ intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curuti viṣayamāy niṉittapaṭi yellām collukiṟateṉṟa kuruṭṭāṭṭamāṉa muṟiyip piṭivātamāyc cātikkiṟatāka nāṉ kāṇkiṟēṉ. piṭil vācikkiṟa evarum cama iṭiveḷikaḷuḷḷa curaṅkaḷi vācippatu turlapam eṉṟum appaṭiyē kuḻantikaḷum tavaṟukiṟārkaḷeṉṟum eṉṉat tuṇikara māyc collukiṟīrkaḷ. piṭil vācitta upāttiyāyariṉ tiṟamiyāvatu pāṭiṉa kuḻantikaḷiṉ tiṟamiyāvatu taṅkaḷukkut teriyātu. appaṭit teriyāmal pōṉālum capiyil pāṭiṉapoḻutāvatu curutikaḷi aṇu aṇuvākap pirittuk kāṭṭiya poḻutāvatu kavaṉittu aṟintukoḷḷak kūṭiya cura ñāṉam taṅkaḷukkuk koñcamāvatu illi eṉṟu taṅkaḷ viyācattiṉāl terikiṟatu.
karnāṭaka caṅkītattil mikunta pirakkiyāti peṟṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi makā vittiyanāta aiyar avarkaḷ koṇṭāṭumpaṭiyāṉa curañāṉamuṭiyavarum kēṭṭavar maṉam urukum vitamāyk kati ceyvatilum cākittiyattilu tāḷattilum vāyppāṭṭilum nāḷatu vari yāvarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭukiṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi kiruṣṇa pākavatar avarkaḷ kūṭavē cīṣarāyiruntu avarippōlavē kati ceyvatilum kāṉam ceyvatilum piṭil vācippatilum tērnta vitva cirōmaṇiyeṉṟu tamiḻnāṭu muṟṟilum koṇṭāṭappaṭṭu varukiṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarḷiyā cariyāyppāṭavilli, tavaṟip pōṉārkaḷ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ? karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷik kīrttaṉikaḷil varum muṟippaṭi aṇuvēṉum tavaṟāmal vāttiya utaviyillāmalē pāṭakkūṭiya tērnta ñāṉamuṭiyavar. avaruṭiya kalvit tiṟamiyi kāṉpareṉsil vantirunta karnāṭaka vitva cirōmaṇikaḷ teḷivāy aṟivārkaḷ. avaruṭiya cāmarttiyam iṉṉateṉṟu tāṅkaḷ terintukoḷvataṟku piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiya oru kīrttaṉamē pōtum. atikkēṭṭu nitāṉikkum curañāṉam taṅkaḷukku illāmiyiṉāl ippaṭic collukiṟīrkaḷ.
paṉṟi vēṭṭiyāṭukiṟavarkaḷ nīṇṭa īṭṭiyiṉāl kutti ati vatittu vēṭikki pārttu cantōṣappaṭuvatupōla capiyiluḷḷa vitva cirōmaṇikaḷik kuṟi kūṟi tāṅkaḷ cantōṣap paṭukiṟatākat terikiṟatu. ippaṭip piṟari avatūṟu colli cantōṣappaṭuvatil tāṅkaḷ atika ki tērntavarkaḷ eṉṟu ovvoru kuṟippiṉālum terikiṟatu. tāṅkaḷ kuṟicollum piṭil upāttiyāyarukku ivviṣayam iṉṉum collap paṭavilli. ēṉeṉṟāl 22 curutiyic cātikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu cattiyam ceytukoṇṭa tirukkūṭṭattil cērntu taṉyāciyil varum kāntāram tuvāvimcati curutiyiṉ muṟippaṭi kuṟintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu tāṉ paṭittuk koṭutta kīrttaṉiyiyē tāṉ kuṟittup pāṭa, nāṉ pala niyāyamum colli tāṅkaḷ paṭittukkoṭutta kīrttaṉaṅkaḷi vēṇṭu meṉṟu kuṟittup pāṭukiṟīrkaḷ eṉṟu colla vantirunta viṇīka cirōmaṇi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷālum maṟṟum capiyō rālum ‘tāṅkaḷ colvatucariyalla’ veṉṟu maṟukkappaṭṭatiṉāl caṟṟēṟak kuṟiya iraṇṭu mātamāka pākavatar avarkaḷ eṉ vīṭṭiṟku varavilli. avarkaḷ vantapiṉ kaṭṭāyam nāṉ avarkaḷukkut terivippēṉ. avarkaḷum taṅkaḷukkup patil eḻutuvārkaḷ.
atōṭu viṭṭuviṭāmal kuḻantikaḷiyum kuṟi collukiṟīrkaḷ. kuḻantikaḷ eṉṟu collum poḻutu peṟṟavaṉukku kumārattikaḷāṉālum taṅkaḷip pārkkilum tērnta caṅkīta ñāṉamuṭiyavarkaḷeṉṟu nīṅkaḷ kavaṉikkavilli.
teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum nuṭpa curutikaḷi nāṉ kavaṉikkumuṉ mēṟṟiciyāriṉ caṅkīta viṣayamum iṉṉateṉṟu aṟintu koḷḷa vēṇṭumeṉṟu virumpi St. Peter’s High School talimi upāttiyāyarum St. Peter’s Church Organist-m āṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi A.G.piccimuttu B.A., L.A., avarkaḷik koṇṭu English Music kaṟṟukoṭukkumpaṭi ceytu Trinity College of Music, London kalācāliyiṉ parīṭciyil eṉatu kumāratti marakatavalli ammāḷ 1914-m varuṣam cūṉ mātam Higher Local  eṉṟa ēḻāvatu parīṭciyilum kaṉakavalli ammāḷ 1913-m varuṣam cūṉ mātam Intermidiate eṉṟa nālāvatu parīṭciyilum vānaṭicala pās paṇṇi yirukkiṟārkaḷ. eṉ kumāratti marakatavalli ammāḷē intiya kiṟistavar kaḷukkuḷ mutal mutal anta uyartara parīṭciyil tēṟiyirukkiṟatu.
makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tiyākarājapiḷḷi avarkaḷ kumārar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cāmiyāpiḷḷi avarkaḷiṭattil ārampap paṭippu mutal cumār 100 kīrttaṉikaḷ paṭittatōṭu araṇmaṉi viṇīkar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi ātimūrtti aiyar avarkaḷ kumārar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi veṅkaṭācalamiyar avarkaḷāl vīṇiyil coṟpap payiṟciyum peṟṟārkaḷ. atōṭu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷāl cumār 100 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ variyum veku nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷik kavaṉittup pāṭum curañāṉamum tāḷañāṉamu muṭiyavarkaḷāṉārkaḷ. ippaṭi paṭittuk koṇṭu varukiyil caṅkītattiṟkuriya cila mukkiya amcaṅkaḷum iṭikkiṭiyē eṉṉāl collappaṭṭum vantatu. atil eṭuttukkoṇṭa ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇattiṟku kavaṉikkavēṇṭiya aintu vitamāṉa ilakkaṇaṅkaḷiyum eṉatu camcāram pākkiyam ammāḷukkuk kaṟṟukkoṭuttu kītam irākac cāyic curukkam jīvacuram mutaliyavikaḷōṭu cumār āyiram irākaṅkaḷ eḻuti muṭintirukkiṟatu. immuṟiyi piḷḷikaḷum aṟivārkaḷ. appaṭic ceyta kītattiliruntu kīrttaṉam eḻutum muṟiyi kaṟṟuk koṭukka atil tērnta marakatavalli ammāḷāl caṟṟēṟakkuṟiya 50 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ putiya irākaṅkaḷil putitāy ceyyappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa. mātirikkāka paḻamiyāṉa irākaṅkaḷilum cila kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
ivikaḷil cila kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ākasṭu mātam 19-m tēti naṭanta tañci caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattiṟku vantirunta capiyōr muṉ pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. acṭitta piratikaḷum koṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. evarum evvita māṉa kuṟiyum colla villi. mikavum cāstirōktamum iṉimiyu muḷḷateṉṟu palarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭṭatu. kuḻantikaḷum, avarkaḷiṉ tāyārum nāṉum vīṇāka aṅku varavilli. kūṭiya vari intiya caṅkītattiṟkāka eṉṉa eṉṉa ceyya vēṇṭiyatu avaciyamō avikaḷic ceyvatiṉ nōkkamākavē aṅku vantōm.
tāṅkaḷ curutiyip paṟṟi vātikkumpoḻutu tāṅkaḷ collum curutiyiṉpaṭi oru Music Piece ceytu kāṭṭa vēṇṭu meṉṟu oru ciṟu tuṇṭu kaṭitam piraciṭeṇṭukku eḻuti aṉuppiṉēṉ. tāṅkaḷ collāmal pōṉāl yāṉ eṉ muṟippaṭi collavum ceytu kāṭṭavum tayārā yiruntēṉ. avarkaḷō itu yārāl ceyya muṭiyumeṉṟu colli viṭṭārkaḷ. capiyiṉ nōkkamaṟintu nāṉum cummāviruntēṉ.
intiya caṅkītattiṟku Staff notation  eppaṭi kuṟikkiṟa teṉṟa viṣayattil Staff notation  for Indian Music eṉṟa talippuṭiyatāy mūṉṟāvatu article marakatavalli ammāḷāl vācikkappaṭṭatiyum atil āyappāli, vaṭṭappāli, tirikōṇappāli, caturap pāli eṉṉum nāluvita pālikaḷukku tiṣṭāntamākak koṭukkappaṭṭa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷip pāṭik kāṭṭiyatiyum pustakattiyum tāṅkaḷ pārttīrkaḷē! pārttiruntum tāṅkaḷ kuṟi kūṟuvatik koṇṭu taṅkaḷukku iṅkilīṣ miyūcikkilum takunta ñāṉamilliyeṉṟu veḷiyākiṟatu.
itōṭu piḷḷikaḷ kakaṉakutukalam allatu kataṉa kutukalam eṉṟa kīrttaṉiyip pāṭumpoḻutu atil piriyappaṭṭa parōṭā camastāṉa Band Master Mr. Fredlis akkīrttaṉiyit taṉakku Staff notation l kuṟittukkoṭukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu piriyamāyk kēṭṭukkoḷḷa aṉṟu cāyantiram mūṉṟu maṇikkē eḻuti koṭukkappaṭṭu tamatu kaṭaravanal appaṭiyē vācittu capi yōrkaḷi cantōṣappaṭuttiṉārkaḷē. karnāṭaka caṅkītatti veku culapa māy Staff notation l kuṟittuk koṭuttatiyum Band Master Mr. Fredlis atiṉ paṭiyē vācittatiyum tāṅkaḷ kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntīrkaḷē. ippaṭip paṭṭavarkaḷiyā nīṅkaḷ kuṟicollavēṇṭum? aṇu aṇuvāṉa curaṅkaḷi tāṅkaḷ aṟintu koḷḷat tiṟamiyillāmal aṟintu pāṭukiṟavarkaḷiyum avatūṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. aṇu aṇuvāṉa curaṅ kaḷip paḻakukiṟataṟku nāṅkaḷ paṭṭa kaṣṭatti teyvam aṟivār. capi yil vantirunta yāvarum oruvāṟu aṟivārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ aṟiyāmal pōṉatip paṟṟi nāṉ āccariyappaṭavilli.
taṅkaḷippōl niṣātam kuṟikiṟateṉṟu Band Master Mr. Fredlis tarkkittu ‘aṟupatupēr vācikkum poḻutu tavaṟuvāṉāṉāl atik kaṇṭu piṭikkak kūṭiya cāmarttiya muṭiyavaṉ nāṉ’ eṉṟu vīram pēciṉār. appōtu paṉṉiraṇṭu perutta nātaṅkaḷip paḻakum uṅkaḷukkut toṇṇūṟṟāṟil oṉṟāṉa nuṭpacuram varamāṭṭāteṉṟu colli aṉu curaṅkaḷiṉālum aṉupōkattilirukkum irākaṅkaḷiṉ curaṅkaḷālum pāṭikkāṭṭi aṅkirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷum intustāṉi kavāykaḷum niṣātam caritāṉ eṉṟu colla uṭaṉē turi eṉṉi maṉṉippuk kēṭṭukkoṇṭār. nāṉum maṉṉittēṉ.
nīṅkaḷum eṉṉiyāvatu kuḻantikaḷiyāvatu piṭil vācitta makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷiyāvatu kēṭṭiruntāl eṅkaḷuṭiya patiliṉāl taṅkaḷukkuc cariyāṉa aṟivu vantirukkum. aintu nāḷ aṅku iruntōmē. anta nāṭkaḷil ivvitamāṉa kuṟippukaḷil eti yāvatu oṉṟu colli yiruppīrkaḷāṉāl uṅkaḷic cummā viṭṭirup pōmā? cariyāṉapaṭi niyāyan tīrttiruppōm. ativiṭṭu ivvaḷavu nāḷāṉapiṉ capiyip paṟṟiyum, vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷip paṟṟiyum, eṉ kuḻantikaḷip paṟṟiyum nīṅkaḷ kuṟippukaḷ eḻutuvatu muṟṟilum tavaṟutalāṉa kāriyam. ippaṭippaṭṭavarkaḷukkup patil eḻutāmal viṭuvatu iṉṉum atika keṭutalukkiṭamāku meṉṟu eḻuta niṉittēṉ. tāṅkaḷ evvaḷavō uyarnta pataviyi liruntum ippaṭi aniyāyamāṉa vārtti kaḷic colvatip pārkka nāṉ veṭkappaṭukiṟēṉ.
12. “tāṅkaḷ tayār ceyta vīṇiyi vittukkoṇṭu kuḻantikaḷ pāṭiṉapōtu kuṟittu vitta iṭiveḷiyip pāṭiṉatiṉāl atu kātukku avvaḷavu iṉimiyāy illi.”
nāṉ tayār ceyta vīṇiyik koṇṭu piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiyatu kuṟinta iṭiveḷikaḷuḷḷavi kaḷāyiruntatāl kātukku iṉimiyā yilli eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ pōṭṭirukkum oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa 25 curutikaḷ eṉṟa aḻukkaṭinta mūkkuk kaṇṇāṭiyi eṭuttu viṭṭup pārppīrkaḷāṉāl appōtu tulāmparamāyt teriyum. apacurak kuṭukki yākiya taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyatti vanta vaḻiyē aṉuppiviṭṭu pūrvat tamiḻ makkaḷ curuti cērkkum muṟippaṭi ārmōṉiyam ceytu atilāvatu - vīṇiyilāvatu paḻakip pāruṅkaḷ. appōtu intiyāviṉ pūrva kuṭikaḷākiya tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta kāṉattiṉ cūṭcumam aṟintu colla muṭiyāmal palar palavitamāy apippirāyappaṭṭu nūl eḻutiṉārka ḷeṉṟu aṟivīrkaḷ. kamakamāy vīṇiyil vācikkavēṇṭiya curaṅkaḷi ataṟkuriya iṉimiyōṭu ārmōṉiyattil muṟṟilum kāṭṭa muṭiyā teṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟiya vēṇṭum.
13. “avarkaḷ piṭiluṭaṉ cērntu pāṭiṉapōtu avarkaḷum piṭil vācittavarum taṅkaḷi yaṟiyāmalē vēṟu ārōkaṇa avarō kaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟiviṭṭārkaḷ.”
piṭil vācitta upāttiyāyarum pāṭiya piḷḷikaḷum taṅkaḷi aṟiyāmalē vēṟu ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟiviṭṭārkaḷeṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. itu mika naṉṟāyirukkiṟatu. taṅkaḷukkuk karnāṭaka caṅkītamum teriyumeṉṟu itaṉāl veḷippaṭuttukiṟīrkaḷ. enta irākam pāṭumpoḻutu enta irākattiṟku māṟiṉārkaḷ? atic collāmaṟ potuvākac colvatu mikavum mōcamāṉatu. capiyil ippaṭi oru kuṟippic colli yiruppīrkaḷāṉāl aṅkirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷ uṅkaḷic cummāviṭṭirukka māṭṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷellārum uṅkaḷōṭu caṇṭikku varavēṇṭumā?
ārōkaṇam, avarōkaṇaṅkaḷil kiramam mīṟi vēṟu oru curam kalakku māṉāl neruppil viḻunta puḻuppōl maṉam tuṭikkum aṟivāḷikaḷ piḷḷikaḷeṉṟāvatu, pākavatareṉṟāvatu pārkka māṭṭārkaḷ. kēṭṭuk koṇṭu cummāyirukkavum māṭṭārkaḷ. vēṟu ārōkaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟi viṭṭārkaḷeṉṟu eṅkaḷiyum, avikaḷik kēṭṭukkoṇṭirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷiyum tāṅkaḷ mōṭaṉam ceyvatu cariyalla.
eṅkaḷ vayiṟṟu āttirattiṟkākavā 1500 rūpāvukku mēl celavu ceytu pala vitamāṉa caṅkaṭaṅkaḷiyum aṉupavittuk koṇṭu aṅku vantu vēṟu irākaṅkaḷukku māṟṟip pāṭiṉōm? maṟṟavarkaḷ etaṟkākak kēṭṭuk koṇṭintārkaḷ? ēṉ kēṭṭuk koṇṭirukkiṟīrkaḷeṉṟu avarkaḷi nīṅkaḷ kēṭkak kūṭātā? eṅkaḷip pōlavē avarkaḷiyum mūṭarkaḷeṉṟu niṉittuk koṇṭīrkaḷ. ippaṭi jaṉacamūkattip puṇpaṭuttum vārttikaḷ colvatip pārkkilum tāṅkaḷ cummāyiruntāl mikap perumiyā yirukkum.
makārājā avarkaḷ kūṭṭi vitta capiyiyum capiyil vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷiyum tāṅkaḷ naṉkumatikkavilli eṉṟu taṅkaḷ vacaṉaṅkaḷiṉāl veḷiyākiṉṟatu. ‘tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ pūrva kāṉattiṉ uṇmiyi yāvarum aṟintu koḷḷa vēṇṭum; ammuṟiyē ulakatti luḷḷa caṅkītam yāvaṟṟilum mēlāṉatu; oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu avatippaṭa vēṇṭām’ eṉṟu eṉ conta jaṉaṅ kaḷukkum conta tēcattārukkum ulakattār yāvarukkum uṇmiyit teriyappaṭutta nāṉ avvaḷavu tūram vantēṉēyoḻiya, ippaṭit taṅkaḷāl avatūṟāṉa kuṟinta vārttikaḷik kēṭka varavilli. taṅkaḷi yottavarkaḷ ivvārttikaḷ colvatum muṟṟilum tavaṟutalāka irukkiṟatu.
14. “avarkaḷ mukkiyamāy māṟippōkiṟa Scale kku ditonal scaleeṉṟu peyar. itittāṉ Pythagoras uṭiya skēl eṉṟu cātāraṇamāyc colvārkaḷ.”
itippaṟṟi nāṉ oru article cīkkiram eḻutuvēṉ. Blaserna eṉpavaruṭiya ‘Theory of sounds’ eṉṟa nūlip pōṉṟa maṟṟa nūlkaḷāl tāṉ Pythagoras uṭiya scale  caṅkīta carittira viṣayattil eṉṉa vēli ceytirukkiṟateṉpatip paṟṟic cāmāṉya jaṉaṅkaḷ tappāṉa apippirāyam koḷvataṟku iṭamāyirukkiṟatu. eṉṉuṭiya apippirāyameṉṉa veṉṟāl temperament vanta piṟakutāṉ caṅkītattiṟku oru mukkiya ātāramāka eṇṇappaṭṭatē yoḻiya ataṟku muntiyalla. āti kirēkkarukkuḷ kittāriyic curuti cērppatil upayōkappaṭuttappaṭṭa cutta skēl muṟikaḷil itu oṉṟāyiruntatu. itu veku cukariyamāyirunta paṭiyāl inta skēli ātāramākak koṇṭē vāttiyaṅkaḷukku notation  eḻuta ārampittārkaḷ. antak kittāriyiṉ tantikaḷi muṟukkiṉāl ariccuram varikkum uyarttakkūṭiya vitamāy atu amikkappaṭṭataṉāl enta skēl avaciyamō ati vācikkumpaṭiyāyc coḷakariyam ēṟpaṭṭatu. taṟkāla piṅkār allatu vīṇiyil meṭṭukaḷil illāta curaṅkaḷi eppaṭit tantiyi iḻuppataṉāl kamakamāy vācikkiṟōmō appaṭittāṉ. inta ditonal scale āṉatu terintavariyil kirēkka caṅkītattil upayōkappaṭuttappaṭavilli. atāvatu oru irākamāvatu Pythagoras muṟiyāyc curuti cērtta cutta curaṅkaḷāl uṇṭāṉatalla. Byzantine Empire (mukamatiya rājāṅkam) irunta kālattil caṅkītamē teriyāta cilar Pythagoras uṭiya kaṇakki ōṭṭiviṭṭārkaḷ. taṟkālam Just intervals eṉṟāl eṉṉaveṉṟu teriyāta paṇṭitarkaḷ 3033/4 uḷḷa kāntāram 405 uḷḷa tivatameṉṟu taṇṇīrpaṭṭa pāṭamāy eppaṭic collukiṟārkaḷō appaṭittāṉ atuvum.”
cama aḷavuḷḷa ōciyuṭiyatāyirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟa pūrva tamiḻ muṟippaṭi ceyta vīṇiyil kaṇṭa nātattiṉpaṭiyē tamiḻ makkaḷ pūrvam vaḻaṅki vantatum taṟkālam tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ vaḻakkatti liruppatumāṉa caṅkītattiyē piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷ. atit tāṅkaḷ ‘artificial iṭiveḷikaḷ’ eṉṟu patiṉōrāvatu vākkiyattilum ‘nāmāyk kūṭak kuṟittu vittuk koḷḷum curaṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu’ eṉṟu oṉpatāvatu vākkiyattilum, ‘kuṟittu vitta iṭiveḷikaḷuṭiya curattil pāṭiyatiṉāl atu iṉimiyāyilli’ eṉṟu paṉṉiraṇṭāvatu vākkiyattilum, ‘taṅkaḷi aṟiyāmalē vēṟu ārōkaṇa avarō kaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟiviṭṭārka’ḷeṉṟu patiṉmūṉṟām vākkiyattilum collukiṟīrkaḷ. ivikaḷik kavaṉikkumpoḻutu Equal Temperament muṟikkum Pythagoras muṟikkumuḷḷa nāta vittiyācam iṉṉateṉṟu tāṅkaḷ teḷivāka aṟintu koḷḷavilli; ōciyi aṟintu nitāṉikkum tiṟamiyum taṅkaḷukku illi eṉṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu. ēṉ caṅkītatti upattiravap paṭuttukiṟīrkaḷ?
Just intervals eṉṟāl iṉṉateṉṟu kaṇakkup perukkik koṇṭupōṉa tēvāl 3033/4 viparēṣaṉil 33/4 viparēṣaṉ ēṉ taḷḷiṉār eṉṟu kāraṇam collāmal ēṉ miraṭṭukiṟīrkaḷ? avar tappitamāyc ceyta kaṇakki tāṅkaḷ ēṉ ātāramāka eṭuttuk koṇṭīrkaḷ? ātāra caṭcam 240 viparēṣaṉ eṉṟu vittuk koṇṭu 2/3 x 2/3, 2/3 x 2/3 x 2/3 eṉṟu perukkik koṇṭupōṉa tantiyiṉ piṉṉattiṟku ōciyiṉ alikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭitta tappāṉa muṟiyiyē tāṅkaḷum eṭuttuk koṇṭu cātikka vantirukkiṟīrkaḷ. 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa piṉṉaṅkaḷ miccamillāmal vakukkappaṭa muṭiyāta eṇkaḷ eṉṟu puḷḷi pōṭṭuk koṇṭu niṟpatiyum appaṭiyē perukkumpoḻutu stāyikkuriya 1, 2, 4, 8 pōṉṟa muḻu ilakkaṅkaḷ kiṭikkāmal āñcanēyar vālpōlap pōkap pōka nīṇṭupōvatiyum eṭuttuc coṉṉavuṭaṉē kāṉpareṉsil vantirunta anēka vitvāṉ kaḷukkum maṟṟum aṟivāḷikaḷukkum itu cariyāṉa muṟiyalla eṉṟu takunta kāraṇam colli ‘itil āṭcēpaṉi irukkumāṉāl colla vēṇṭu’meṉṟu pala taṭavi kēṭṭēṉē. oruvarum oṉṟum pēca villiyē. tāṅkaḷum aṅku iruntīrkaḷē. oru vārtti vāy tiṟantu coṉṉīrkaḷā? taṅkaḷukku ēṉ appaṭippaṭavilli? appōtu cummā iruntuviṭṭu āṟu mātattiṟkup piṟaku eṉṉa āravāram?
oṉṟirukka maṟṟoṉṟic collum aṟivāḷikaḷiṉ col ettaṉi nāḷikku niṟkum? maṉōvākkuk kāyaṅkaḷ mūṉṟilum oṉṟākak kāṇappaṭum oru cattiyam, cuvarkka, mattiya, pātāḷam eṉṉum mūṉṟu ulakattilum oṉṟākavē nilittirukkum. appaṭi yillātavi “piḻikkiṟa piḷḷiyāṉāl piṟanta uṭaṉē cākātā”? eṉṟu collum parikācavākkiyampōl ākumē. taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyamum aṉṟē tolintatē. uyiraṟṟa oṉṟik kaṭṭik koṇṭu ettaṉi nāḷ avatippaṭuvīrkaḷ. nāṟippōkumē.
āyiṉum tāṅkaḷ ēḷaṉam ceykiṟa paṇṭitarkaḷ kūṭiya cīkkiram uṅkaḷ kaṇakkiyum ārmōṉiyattiyum kaṇṭittu uṅkaḷukku eḻutu vārkaḷ. ‘intiya caṅkītam mēṟṟiciyiliruntu oru airōppiyar vantu taṉṉi eṭuttu niṟutta vēṇṭumeṉṟu āvalāyk kāttuk koṇṭirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu coṉṉa collukku intiyāviṉ muṉṉōr kaḷiyum avarkaḷiṉ muṟikaḷiyum aṉupōkattiyum pāḻ ceyyat tāṅkaḷā taliyeṭukka vēṇṭum? taṅkaḷuṭiya kuṟippukaḷ (Remark)pārkkum poḻutu oṉṟumillāta coṟkaḷ pōliruntālum viṭamuḷḷa pāṇaṅkaḷippōl varuttattit tarukiṉṟaṉavē.
15. “taṅkaḷ kuḻantikaḷuṭiya kāṉamāṉatu Jackruddin ālum maṟṟavarkaḷālum atikamākap pukaḻap paṭṭapōtilum atu evvitattilum rucu eṉṟu colla muṭiyātu.”
‘taṅkaḷ kuḻantikaḷuṭiya kāṉamāṉatu cākruṭīṉālum maṟṟavar kaḷālum atikamāyp pukaḻappaṭṭapōtilum atu evvitattilum rucu eṉṟu collamuṭiyātu’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷē. oru nalla vārttiyāvatu pūraṇamāyc collakkūṭātā? colvatilum oru nañcu vittā colla vēṇṭum. capiyil vantirunta caṟṟēṟakkuṟiya 500 pērkaḷum koṇṭāṭumpaṭi nāṅkaḷ avarkaḷukku eṉṉa ceytōm? muṉpiṉ eṅkaḷi avarkaḷukkut teriyumā? iṉiya kītattik kēṭṭatiṉ nimittam atikkoṇṭāṭiṉārkaḷ.
kāṉpareṉs ārampattil teyvavaṇakkam piḷḷikaḷ colla vēṇṭumeṉṟu purōkirāmil kuṟittiruntārkaḷ. mutal mutal aṭāṉā kīrttaṉam pāṭappaṭṭatu. ārampittu mutal aṭi collum poḻutē piḷḷikaḷ pakkamirunta Mrs. Atya Begum Fyze Rahimin iṉiya kuraluk  kīṭupaṭṭu anēka kālam paḻakiṉavarkaḷpōl piriyaṅkāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. ataṉ piṉ ‘taṉ vīṭṭiṟku varavēṇṭumeṉṟum, taṉṉōṭu Tea  cāppiṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟum, taṉ pāṭṭik kēṭka vēṇṭumeṉṟum, piḷḷikaḷ taṉakkāka iṉṉum cila pāṭṭukaḷ taṉ vīṭṭil pāṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟum’ kēṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kēṭṭukkoṇṭapaṭiyē nāṅkaḷum ceytōm. avarkaḷ pāṭiya poḻutu nāṅkaḷ mikavum āccariyappaṭṭōm. iṉiya kuralum pattiracamāṉa poruḷum irākaṅkaḷiṉ muṟiyum kēṭka mika iṉimiyāyiruntaṉa. caṅkītattil avarkaḷ avvaḷavu aṟivuṭiyavarkaḷā yiruntataṉāl allavō piḷḷikaḷ pāṭṭil piriyappaṭṭārkaḷ?
iṉṉum cilar mutal pallaviyik kēṭṭapiṉ kīrttaṉattiṉ poruḷum irākattiṉ amitiyum kaṇṭu taṅkaḷ kaṇkaḷi mūṭic camāti niliyil niṉṟārkaḷ. vēṟu cilar āṉantak kaṇṇīr corintārkaḷ. his hiṉas makārājā avarkaḷum ‘pāṭṭu eṅkiruntu varukiṟatu. yār pāṭukiṟār’? eṉṟu vicārikka ārampittārkaḷ. capiyōr palarum arumiyāṉa pala kuṟippukaḷ perumiyāyp pēcikkoṇṭārkaḷ. caṟṟēṟak kuṟiya 500 pēr appōtu kūṭiyiruntārkaḷeṉṟu uttēcikkiṟēṉ. ivarkaḷil uṇmiyāyc caṅkītatti appiyācam paṇṇiṉavarkaḷum aṟintavarkaḷum 300 pērāvatu irukkalām. ivarkaḷālum yāvarālum pukaḻappaṭṭa kuḻantikaḷiṉ kāṉam tāṅkaḷ oruvarukku māttiram aruvaruppāyiruntataṟkuk kāraṇameṉṉa? his hiṉas makārājā makā rāṇiyavarkaḷum rāja kuṭumpattārum lakṣmi vilācattil piḷḷikaḷiṉ pāṭṭik kēṭṭapōtu ‘piḷḷikaḷiṉ pāṭṭu mika naṉṟāyiruntatu avarkaḷukku mikavum naṉṟi pārāṭṭukiṟōm’ eṉṟu piriya vacaṉam coṉṉārkaḷē. tāṅkaḷum appōtiruntīrkaḷē. taṅkaḷukkuc cariyāṉa caṅkītam kēṭṭup paḻakkamillātataṉāl ippaṭic collukiṟīrkaḷ eṉṟu eṇṇukiṟēṉ.
his hiṉas makārājā makārāṇi avarkaḷālum intiyāviṉ caṅkītattil tērnta ellā vitvāṉkaḷālum oṉṟupōl pukaḻappaṭṭa kītam uṅkaḷukku aruvaruppā yirukkiṟateṉṟu aṅkēyē colliyiruppīr kaḷāṉāl taṅkaḷiyum oru tukkaṭā pāṭac collip pukaḻntiruppēṉ. capiyār yāvarālum aruvarukkappaṭṭiruppīrkaḷ. appaṭiyāṉāl āṟu mātattiṟkup piṟaku ippaṭi pitaṟṟamāṭṭīrkaḷ. taṅkaḷ apacuramuḷḷa ārmōṉiyam uṅkaḷ kātik keṭuttu viṭṭatu eṉṟu nāṉ niccayam colvēṉ. in nōy tīra kīlayāttil tila muṇṭō? aintu jūrikaḷ alla 300kku mēṟpaṭṭavarkaḷ ‘ām’ eṉṟu colvati oruvar māṟṟic colla eṉṉa ātāramirukkiṟatu? itu aṉiyāyattilum aṉiyāyam aṟiyāmiyilum aṟiyāmiyē.
karnāṭaka caṅkīta muṟikkum intustāṉ muṟikkum cila pētaṅkaḷ uṇL. ivikaḷ iraṇṭum vevvēṟāyirāmal iraṇṭum oṉṟu cērntu oru kīrttaṉatti aḻaku paṭutta vēṇṭumeṉpatu eṉṉuṭiya mukkiya nōkkam. ivviraṇṭum vevvēṟāka niṉippavarkaḷ kūṭa tiruptiyaṭiyak kūṭiyatāyirukkumāṉāl tāṅkaḷ māttiram taṉittu niṉṟāl ivviraṇṭi lum taṅkaḷukkuc ciṟitum kēḷvi yilliyeṉṟē colla vēṇṭiyatā yirukkiṟatu.
piḷḷikaḷ pāṭiya kīrttaṉam curuti muṟikaḷukku rucuveṉṟu taṅkaḷi nāṉ collac coṉṉēṉā? allatu capiyāriyāvatu colla vēṇṭumeṉṟu kēṭṭuk koṇṭēṉā? teṉṉāṭṭiṉ tamiḻmakkaḷ pāṭi varum caṅkītatti vaṭa nāṭṭil intustāṉ caṅkītam pāṭuvōr oppuk koḷḷuvārkaḷā? oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu vātāṭum vaṭanāṭṭil 96 nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu coṉṉāl aṟintu koḷvārkaḷā? ākiyiṉāl evvitamāṉa muṭivum (recalūṣaṉum) colla nāṉ niṉikkavilli.
‘oru stāyiyi 24 curutikaḷāka vakuttu atil iraṇṭu alaku kuṟittu 22 eṉṟu kaṇakkuc coṉṉa pūrva tamiḻ nūliṉ karuttaṟiyāmal oru stāyiyil 22 eṉṟu maṟṟavarkaḷ tavaṟutalāyc collukiṟārkaḷ. nāṉ intat taṭavi viyācam vācittuk kāṭṭa muṭiyātu. avviṭattuk kāṉpareṉsiṉ naṭavaṭikkiyip pārttuk koṇṭu aṭutta kāṉpa reṉsil vācikkiṟēṉ’ eṉṟu tivāṉcākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷukku Mr. V.N.Bhatkandi B.A.,B.L. avarkaḷukkum kaṭitam eḻutiyum nāṉ vara vēṇṭumeṉṟum curutikaḷip paṟṟic colliyē tīravēṇṭumeṉṟum vaṟpuṟuttik kēṭṭuk koṇṭatiṉāl curutikaḷip paṟṟi eḻuti varum eṉṉuṭiya puttakam muṭintum muṭiyāmalumirukkiyil eṉ vēlikaḷi ellām pōṭṭuviṭṭu pala kaṣṭaṅkaḷiyum mēṟkoṇṭu aṅku vantēṉ.
iṭattukku nāṉ putitāyiruntataṉālum tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ mēlāṉa caṅkīta ñāṉam avviṭattiṟkup putitāyirukkumāṉatiṉālum nāṉ atikamāka eṉ vārttikaḷic celavaḻikkavilli. āṉālum aṅku vantirunta aṟivāḷikaḷ āḻntu kavaṉikkumpaṭi cila ariya viṣayaṅkaḷip puttakamāka accaṭittuk koṭuttum curukkamāy 31/2 maṇi nēram viyākkiyāṉam ceytum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. āyappāli, vaṭṭappāli, tirikōṇappāli, caturappāli eṉṉum nālu pāliyāka taṅkaḷ kāṉatti vakuttu 12,000 irākaṅkaḷ pāṭi vanta tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ muṟiyil nālu aṭṭavaṇikaḷil taṟkālattil vaḻaṅkum 67 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ eḻuti ataṉpaṭiyē capiyiṉ muṉ rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭiṉēṉ. innālu aṭṭavaṇikaḷil tāṅkaḷ piramātamākac collum 5, 6 irākaṅkaḷit tēṭip piṭittu ataṉpaṭi pāṭippārttāl taṅkaḷip piṭitta apacura ñāṉam uṭaṉē nīṅkiviṭum. taṅkaḷ colli nampit taliyāṭṭal koṇṭavarkaḷum kavaṉittāl niccaya puttiyuṇṭākiviṭum. taṅkaḷukkut terinta cila irākaṅkaḷil nuṭpa curaṅkaḷ varuvatu pōl iṉṉum ērāḷamāṉa irākaṅkaḷil ciṟu curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu tāṅkaḷ kaṇṭu koḷvīrkaḷ. kirakacuram māṟṟuvataṉāl mūṉṟu curutikaḷ kiṭittaṉa eṉṟu coṉṉatupōl ataṟku eṉṉa kāraṇam colluvīrkaḷ?
‘capiyil yārukkāvatu āṣēpamiruntāl collaṭṭum. iṉṉum teḷivākac collak kūṭiyavikaḷic collukiṟēṉ. kēṭkiṟavarkaḷ taṉittu vantālum collat tayārāyirukkiṟēṉ’ eṉṟum, kaṇita viṣayamāka 2/3, 3/4 ākak kaṇṭupiṭittuk koṇṭu pōkum curaṅkaḷ caṅkītattiṟkuc cariyāṉa aḷavit tarātu eṉṟum pala niyāyaṅkaḷ colli, Geometrical Progression paṭiyē cariyāṉa curaṅkaḷ kiṭikkum kaṇitam kāṭṭi, ‘āṣēpaṉiyirukkumāṉāl colla vēṇṭu’meṉṟum capiyōrip pārttuk kēṭṭukkoṇṭēṉē. kēṭṭukkoṇṭa iṭattil maṟuttu oruvarum kēṭka villiyē eṉṟu varuttappaṭṭēṉ. kēṭṭiruntāl, oru maṇi nēramalla iraṇṭu mūṉṟu maṇi nēramāṉālum eṭuttuk koṇṭa curuti viṣayattip pūraṇamāy aṟintu koḷḷumpaṭi collat tayārā yiruntēṉ.
tāṅkaḷ nālām nāḷ naḻuvalāyc collōṭu collāyc coṉṉa iraṇṭu kuṟippukaḷukku iraṇṭu nimiṣamtāṉ patil collak kiṭittatu. āṉāl 3/4 maṇi nēram collumpaṭi viṭṭuviṭṭārkaḷ. cāppāṭṭukku vaḻakkamāyp pōkum nērattip pārkkilum atika nēram ākiviṭṭatu. appōtum ‘tāṅkaḷ ētāvatu āṣēpaṉi colvatāyiruntāl colla vēṇṭu’ meṉṟu kēṭṭapoḻutu collātiruntīrkaḷ. colliyiruppīr kaḷāṉāl tēvāl avarkaḷiṉ tavaṟutalāṉa kaṇakkiyum at tavaṟutalil cellum taṅkaḷuṭiya kaṇakkiyum eṭuttukkāṭṭi ammuṟippaṭi vīṇi yil curuti stāṉaṅkaḷik kāṭṭit taṅkaḷ muṟi tavaṟutaleṉṟu oppuk koḷḷumpaṭi ceytiruppēṉ. nāṉ taṅkaḷiṭattil perumi pārāṭṭuvatāka niṉiyātirukka mikavum vaṇakkamāyk kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
uṇmi yirukkumāṉāl nāṉ ēṉ vāy tiṟantu collakkūṭātu? pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷākap pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta nuṭpamāṉa curutimuṟi ivvaḷavu kālamum aṟintu koḷḷak kūṭāmal pōyiṟṟē yeṉṟu varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ. uḷḷapaṭi maṟṟavarkaḷ ati aṟintu koḷḷa vēṇṭiya pirayattaṉam eṭuttuk koḷḷāmal pōṉāl nāṉ eṉ tēcattiṟkum eṉ jaṉaṅkaḷukkum eṉ pāṣikkum turōkiyāvēṉ. nāṉ pūrvattil illātavikaḷic collukiṟēṉ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ eṇṇā tirukkumpaṭi kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ. curuti viṣayamāka muṟṟilum ārāyntu pārkkāmal avaravarkaḷ taṅkaḷ taṅkaḷukkuk kiṭitta cila curutikaḷik kaṇṭupiṭittatākak koṇṭu vantu viṭṭārkaḷ. iru kuruṭaṉukkuk kāṭṭiya kokkuppōl kēṭāy muṭintatu.
oru kuruṭaṉukku oru piḷḷi piṟantatu. atu pāl puriyēṟi iṟantu viṭṭatu. tukkam vicārikka vanta oruvaṉiṭattil pāl eppaṭiyirukkum aṇṇā eṉṟu kuruṭaṉ kēṭṭāṉ. avaṉ kokkup pōl irukkum eṉṟāṉ. pakkattilirunta vēṟoruvaṉik kokku eppaṭiyirukku meṉṟu kēṭṭāṉ. avaṉ muḻaṅkiyiyum muṉṉaṅkiyiyum kokkuppōl vaḷittuk kuruṭaṉ kiyi ataṉ mēl vittut taṭavip pārkkac colli, ‘kokku ippaṭittāṉ irukkum’ eṉṟāṉ. kuruṭaṉ uṭaṉē taṉ taṭiyi eṭuttuk koṇṭupōyk kokkup pōl oru kiyi maṭakkik kāṭṭik koṇṭu ‘intap periya kokki eppaṭi piḷḷikkuk koṭuttāy’ eṉṟu taṉ peṇcātiyi aṭittāṉ. avaḷ kūkkuraliṭṭāḷ. itupōl taṅkaḷuṭiya 25 curutiyum irukkiṟatē.
mirāj paṭṭaṇattu Mr.Krishnaji Mahadev Gokhaleavarkaḷ 22 curutikku mēṟpaṭṭu nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ varum 83 irākaṅkaḷip pāṭik kāṭṭiṉārka ḷeṉṟu coṉṉa tāṅkaḷ irupattintu māttiram ēṉ eṭuttuk koṇṭīrkaḷ? caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭiya apippirāyattiṉpaṭi irupattiraṇṭi yum taḷḷi ³ Mr.Krishnaji Mahadev Gokhale caṅkīta vitvāṉuṭaya apippirāyatti yum taḷḷi naṭuvil irupattintu eṉṟa kokkik koṇṭu vantāl eṅkaḷāl oppukkoḷḷa muṭiyavilliyē. nāṅkaḷ kaṣṭappaṭumpaṭi ceyvatu intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ iṉṉaviyeṉṟu aṟiyāta taṅkaḷ kavaṉak kuṟivēyoḻiya vēṟalla. taṅkaḷip pōṉṟavarkaḷ rucu veṉṟu colliviṭṭāl karnāṭaka caṅkītattil pāṇṭittiya muḷḷavarkaḷ oppuk koḷvārkaḷō. karnāṭaka caṅkītattil pāṇṭittiya muṭiyavarkaḷuṅkūṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟu kutarkkam colvārkaḷāṉāl tāṅkaḷ collak kēṭpāṉēṉ.
taṅkaḷip pōl 1000 kiḷameṉṭs turikaḷi oṉṟāyccērttu urukki vārttatupōṉṟavarum piḷḷikaḷukkup paṭittuk koṭukkiṟavaru mākiya makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavataravarkaḷ 67 kīrttaṉikaḷilum oru piḻikūṭa kaṇṭupiṭikka muṭiyāmal eppaṭiyāvatu oṉṟil oru kuṟi colla vēṇṭum eṉṟu tīrmāṉittu, ‘taṉṉiyāciyil varum kāntārattip piḷḷikaḷ kūṭṭip paṭikkiṟārkaḷ. atu 22 curutiyiṉpaṭi kuṟintu varavēṇṭiyatu’ eṉṟu piṭilil vācittuk kōkaraṇam, kajakaraṇam ellām ceytārkaḷ. makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi makā vittiyanāta aiyaruṭiya cīṭaril oruvarum karnāṭaka caṅkītattil tērntavarumāṉa paḻamāṟaṉēri makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cāmināta aiyar avarkaḷum ataṟku ottup pāṭiṉārkaḷ. appōtu niṣātam kūṭutalāka varuvati vīṇiyil kāṭṭa, oppuk koṇṭārkaḷ. niṣātam pōlavē, ‘kāntāramumkūṭa varavēṇṭum. illiyāṉāl ataṟku ca-pa- oṟṟumi yilli’ yeṉṟu nāṉ coṉṉēṉ. appōtu micūr viṇīka vitvāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷum maṟṟa vitvāṉkaḷum ‘kāntāram kūṭa varāmal pōṉāl atu taṉṉiyāciyāka māṭṭātu. piḷḷikaḷ pāṭuvatu cariyāyirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu tīrmāṉittārkaḷ. karnāṭaka nāṭṭil nuṭpamāyk kavaṉikkiṟatu pōla vaṭanāṭṭil atik kavaṉikkavilli eṉṟu nāṉ varuttappaṭavumilli. piṟar ataṉ arumiyit terintu koḷḷavilli eṉṟu kuṟicollavumilli. curutiyip paṟṟiya aṟiyāmiyum kutarkkamum nīṅkic cariyāṉa aṟivu varum kālattil ataṉ arumiyi aṟivārkaḷ.
16. “tāṅkaḷ stāyiyic caripākamāka vakuppatippaṟṟi eṉ apip pirāyattic collukiṟēṉ. intiya caṅkītamāṉatu ippōtutāṉ tivviyamāṉa pataviyilirukkiṟatu.”
stāyiyic caripākamāka nāṉ vakuppatippaṟṟi evvaḷavu tāṅkaḷ parikācam ceyya vēṇṭumō avvaḷavu parikācam ceyya cila kuṟippukaḷ collukiṟīrkaḷ. attaṉi parikācamum taṅkaḷukkē collappaṭṭavi yeṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟiyātirukkiṟīrkaḷ. intiya caṅkītamāṉatu ippōtutāṉ tivviyamāṉa pataviyilirukkiṟatu eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. taṅkaḷ muṟip paṭiyē atu taḷḷappaṭṭatē. piṉ yār muṟipṭi tivviyamāṉa niliyi lirukkiṟatu?
17. “ca-pa eṉṟa oṟṟumi ātāramākak koṇṭa enta caṅkīta muṟiyum muṟṟilum cariyāṉa oṟṟumiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷālāṉatāyirukka vēṇṭum.”
ca-pa muṟiyi ātāramākak koṇṭa enta caṅkīta muṟiyum muṟṟilum cariyāṉa oṟṟumiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷālāṉatāyirukka vēṇṭu meṉṟu oppukkoḷḷukiṟīrkaḷ. ivvuttama apippirāyatti nāṉ mikavum oppukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. ca-pa muṟiyil oru stāyiyil paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ kiṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟa pūrvatamiḻ muṟiyiyē iṅkē collukiṟīrkaḷ. ca-pa muṟiyil curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭippataṟku 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa muṟi cariyāṉataṉṟu. curañāṉattiṉāl kaṇṭu piṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ icit tamiḻ nūlil teḷivāyc colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ.
ēṟṟiya kuraliṉi yeṉṟiru narampiṉ - oppak kēṭkum uṇarviṉaṉāki
ammuṟi Geometrical Progression paṭi curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷum varavēṇṭu meṉṟu vaṟpuṟuttic collukiṟatāka irukkiṟatu.
immuṟiyil pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ toṭṭa curattiṟku ēḻāvatu ēḻāva tākavum aintāvatu aintāvatākavum oru rāciyil 12 curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭittu.
varaṉmuṟi maruṅkiṉ aintiṉum ēḻiṉum-uḻimuta lākavum uḻiyī ṟākavum
kuraṉmuta lākavum kuralī ṟākavum
ovvoru curattilum ca-pa, ca-ma muṟiyāy ovvoru alakum ataṟkuk kuṟintu varukiṟa nuṭpa curaṅkaḷum ca-pa, ca-ma muṟiyil porunti varavēṇṭumeṉṟu ulakattār oruvarum aṟintu koḷḷāta tivviya pataviyic colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. ‘eṉ muṟiyē intiya caṅkītattiṟku tivviyamāṉa pataviyit tantatu’ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ tīrkkataricaṉam collukiṟatu pōlirukkiṟatu.
oru stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷum 24 curutikaḷum maṟṟum nuṭpa curutikaḷum Geometrical Progression paṭi tantiyiṉ enta aḷavil varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu kaṇṭu avaṟṟiṉpaṭi meṭṭukaḷ vittu aṉu pōkattilirukkum irākattip pāṭikkāṭṭiyapōtu ‘caṅkītattiṟkup putiya ulakam tōṉṟi irukkiṟatu, iṉimēl curutikaḷi vicārikka vēṇṭiya avaciyamilli, ivi pōtum, Mr. tēvāl Mr. kiḷameṇṭs avarkaḷ curuti muṟi pātāḷattiṟkut taḷḷappaṭṭatu’ eṉṟu kūṭiyirunta kaṉavāṉkaḷum, aṟivāḷikaḷum collit taṅkaḷukkuḷḷa cantōṣattik kāṭṭiṉārkaḷē. atittāṉō tāṅkaḷ tīrkkataricaṉamākac collukiṟīrkaḷ? allatu yāvarālum takunta pariṣiyiṇ mēl aṉupavattiṟku ottuvara villi eṉṟu aruvaruttut taḷḷiya ārmōṉiyam tivviyapatattit tantateṉṟu maṉacāṭcikku virōtamāyc collukiṟīrkaḷō?
ēṉeṉṟāl eṉṉuṭiya muṟi ca-pa vi ātāramākak koṇṭatu. muṟṟilum cariyāṉa oṟṟumiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷālāṉatu. taṅkaḷ muṟiyō muṟṟilum caṅkītattiṟku ottu varāta curaṅkaḷuṭiyatu. 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa piṉṉa eṇkaḷiṉāl perukkik koṇṭupōy oru iṭattil taliyit taṭṭiyum maṟṟoru iṭattil kāli veṭṭiyum carippaṭuttiyatu. ivikaḷip paṟṟik karuṇāmirta cākaram iraṇṭām pākattil pōtumāṉapaṭi colli yirukkiṟēṉ.
18. “ātikālattil cāstirikaḷukku cutta oṟṟumiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷ aviḻkkappaṭakkūṭāta oru muṭiccuppōl iruntatu. tantiyiṉ aḷavāl curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu aṟinta piṟaku tāṉ cariyāṉa vaḻi avarkaḷukkut terintatu.”
āti kālattu cāstirikaḷukku cutta oṟṟumiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷ aviḻkkappaṭāta muṭiccup pōliruntaṉa. avarkaḷāl aviḻkkak kūṭā tirunta muṭiccit tāṅkaḷ aviḻttu  viṭṭīrkaḷ. tantiyiṉ aḷavāl kaṇṭupiṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu aṟinta piṟakutāṉ cariyāṉa vaḻi avarkaḷukkut terintatu eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. kātiṉāl ca-pa viṉ oṟṟumiyi aṟintukoḷḷa vēṇṭiyirukka maṭṭap palakiyiṉāl 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟu tantiyil aḷantu pōvatu vanta piṟakutāṉinta viparītaṅkaḷellām uṇṭāyiṉa. āṉāl iti meccik koḷḷukiṟīrkaḷ. Pythagoras eṉpavarāl itu ēṟpaṭṭatu. ataṟku muṟpaṭṭa tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ caṅkīta muṟiyi nīṅkaḷ kavaṉippīrkaḷāṉāl 2/3, 3/4 muṟiyākac curaṅkaḷik kaṇṭupiṭippatu cutta aṟiyāmi eṉṟu colluvīrkaḷ.
ōciyi aḷappatu kātō, maṭṭappalakiyō? oruvaṉi maṭṭap palakiyiṉāl aḷantu iṉṉa uyaramuḷḷavaṉeṉṟum tarācil niṟuttu ittaṉi eṭiyuḷḷavaṉeṉṟum colliviṭalām. avaṉukkuḷ maṟin tirukkum jīvacaktiyiyum uttama eṇṇaṅkaḷiyum aḷappatu etaṉāl muṭiyum? aṉupōkattiṉālum maṉatiṉālum māttiram kaṇṭu koḷḷalām. eṭiyiṉāl vili tīrmāṉikkappaṭum vayirattiṟkum kuṇattiṉāl vili matikkappaṭāta rattiṉattiṟkum oppāṉa curutiyi maṭṭappalaki aṟiyumā? curañāṉattil tērntavaṉē ca-pa viṉ oṟṟumiyi aṟivāṉ. ca-pa viṉ oṟṟumiyi aṟinta piṉ pa vi ca vāka vittuk koṇṭu ataṉ mēl pa aṟivāṉ. immuṟiyil oru stāyiyi irācivaṭṭamākap pirittu ēḻāvatu ēḻāvatāka varum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭittirukkiṟārkaḷ. ati aṟiya muṭiyātavarkaḷ oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟum 25 curutikaḷ eṉṟum 53 curutikaḷ eṉṟum curutikaḷ aṉantam eṉṟum pitaṟṟuvārkaḷē yoḻiya uṇmiyik kāṇamāṭṭārkaḷ.
19. “āṉāl ippaṭic curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭippatu kaṣṭameṉṟu terintum anta cāstiri etaṟkum payantāṉō? illi, pōy viḻuntu tāṭi oru muṟiyik kaṇṭupiṭittāṉ. appērppaṭṭa cāstirikaḷ intiyāvilum kirēkka tēcattilum oruvēḷi ekiptu, ācīriyā, cīṉā tēcaṅkaḷilum kiḷampi cāstirōktamillāta oru caṅkīta muṟiyi ēṟpaṭutti ellā skēlkaḷum stāyiyi camapākaṅkaḷākap pirippatiṉāl ēṟpaṭukiṟavikaḷ eṉṟu collic cātittārkaḷ. ellā cāstirikaḷum ivvita muṟiyiyē uṇṭākkiṉārkaḷ. oru cāṇ allatu oru muḻattik koṭukkappaṭṭa aḷavāka niṉippatu pōl ellā iṭiveḷikaḷukkum potuvāṉa oru cama aḷavu irukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu niṉittārkaḷ. intap potuvāṉa cama aḷavu curaṅkaḷukkuḷḷa atinuṭpamāṉa ciṟu vittiyācantāṉ. iti ātāramāka vittuk koṇṭu taṅkaḷ kālattiluḷḷa vitvāṉkaḷāl upayōkikkappaṭṭa iṭiveḷikaḷukku veku vicittiramāṉa vitamāyum veku cāmarttiyamāṉa vitamāyum appaṭi ettaṉi nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷ irukkum eṉṟu kaṇṭu piṭittārkaḷ.”
ippaṭi ca-pa, ca-ma muṟiyi aṟintu koḷḷāta cāstirikaḷ aṉu pōkattilirukkum caṅkītattil eṉṉa eṉṉa curam curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu nitāṉittu ārāyntu pārkkāmal tamakku etirppaṭṭa vaḻiyellām ōṭi vāykku vanta tellām uḷaṟi puttimāṉkaḷip pōl curuti muṟi eṉṟu pustakam eḻuta ārampittārkaḷ. ētō taṅkaḷukkuk kiṭitta cila nūlkaḷip pārttu avaṟṟiṉ irakaciyam viḷaṅkāmiyāl muṉṉum piṉṉumāyc collit tūṣittārkaḷ. oru stāyiyi camapākamākap pirikka vēṇṭum eṉpatu oruvarukkum teriyāta irakaciyampōl eṇṇik koṇṭu oru ēṇiyit tiṣṭāntam coṉṉārkaḷ. ēṇiyiṉ paḻukkaḷit tiṣṭāntamākac colliyum oru cāṇil oru viraṟkaṭiyiyum oru muḻattil mūṉṟu viraṟkaṭiyiyum kūṭakkuṟittu vittuk koṇṭāl pātakamilli eṉpatu pōlac curamum curutikaḷum muṉpiṉṉāy varalā meṉṟu kaṇakkuk koṭuttārkaḷ. ippaṭippaṭṭa aḷavukaḷiṉāl namatu kāṉamirukkiṟa teṉṟu vāyc camarttākap piracaṅkittum viyācam eḻutiyum intiyāvil periya vitvāṉkaḷeṉṟu koṇṭāṭumpaṭi cila nāḷ kaḻittārkaḷ. taṅkaḷ muṟippaṭi ārmōṉiyam ceytu parōṭāvil kūṭiya āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉsil akappaṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ. ārmōṉiyattilirukkum curaṅkaḷ ca-pa muṟiyāy oṟṟumi yuḷḷavi yeṉṟum cama iṭiveḷikaḷuṭiyavi yeṉṟum cātittārkaḷ. āṉāl cama iṭiveḷikaḷuṭiyatāy taṟkālattil aṉupōkattilirukkum curaṅ kaḷukkuk kuṟintu varukiṟa teṉṟu kaṇṭārkaḷ. kuṟintu varukiṟa teṉṟu capimuṉ oppuk koḷḷum nalla eṇṇam vantālum āṟu mātam ākiṟataṟkuḷ vantuviṭṭatu aiyā paḻiya kutarkkam vantuviṭṭatu. capiyi luḷḷa yāvarālum āṣēpikkappaṭāmalirunta teṉṉintiya curuti muṟi yik kōṇal eṉṟu colla ārampittu viṭṭārkaḷ. Equal Temperament eṉṟu ēḷaṉam ceytārkaḷ. ‘etaṟkum payappaṭāmal aṅkumiṅkumāy viḻuntu cāṭi oru muṟiyik kaṇṭupiṭittāṉ’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. ‘ip pērppaṭṭa payittiyakkāraṉ intiyāvilum kiḷampi cāstirōktamillāta oru caṅkīta muṟiyi ēṟpaṭuttiṉāṉ’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. paritāpam! paritāpam!!
aṉpuḷḷa turiyē! pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ eḻuti vitta icittamiḻ nūli ārāycci ceyyappōtumāṉa nūlkaḷ eṉakkuk kiṭikkāmal pōṉālum, mutal nūṟṟāṇṭil iḷaṅ kōvaṭikaḷ eḻutiya cilappatikāram eṉṟa iyal ici nāṭakameṉṉum muttamiḻic collum nūlālum ataṟkup pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉuḷḷa nūlkaḷil aṅkaṅkē collappaṭum cila pākkaḷālum caṅkītam tamiḻ nāṭṭil taṟkālattavar aṟintu koḷḷa muṭiyāta avvaḷavu tērcciyuṭiyatāyiruntateṉṟu nāṉ kaṇṭu ataṉpaṭi taṟkālam aṉupōkamirukkiṟatā eṉṟu pūraṇamāyp paricōtittu kāṉpareṉs muṉ coṉṉēṉēyoḻiya taṅkaḷippōl vāykku vantavikaḷi yellām colli viṭavilli. tāṅkaḷ cāmarttiyamāy eḻutiya kaṭitatti uṟṟu nōkkum puttimāṉkaḷ eṉṉip paṟṟiyum nāṉ koṇṭu vanta curuti muṟiyip paṟṟiyum accuruti muṟikaḷ coṉṉa intiyāviṉ makāṉkaḷip paṟṟiyum eṉṉa niṉippārkaḷ? intak kaṭitatti evvaḷavu yōcaṉiyāy eḻuti yirukkiṟīrkaḷ. iṉṉum eṉṉeṉṉa viparītaṅkaḷ eḻutappōkiṟīrkaḷō eṉṟu nāṉ payappaṭavilli. nāṉ eḻutiya maṟuppil taṅkaḷip paṟṟic collum kuṟikaḷi nivirttippati viṭṭuviṭṭuk kāṭumēṭāyp pitaṟṟu kiṟīrkaḷ.
20. “Aristoxenus eṉṟa kirēkka vitvāṉiyum maṟṟa āti cāstirikaḷi yum uṅkaḷuṭiya tamiḻ cāstirikaḷiyum viṭa paratarum avarip piṉpaṟṟiṉavarākiya cāraṅka tēvarum uyarnta pīṭastāṉattil vikkap paṭṭataṟkuk kāraṇa meṉṉaveṉṟāl avarkaḷ collukiṟa 13, 9, 4, 3, 2, 1 mutaliya curutikaḷukku irukkappaṭṭa campantamum avarkaḷ upayōkikkum 2/3, 4/5, 9/5, 10/9, 16/15, 81/80 mutaliya Harmonic iṭiveḷikaḷumē.”
kirēkka vitvāṉkaḷiyum maṟṟa tēcattu āti cāstirikaḷiyum uṅkaḷuṭiya tamiḻ cāstirikaḷiyumviṭa paratarum, cāraṅkatēvarum uyarnta pīṭastāṉattilirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. ā! ā! itu mikavum naṉṟāyirukkiṟatu. ettaṉi nāḷikku niṟkum.
ivvuṇmiyi uḷḷapaṭi aṟintu koḷvīrkaḷāṉāl caṅkītattil curuti viṣayamākat tāṅkaḷ niṉittirukkum tappāṉa apippirāyam muṟṟilum nīṅkum eṉṟu niṉikkiṟēṉ. ēṉeṉṟāl paratarum cāraṅka tēvarum coṉṉa 22 curutikaḷiyum 13, 9, 4, 3, 2, 1 eṉṟa curutikaḷiyum avikaḷukku irukkappaṭṭa 2/3, 4/5, 8/9, 10/9, 16/15, 81/80 mutaliya ārmāṉik iṭiveḷikaḷiṉ oṟṟumi eṉkiṟīrkaḷ. inta mūṉṟum oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu campantamillāmalum taṟkālam aṉupōkattiṟku varāmalu mirukkiṟavi yeṉṟu taṅkaḷukkut teriyavilli. terintiruntāl tāṅkaḷ ippaṭic colla māṭṭīrkaḷ. camayampōl pētikaḷukku etiyāvatu collik kāriyam cātittuk koḷkiṟateṉpati aṟivāḷikaḷ kaṇṭāl aruvarup pārkaḷē.
tāṅkaḷ ‘paratarum, cāraṅkatēvarum uyarnta pīṭattil vikkappaṭṭiruk kiṟārkaḷ’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. āṉāl avvuyarnta pīṭam 22 aṭi uyarntatākavum atil vīṟṟirukkum paratariyum cāraṅkatēvariyum kīḻē taḷḷuvatum, paḻiyapaṭi 25 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷa kayiṟṟil uruvu curukkup pōṭṭuk kaḻuttil māṭṭi mēlē tūkkivippatum, avarkaḷukkuc campanta millāta intustāṉ caṅkītam eṉṉum pātāḷattil avarkaḷit takutiyā yirukkum eṉṟu taḷḷuvatum, pārkkap paritāpamāyirukkiṟatu. ivi uṇmiyō allavō eṉṟu aṟivāḷikaḷ vicārippārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ Introduction to the study of Indian Music eṉṟa puttakattil eḻutiyirukkum cila kuṟippukaḷē iti naṉku viḷakkukiṉṟaṉa.
Introduction to the study of Indian Music Page.5.
The ancient believed that if the octave were divided into twenty two roughly equal parts all the notes in use could be obtined. They called these small intervals “Srutis” and spoke of intervals of two Srutis three Sruits and four Srutis and of rising or lowering a note by one Sruti or more. They believed that all the “Shuddh” and Vikrit notes had Srutis to themselves. The author concludes, from a study of Bharata’s Natya Shastra and the Sangit Ratnakar of Sarangdev that their system in reality involved the use of 25 notes to the octave and not 22 as they imagined (Sec appendix E.)
oru stāyiyāṉatu ēṟakkuṟiya 22 camapākaṅkaḷākap pirikkappaṭṭāl avaṟṟiluḷḷa ellā curaṅkaḷum akappaṭṭuppōkum eṉṟu pūrvattār nampiṉārkaḷ. intac ciṟiya iṭiveḷikaḷukku avarkaḷ curutikaḷ eṉṟu peyariṭṭārkaḷ. mēlum iraṇṭu curuti iṭiveḷikaḷ mūṉṟu allatu nālu curuti iṭiveḷikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟum oru cuvarattik kūṭṭiyāvatu kuṟittāvatu piṭikkalāmeṉṟum coṉṉārkaḷ. cutta curaṅkaḷum vikruti curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷālāṉavi eṉṟum nampiṉārkaḷ. inta nūli eḻutiṉavar parata nāṭṭiya cāstirattiyum cāraṅkatēvaruṭiya caṅkīta ratṉākarattiyum ārāynta piṟaku colvateṉṉaveṉṟāl ‘avar kaḷuṭiya muṟiyāṉatu stāyiyil avarkaḷ niyamattiṉpaṭi 22 alla 25 curaṅkaḷ uḷḷatāyirukka vēṇṭum’ eṉpatē.
mēṟkaṇṭa kuṟippil ‘oru stāyiyil 22 cama pākaṅkaḷāṉa curutikaḷākap pirikkalām eṉṟum ellāc curaṅkaḷum atil vantuviṭu meṉṟum nampiṉārkaḷeṉṟum oru curattik kūṭṭiyāvatu kuṟittāvatu piṭikkalām eṉṟum cutta curaṅkaḷum vikruti curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷālāṉa viyeṉṟu nampiṉārkaḷeṉṟum collukiṟīrkaḷ. ‘nampiṉārkaḷ, niṉittārkaḷ’ eṉṟu collum vārtti avvaḷavu uṟutiyāṉaviyalla. cāraṅkatēvar eṭuttukkoṇṭa curattiliruntu paṭippaṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu teḷivākac collukiṟār. appaṭiyirukka parata nāṭṭiya cāstirattiyum cāraṅka tēvaruṭiya caṅkīta ratṉākarattiyum naṉṟāy ārāyntu pārtta piṉ oru stāyiyil 22 alla 25 curutikaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. ‘koṭṭik koṭṭi aḷantālum kuṟuṇi patakkākumā?’ oru stāyiyil 22 curuti uṇṭeṉṟu coṉṉa cāraṅkar kirakam māṟṟumpoḻutu 4, 3, 2, 4, 4, 3, 2 eṉṟu coṉṉār. caṭcamattiṉ 4 curutikaḷil iraṇṭu curutikaḷ taḷḷikkoṇṭu kirakam māṟṟiṉāl iraṇṭu curutiyuḷḷa niṣātamum kāntāramum riṣapa tivatattil layatti yaṭikiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu coṉṉārē. ivikaḷ cama aḷavuṭiyaviyā yillāmaṟ pōṉāl eppaṭi layattiyaṭiyum? caṟṟēṟakkuṟiya 12, 4, 10, 3, 14, 3, 12, 3, 12, 5, 4, 13, 5, 19, 18, 6, 16, 5, 15, 6, 5, 18, 4, 24 pōṉṟa vittiyācamirukkum viparēṣaṉkaḷit taṅkaḷ puttakam 7-vatu pakkattilum eṭṭāvatu pakkattilum collukiṟīrkaḷ. oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu ivvaḷavu vittiyācamāṉa aḷavukaḷuḷḷa curaṅkaḷ eppaṭik kirakamāṟṟavarum? caṭcamattil mūṉṟu curuti kuṟittuk koṇṭupōka mūṉṟu curutiyuḷḷa riṣapa tivataṅkaḷ caṭcama pañcamattil layattiyaṭikiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu colliyirukkiṟārē. tāṅkaḷ collum oḻuṅkaṟṟa varici eṅkē layattiyaṭikiṟatu? atu layatti aṭiyumpaṭiyāṉa iṭam taṅkaḷ pustakattiṉāl teriyavilli. inta oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa curuti varicikaḷ intustāṉ caṅkītattiṟkuriyaviyeṉṟu muṭi cūṭṭap pārkkiṟīrkaḷ. ataṉ palaṉi iṉimēl aṟivīrkaḷ.

Dr.kumāracāmi avarkaḷi nāṉ nēril aṟivēṉ. avarkaḷ ilaṅkiyilum teṉṉintiyāvilum pala taṭavi cuṟṟup pirayāṇam ceytu mukkiyamāṉa tamiḻ nāṭukaḷil vēṇṭiya kālam taṅkiyiruntu intiyāviṉ kinē yacavaḷakaḷi veku cirattiyuṭaṉ kavaṉittiruntatiṉāl teṉ tamiḻnāṭṭu caṅkītam ciṟantateṉṟum mika nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷuṭiyateṉṟum aṟintiruntārkaḷeṉṟu nāṉ pirattiyaṭcamāy aṟivēṉ. eṉ vīṭṭiṟkum vantu curutikaḷip paṟṟi vicārittup pōṉārkaḷ. appaṭippaṭṭavarkaḷ taṅkaḷ oḻuṅkaṟṟa curuti muṟiyāṉatu uṇmiyāṉa caṅkītattik keṭukkak kūṭiyateṉṟu aṟintē ippaṭic coṉṉār.
tāṅkaḷ iṉṉum koñcam vicārittāl caṅkīta ratṉākarattil 25 curutikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu colvataṟku iṭamēyilliyeṉṟum taṅkaḷ karuttiṟku icintavāṟu kirakam māṟṟumpoḻutu mūṉṟu kirāmaṅkaḷilum mūṉṟu curutikaḷ kiṭittaṉaveṉṟu kaṇṭukoḷvīrkaḷ. ippaṭi oru nāḷum uṇṭākakkūṭiyatalla. pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ kirakam māṟṟic collum muṟiyil marutam, kuṟiñci, neytal, pāli eṉṟu nālu yāḻ vakikaḷ collukiṟārkaḷ. avikaḷē caṭcakirāmam, mattimakirāmam, pañcamakirāmam, tārakkirāmam allatu kāntārakirāmam. inta nālu kirāmaṅkaḷilum varum alaku muṟiyum colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ.

Introduction to the study of Indian Music Page 54.
Verse 47 :- When Ni take the first Sruti of Sa, it is Kaishik; and when it take two, it is Kakali. These are the two Vikrits of Ni
Such are the twelve Vikrits. The total of Shuddh and Vikrit Svara as is nineteen.
Note :- The above classification of Vikrits is inexact and confused. It was probably in vogue among musicians, and Sarangdev took it as he found it. Out of the twelve Vikrits; seven, namely. Chyut Sa, Ma. And Pa, antara and Sadharan Ga, Kaishik and Kakali Ni are new, the rest are old Svaras with new names.
