caṭcamam kiṭippatāl oṉṟāyirunta tantiyiṉ nīḷam ataṉ pāti aḷavu variyilum eppaṭip paṭippaṭiyāy 12 curattiṟkuk kuṟintu pōkiṟateṉṟu kaṇṭu piṭippatiṉāl vīṇittantiyiṉ enta aḷavil 12 curaṅkaḷum varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu kaṇakkuc ceytirukkiṟēṉ. oru stāyi yil varum 12 curaṅkaḷukku 122 eṉṟum 24 curutikaḷukku 242 eṉṟum 48, 96 pōṉṟa nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷukku 482, 962 eṉṟum kaṇakkuc ceytiruk kiṟēṉ. avikaḷukkuḷḷa oṟṟumikaḷiyum, oḻuṅkupaṭṭirukkum muṟi yiyum karuṇāmirta cākaram 64 ām pakka mutal 89 ām pakkam variyum colliyirukkiṟēṉ. nāṉ parōṭāvukkuk koṇṭupōṉa iraṇṭāvatu viyācattil ikkaṇakkippaṟṟi viparamāyc colli yirukkiṟēṉ. apputtakam taṅkaḷukku nālu aintu nāḷ muṉṉatākavē koṭukkap paṭṭirukkiṟatu. tāṅkaḷ akkaṇakkukaḷi caritāṉāveṉṟu pārkkiṟatōṭu ataṟkeṉṟu nāṉ tayār ceytirukkum vīṇiyil amittirukkum meṭṭukaḷ kaṇakkil kaṇṭapaṭi aḷavil ottirukkiṉṟaṉa vāveṉṟu paricōtaṉi ceytu collavum vēṇṭumeṉṟu taṅkaḷi mikavum kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ curutiyip paṟṟic collum karuttiṟkiṇaṅka ikkaṇita muṟi ceytirukkiṟēṉ. immuṟi takutiyāṉatōveṉṟum, kaṇakkuc caritāṉāveṉṟum kaṇakkil kaṇṭa aḷaviṉpaṭi vīṇiyil amittirukkum curastāṉaṅkaḷ caritāṉāveṉṟum tāṅkaḷ paricōtikkiṟa taṟku utaviyāka cila kuṟippukaḷ ittuṭaṉ koṭuttirukkiṟēṉ. tāṅkaḷ avikaḷi iṉṟu muḻuvatum ārāyntu pārttu taṅkaḷ muṭivāṉa apip pirāyatti nāḷik kāliyil piraciṭeṇṭ avarkaḷukkut terivikkum paṭiyāka mika vaṇakkamāyk kēṭṭukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ” eṉṟu kaṇita pañcāyat tārukku mikat teḷivāka eṭutturittu cila kuṟippukaḷaṭaṅkiya aṭṭavaṇi yum koṭuttārkaḷ.
II.kaṇita nūl vallōr curam curutikaḷukku varum kaṇita muṟiyil ārāycci ceytu colvataṟku vēṇṭiya cila kuṟippukaḷ.
1. mantara stāyiyil ōci oṉṟāṉāl mattiya stāyi ataṉ irumaṭaṅkākavum, tāra stāyi mattiya stāyiyiṉ irumaṭaṅkākavum pōka vēṇṭumeṉkiṟa apippirāyattiṉpaṭiyē tantiyiṉ aḷavil stāyi pōkap pōkak kuṟukiya aḷavuṭiyatāy varukiṟatu eṉpatic cōtittup pārttal.
2. oṉṟāyirunta ātāra caṭcamam (atāvatu kural) iraṇṭāṉa mattiya stāyi caṭcamattiṟkup paṭippaṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal eppaṭip paṉṉiraṇṭu stāṉaṅkaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu ilākiruta (ṭuṭipayacivāa) mūlamāka varum kaṇakkip pārttal.
3. oru stāyiyil 24 curutiḷāka varuvataṟkuk kaṇakkup pārttal.
4. 48 ākavum, 96 ākavum varum nuṭpa curutikaḷukku iraṇṭil lākirutam mūlamākak kaṇakkup pārttal.
5. mēṟpaṭi kaṇakkiṉāl kiṭikkum tantiyiṉ nīḷattiṟkuriya aḷaviṉ paṭiyē vīṇiyil curaṅkaḷ varukiṉṟaṉavā eṉṟu paricōtittal.
6. ca-pa- 2/3, ma 3/4 eṉṉu muṟiyiṉāl cariyāṉa curaṅkaḷ kiṭikka māṭṭāteṉṟa kaṇakkip paricōtittal.
mu. āpirakām paṇṭitar.

ataṉpiṉ caṅkīta pañcāyattārip pārttup piṉ varumāṟu pēciṉārkaḷ.
“kaṉavāṉkaḷē! intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curutikaḷ eṉṟu palar palavitamāyk kaṇakku coṉṉālum cilar intustāṉi caṅkītattiṟ kuriyateṉṟum, cilar āriya caṅkītattiṟkuriyateṉṟum, cilar iṅkilīṣ caṅkītattiṟkuriyateṉṟum colvatiṉāl avikaḷippaṟṟi iṅku nāṉ colla varavilli.curutikaḷip paṟṟi cāraṅkatēvar colvatu namatu karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṟku ottatāyirukkavilli. atōṭu ammuṟippaṭi oru kīrttaṉaṅkūṭa vaṭanāṭṭilāvatu teṉṉāṭṭilāvatu pāṭikkēṭkavu milli. itippaṟṟi vātippōrkaḷē caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ muṟiyi stāpittuk koḷḷa vēṇṭiyatu. ammuṟikaḷip paṟṟi nāṉ oṉṟum collap piriyappaṭavilli. ēṉeṉṟāl nām ippōtu karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curutikaḷi vicārikka vantirukkiṟōm. itaṉmuṉ āṟu kāṉpareṉsukaḷāka nām vicārittumirukkiṟōm.
caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟu coṉṉatit tavira 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟu coṉṉa evarum oruvarukkoruvar oṟṟumiyāṉa muṟikaḷic coṉṉatilli. avvoṟṟumiyillāta muṟikaḷic colli nāṉ poḻutupōkkuvatilum, karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṟkeṉṟu curuti muṟikaḷic collum pūrvatamiḻmakkaḷiṉ oru mēlāṉa muṟiyi iṅkē collavum, ammuṟippaṭit taṟkālam pāṭappaṭum kīta muṟikaḷik koṇṭu meyppikkavum vēṇṭumeṉṟu niṉittēṉ. ik kālattil pūrṇamāy arttamākāmal pōṉa tamiḻ moḻikaḷuḷḷa cilappatikārattiṉ mēṟkōḷkaḷi viḷakkik kāṭṭavum, appūrva karuttiṉpaṭi curutikaḷ kuṟikkum kaṇakkuk kāṭṭavum, akkaṇakkiṉpaṭi vīṇi aḷavil kiṭikkum curaṅkaḷ caritāṉāveṉṟu aṉupōkatti lirukkum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ mūlamāyp pārkkavum vēṇṭiyirukkiṟatu. itaṉmuṉ iraṇṭu pañcāyattārukkum nāṉ coṉṉa apippirāyatti mikap poṟumiyākak kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntīrkaḷ. ippōtu vīṇiyil aḷaviṉpaṭi vikkappaṭṭa meṭṭukaḷil olikkum curaṅkaḷum, nuṭpa curutikaḷum taṟkālam nam aṉupōkattilirukkiṟavitāṉāveṉṟu taṅkaḷāl paricōtikkappaṭavēṇṭum. taṅkaḷ aṉupōkattilirukkum curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷum nuṭpa curutikaḷum cariyāyirukkumāṉāl pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vantavikaḷ avikaḷē yeṉṟum iṉimēl vaḻaṅki varak kūṭiyavikaḷ avikaḷtāṉ eṉṟum nām niccayikkalām. ivikaḷip paṟṟi itaṟku muṉ cila kuṟippukaḷ coṉṉatiṉāl nāṉatikam colla avaciyamilli eṉṟu eṇṇukiṟēṉ.
iṅkē taṅkaḷ muṉ vittirukkum vīṇi ituvariyum nam nāṭṭil vaḻaṅki varum vīṇiyip pōṉṟatē yoḻiya nūtaṉamāṉatalla. āṉāl itaṉ muṉ curutikaḷip paṟṟic collukiṟavarkaḷ karutti aṟintu koḷvataṟku avarkaḷ kaṇakki 32 aṅkulat tantikku māṟṟi yiruppatiṉāl 32 aṅkula nīḷamuḷḷa tanti pōṭṭu atil kaṇakkil kaṇṭa aḷaviṉpaṭi curastāṉaṅkaḷ pirittirukkiṟēṉ. itittavira nūtaṉamāṉatu itil oṉṟumilli. āṉāl oru stāyiyil 12 curastāṉaṅkaḷit tavira ariccuratti iraṇṭākap pirittu 24 curuti stāṉaṅkaḷ varumiṭat tiyum, nālākap pirittu 48 curutikaḷ varum stāṉattiyum, eṭṭākap pakuttu 96 curutikaḷ varum curuti stāṉattiyum kuṟittirukkiṟēṉ. ciṟiya veḷḷip poṭṭukaḷiṉāl aṭiyāḷam vittirukkiṟēṉ. ivikaḷil collappaṭum ōcikaḷ caritāṉā veṉṟu pāṭikkāṭṭum poḻutu kavaṉamāyk kēṭṭu muṭivu collumpaṭi vaṇakkamāyt taṅkaḷik kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ” eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ.
III. tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta curam curutikaḷ iṉṉaviyeṉṟu ici vallōr ārāyvataṟkēṟṟa cila kuṟippukaḷ.
1. icittamiḻ (caṅkīta) muṟippaṭi kural iḷiyāy ca-pa, ca-pa vāka, uḻi kuralāy ca-ma, ca-ma vāka oru stāyiyil varum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷiyum variciyāyp pāṭikkāṭṭutal.
2. oru irāci vaṭṭattil 24 alakukaḷil varum 24 curutikaḷiyum pāṭikkāṭṭutal.
3. teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷukkum curutikaḷukkum koṭukkap paṭṭirukkum nālu aṭṭavaṇikaḷiluḷḷa 67 irākaṅkaḷil virumpiya irākaṅkaḷip pāṭip paricōtittal.
4. pūrvam kiraka curam piṭittu āycciyar kuravi pāṭum muṟiyip pāṭikkāṭṭutal.
5. ēḻu curaṅkaḷiyum kiraka māṟṟuvatiluṇṭākum pūrva irākaṅkaḷiṉ peyarum, avaṟṟiṟkut taṟkālam vaḻaṅkum irākaṅkaḷiṉ peyarum.
6. mūṉṟu stāyikaḷiṉ muṟiyum, nālu kirāmaṅkaḷ, nālu jātikaḷ, pañcama mattima curutikaḷ muṟiyum iṉṉaviyeṉṟu cilappatikārattiṉāl viḷakkik kāṭṭutal.
ataṉ piṉ paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ kumārattikaḷ marakatavalli ammāḷum, kaṉakavalli ammāḷum vīṇiyil varum 12 curaṅkaḷi variciyāka vācittum, pala taṭavi vāyiṉāl colliyum kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. atil milāppūr makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi piṭil cuntaramiyar eṉpavar pañcamam koñcam kuṟikiṟateṉṟu coṉṉār. āṉāl pañcamam eppaṭi varavēṇṭum eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ colla vēṇṭumeṉap paṇṭitar avarkaḷ palataṭavi kēṭṭum colla muṭiyāmal muṉam cātittār. ēṉeṉṟāl eṭuttukkoṇṭa caṭcamatti vīṇiyil palataṭavi mīṭṭum poḻutu ataṟkup pañcamam vīṇiyilirukkum pañcamappaṭiyē nām paḻakiyiruppati aṟintum ataṟkuk kuṟittuc collat tammāl muṭiyātiruppati yaṟintum pēcāmaliruntār. āṉālum piḷḷikaḷiṉ upāttiyāyarāṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷāl tōṭi, kalyāṇi, caṅkarā paraṇam, māyāmāḷavam mutaliya irākattiṉ curaṅkaḷ pāṭumpaṭi kēṭṭu appaṭiyē paṭikkappaṭṭu piḷḷikaḷāl vīṇiyil oṉṟaṉpiṉ oṉṟāy vācikkappaṭṭum vāyiṉāṟ collappaṭṭum avikaḷil varum curaṅkaḷ yāvum cariyāṉaviyeṉṟum taṟkālam nam vaḻakkattiliruppaviyeṉṟum pañcamam cariyāyirukkiṟateṉṟum capiyōr yāvarālum aṅkīkarikkap paṭṭatu.
ataṉpiṉ oru stāyiyil varum 24 curutikaḷum piḷḷikaḷāl vāyiṉāl pāṭiyum vīṇiyil vācittum kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. capiyōr yāvarum kavaṉamāyum, āccariyamāyum kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. ataṉ piṉ 24 curuti muṟikaḷil pāṭappaṭum cāvēriyil oru alakil pāṭappaṭum riṣapa tivataṅkaḷum kikavaciyil aintāvatu alakil pāṭappaṭum mattimamum maṟṟum pavappiriyā, piyākaṭi mutaliya irākaṅkaḷum pāṭik kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.
tirikōṇappāliyil caṅkarāparaṇattil vaḻaṅki varum 41/2 āka varum riṣapa tivataṅkaḷum tōṭiyil 31/2 alakāka varum kāntāra niṣātaṅkaḷum tanniyāciyil 41/2 alakil varum kāntāra niṣātaṅkaḷum pavappiriyāvil 31/2 āka varum kāntāra niṣātaṅkaḷum 41/2 āka varum mattimamum maṟṟum itupōl caṇmukappiriyā, amcattoṉi, mōkaṉam mutaliya irākaṅkaḷum pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. (karuṇāmirta cākaram ip puttakattil 101 - 110ām pakkam vari kāṇka.)
nālāvatāṉa caturappāliyil 43/4 alakāṉa riṣapa tivataṅkaḷum ārapiyil 41/4 āṉa riṣapa tivataṅkaḷuma ceñcuruṭṭiyil 41/4 āṉa riṣapa tivataṅkaḷum mattimāvatiyil 43/4 āṉa riṣapamum maṟṟum cila irākaṅkaḷum paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.
itil tanniyāci pāṭappaṭum poḻutu kāntāra niṣātaṅkaḷip paṇṭitar avarkaḷuṭiya karuttiṟkiṇaṅka piḷḷikaḷ kūṭṭip paṭikkiṟārkaḷ. ituvēṇṭumeṉṟu ceykiṟatākat terikiṟatu’ eṉṟu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi piratāpa rāmacāmi pākavatar avarkaḷ āṣēpaṉi ceytārkaḷ. appoḻutu kuṟintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ piṭil vācittuk kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. paṇṭitar avarkaḷ ivviraṇṭu curaṅkaḷiyum nīkki maṟṟa curaṅkaḷ oru stāyiyil paṉṉiraṇṭāka varum curaṅkaḷil collappaṭukiṉṟaṉavā? avikaḷum vittiyācamāyirukkiṉṟaṉavā eṉṟu kēṭṭārkaḷ. ataṟku evarum patil collavilli. 12 curaṅkaḷil pāṭum taṅkaḷ aṉupōkatti maṟuttu vēṟu collakkūṭātavarkaḷāy inta iraṇṭu curamum 22 curutiyiṉpaṭi varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. appōtu paṇṭitar avarkaḷ vātañceyyum makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi piratāparāmacāmi pākavatar avarkaḷip pārttut ‘tāṅkaḷ parōṭāvil makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tivāṉ cākip avarkaḷ muṉṉiliyil iṉṉum iraṇṭu mātattiṟkuḷ 22 curutikaḷil paḻakic collukiṟēṉ eṉṟu coṉṉīrkaḷē! āṟu mātamāyiṟṟē? ippōtāvatu koñcam pāṭikkāṭṭuṅkaḷ’ eṉṟu kēṭṭapoḻutu perum viḻi viḻittu viṭṭup pēcāmal oru mūliyil pōy uṭkārntu koṇṭār. ataṉpiṉ capi muṉ avar pēccuk kēṭkappaṭavilli. capiyōr yāvarum mika āccariyappaṭṭārkaḷ. iṉṉum vēṇṭum kēḷvikaḷukkup patil collap paṭṭatu. kuṟitta 11 maṇikku mēl 3/4 maṇi nēram kūṭa ākiviṭṭataṉāl ellōrum cāppāṭṭiṟkup pōka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu.
maṟupaṭiyum māli mūṉṟu maṇikku capi kūṭiṟṟu. mūṉṟu maṇiyi liruntu aintu maṇi vari 24 curutikaḷiyum, atinuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷiyum vīṇi mūlamāyum - vāyppāṭṭiṉ mūlamāyum rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭuvatum ati aṟivatiṉāluṇṭākum pirayōcaṉattiṟku tiṣṭāntakamāka ituvari yum oruvarum kītamāvatu kīrttaṉamāvatu ceyyāta putiya irākaṅkaḷil putitākac ceyta kīrttaṉaṅkaḷip pāṭikkāṭṭa vēṇṭiyatum purōkirāmil kuṟitta viṣayaṅkaḷ. iccamayammakā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tivāṉ cākip avarkaḷ caṟṟup pinti varuvatākac collik koṇṭatiṉāl avarkaḷukkup patil kumpakōṇam kavarṉmeṇṭ kālēj Mathematics Professor āṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cīṉivāca pāṭrāccāriyār M.A.,L.T., avarkaḷ tivāṉ cākip avarkaḷ varum variyil akkirācaṉam vakikkumpaṭi kēṭṭukkoḷḷappaṭṭārkaḷ. capiyār yāvarālum itu aṅkīkarikkap paṭṭatu.
itaṉ naṭuvil makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tivāṉ cākip V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷum vantu viṭṭārkaḷ. appōtu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi paṇṭitar avarkaḷ capiyārip pārttuc colliyavi piṉ varumāṟu:-
“akkirācaṉātipatiyavarkaḷē! kaṉavāṉkaḷē!
24 curutikaḷ oru stāyiyil uṇṭeṉṟu colvatu taṅkaḷukkuc caṟṟu nūtaṉamāyt tōṉṟum. oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷuṇṭeṉṟu kēḷvippaṭṭirukkum namakku itu viyappāyirukkum. eppaṭiyiruntālum aṉupōkattil nām kāṇpōmāṉāl nammuṭiya cantēkaṅkaḷ yāvum nīṅki viṭum. pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ oru stāyiyi 12 ākap pirittu atil ēḻu curattil oru irākam amittup pāṭiṉārkaḷ. itu āyappāliyām. inta āyappāli muṟippaṭi varum ēḻu curaṅkaḷil ca-pa muṟiyāṉa iraṇṭu curaṅkaḷil ovvoru alaku kuṟittup pāṭiṉārkaḷ. 4, 4, 3, 2, 4, 3, 2 eṉṟu oru alaku kuṟittup pāṭum iṭattik kāṇumpaṭiyāka kirakam māṟṟi 16 jātip paṇkaḷ piṟakkum vaḻi coṉṉārkaḷ. itil mūṉṟu alakāy varum curaṅkaḷ ovvoru alaku kuṟittup pāṭa vēṇṭu meṉpatu karuttu. iraṇṭu alakāyirukkumiṭattil mūṉṟu varumāṉāl atu oru alaku kuṟintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu arttamākum. itaṉāl oru stāyiyil 22 curutiyalla 24 curutikaḷē. itu vaṭṭappāliyām.
itaṉ piṉ vaṭṭappāli muṟiyil oru alaku kuṟittup pāṭuvatu pōlavē 1/2,1/4  āṉa  curutikaḷ  kuṟittup  pāṭumpoḻutu avikaḷ tirikōṇappāli eṉṟum caturappāli eṉṟum vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟu vivaramāka kāliyil coṉṉēṉ. ataṟkiṇaṅka eṉ kumāratti kaḷik koṇṭu yāḻil vācittum, vāyiṉāl pāṭiyum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. oru stāyiyip paṉṉiraṇṭāyp piritta muṟippaṭi pōtumāṉa aḷavu cila irākaṅkaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭiṉēṉ. vaṭṭappāli muṟippaṭiyum cila irākaṅkaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭiṉēṉ. tirikōṇappāli muṟippaṭiyum, caturappāli muṟip paṭiyum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷil vaḻaṅkum tiyākarāja aiyar avarkaḷ kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ palavum pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa. āṣēpaṉi ceytavar kaḷum capiyār yāvarukkum pōtumāṉa camātāṉamum collappaṭṭatu.
ivikaḷ yāviyum kēṭṭirunta tāṅkaḷ iti vicārippatiṉāl eṉṉa pirayōjaṉameṉṟu aṟiya virumpuvīrkaḷ. ivviṣayam pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta muṟi vekukālam maṟintu pōṉatiṉimittam namakku ippōtu nūtaṉamāyt tōṉṟukiṟatu. oru pāṣiyiṉ eḻuttukkaḷum avikaḷāl eḻutappaṭṭa nūlkaḷum illāmal pōṉa piṉ eḻuttillāta pāṣi ettaṉi nāḷikku niṟkum eṉpatu pōl karnāṭaka caṅkītam varavarak kuṟintu tēcikak kalappuṇṭāki muṟi tavirntu melintu varukiṟa teṉṟu nām aṟivōm. eḻuttillāta pāṣiyippōl caṅkītamu mirukkiṟateṉṟu varuttattōṭu collavēṇṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. curutiyiṉ niccayam namakku illātapōtu ivviṣayam tiruntuvatu kūṭātakāriya meṉṟu nām aṟivōm. namatu muṉṉōrkaḷ ceytuvitta uruppaṭikaḷ tavaṟāmal maṉaṉam ceytu pēṇappaṭṭu vantatiṉimittam ivvaḷavāvatu karnāṭaka caṅkītameṉṟu peyar nilittirukkiṟatu. itaṉuṭiya irakaciyam teriyumāṉāl nāṉ ivvaḷavu tūram varuntic colvati tāṅkaḷ aṟintu koḷvīrkaḷ.
ippōtu curuti viṣayamāṉa vicāraṇiyil eṉṉa pirayōjaṉa muṇṭākumeṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟintu koḷvataṟkāka itu variyum kēṭṭirāta kīrttaṉikaḷip pāṭikkāṭṭumpaṭi ceyyap pōkiṟēṉ. tāṅkaḷ yāvarum aṟinta aḷavu karnāṭaka caṅkītattil nāṅkaḷ atikap pariccaya muṭiyavarkaḷalla. irākam pallavi pāṭuvatil tērntavarkaḷumalla. atikamāṉa kītam paṭittavarkaḷumalla. āṉāl karnāṭaka caṅkītattil tērntavarum laya cuttamāyp pāṭakkūṭiya varumāṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷāl caṟṟēṟakkuṟiya 100 kīrttaṉi vaṭittuk koṭukkappaṭṭirukkiṟatu. itōṭu iṅkē yirukkum eṉatu kumārattikaḷ marakatavalliyammāḷum, kaṉakavalliyammāḷum oru irākattil kītam eḻutum muṟiyiyum, jīvacuram kāṇum muṟiyiyum, atiliruntu kīrttaṉam eḻutum muṟiyiyum, ataṟku ettukkaṭi curam eḻutum muṟi yiyum eṉṉāl oruvāṟu terintirukkiṟārkaḷ. immuṟiyiliruntu kīrttaṉam eḻutuvatik kaṟṟukkoṇṭa marakatavalli ammāḷāl cumār 50 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ variyum ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivikaḷ ippōtu curat tuṭaṉum, tāḷattuṭaṉum accākikkoṇṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟil mutal 15 kīrttaṉikaḷaṭaṅkiya ciṟu puttakam ippōtu taṅkaḷ kiyil koṭuttirukkiṟēṉ. immuṟippaṭi nam intiya kāṉam curappaṭutti eḻutap paṭumāṉāl mikappirayōjaṉamāyirukkum. itippaṭikkiṟataṟku vēṇṭiya curañāṉamum, tāḷañāṉamum māttiram namakku vēṇṭiyatē yoḻiya vēṟu evvitamāṉa maṟippumillāmal teḷivākac ceytirukkiṟēṉ.
nām itaṉ muṉ kēṭṭirāta putiya irākaṅkaḷil ceyta kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ caritāṉā eṉṟu pārppataṟku itaṉ muṉ nām kēṭṭirunta paḻiya irākaṅkaḷil putitākac cila kīrttaṉikaḷ mātirikkāka eḻutap paṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa. caṅkītattil atika uruppaṭikaḷum irākam, pallavikaḷum atikamāyt teriyāta ivarkaḷ kaṇakkiṉāl putiya uruppaṭikaḷ ceyvārkaḷāṉāl vāyppāṭṭil tērnta vitvāṉkaḷ ceyvatu mikac culapamāyirukkum. putiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ceyvataṟku aṉukūlamākac ceytuvarum irāka vivaramaṭaṅkiya iraṇṭām puttakattil ivikaḷ yāviyum teḷivākak kāṇpōm. tāṅkaḷ yāvarum nūtaṉamāka kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ceytu pāṭuvati nāṉ kēṭka mikavum ācippaṭukiṟēṉ. eṉ conta pirayōjaṉattiṟku māttiram ceyya niṉittiruppēṉāṉāl ivikaḷi nāṉ oruvarukkum colla niṉikkamāṭṭēṉ. nīṅkaḷum ulakattavarum itaṉ irakaciyattit terintu karnāṭaka caṅkītatti mikunta cāstira muṟiyuṭiya teṉṟu oppukkoḷḷavum karnāṭaka caṅkīta muṟi ennāḷum nilittirukkavum vēṇṭumeṉpatē eṉ mukkiya nōkkam” eṉṟu teḷivāka eṭuttuc coṉṉārkaḷ.
itaṉ piṉ tivviyakāntāri, vaccirakānti, himāṅki, vivarttaṉi, āṉantatōṭi, tarmavati, mēkarañcaṉi, nākapūcaṇi eṉṟa putiya kīrttaṉikaḷum, puḷi, pūpāḷam, vacantā, mōkaṉam, amcattoṉi, paracu mutaliya paḻamiyāṉa irākaṅkaḷil ceyta putiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷum pāṭik kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.
kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ putiyavikaḷāyum iṉimiyuṭiyavikaḷāyumirunta tiṉāl capiyōr yāvarum cuvaril eḻutiṉa cittirampōl acivaṟṟuk kēṭṭukkoṇṭiruntārkaḷ. appōtu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi paṇṭitar avarkaḷ caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷip pārttup piṉvarumāṟu pēciṉārkaḷ:-
“tāṅkaḷ putiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷaṭaṅkiya puttakatti mikak kaṇṇum karuttumāyp pārttīrkaḷ. kīrttaṉikaḷil varum curaṅkaḷum, nuṭpa curaṅkaḷum, caritāṉā eṉṟu pāṭak kēṭṭīrkaḷ. piramippiṉālum āccariyat tiṉālum tāṅkaḷ oruvarāvatu kuṟi colla vāy tiṟakkavilli. immātiriyē tāṅkaḷum itaṟku mēlāṉa vitamāyk kīrttaṉikaḷic ceyyalām. appaṭic ceyvataṟkum atil nuṭpa curutikaḷil evi jīvacuramāka varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu kavaṉippataṟku muriya cila vitivakikaḷi iraṇṭām puttakamāka eḻuti varukiṟēṉ. curaṅkaḷiyum curutikaḷiyum iṉṉateṉṟu tīrmāṉikkāmal nām oṉṟum ceyyamuṭiyātu. curutikaḷ nām pāṭum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil paṉṉiraṇṭil oṉṟōṭu cērntu varum poḻutu eṉṉa eṉṉa curaṅkaḷōṭu cērntu varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu niccayam teriyāmal avikaḷiyum cērttuc curamākac collik koṇṭu varukiṟati maṟṟavar kaṇṭu ēḷaṉam ceykiṟārkaḷ. pūrva tamiḻ nāṭṭil periyavarkaḷāl kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭu ēṟpaṭuttappaṭṭa muṟi mikavum uttamamāṉatu. itippārkkilum uttamamāṉa muṟikku ulakattavar evarum vantu cēravilli. nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ iṉṉiṉṉa iṭaṅkaḷil varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟintukoḷḷumpoḻutu mikavum cantōṣap paṭuvīrkaḷ” eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ.
cāyantiram aintu maṇi mutal āṟu maṇi vari iḷippāṟṟik koḷḷum nēramāyiruntatu.
āṟu maṇi mutal eṭṭu maṇi variyum vantirunta palar pala irākaṅkaḷum, kīrttaṉaṅkaḷum pāṭiṉārkaḷ. tirunelvēli intu kālēj makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi makāliṅka aiyar avarkaḷ tēvāra tiruvācakaṅkaḷip paṇmuṟippaṭic colla vēṇṭumeṉṟu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷāl kēṭṭukkoḷḷappaṭṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷ pāṭiya paṇkaḷ mika iṉimiyākavum paktiracamāyum iruntatiṉāl ellārum acivaṟṟuk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. irāppōjaṉattiṟku nēramāṉatiṉāl puṣpa tāmpūlaṅkaḷ vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.
maṟunāḷ 20ām tēti 81/2 maṇi mutal 9 maṇi variyum vantirunta capiyōrkaḷiṉ paṭam eṭukkappaṭṭatu.
9 maṇi mutal 111/2 maṇi variyum pañcāyattār taṅkaḷ muṭivāṉa apippirāyatti piraciṭeṇṭ avarkaḷukku koṭukkavēṇṭiya nēramā yiruntatu. appōtu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi paṇṭitar avarkaḷ pañcāyattāriyum capiyōriyum pārttup piṉvarumāṟu coṉṉārkaḷ.
“capiyiṉ akkirācaṉātipatiyavarkaḷē! pañcāyattu capiyōrē! maṟṟum kaṉavāṉkaḷē!
nām pāṭikkoṇṭirukkum karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṉ curam curutikaḷip paṟṟip palar palavitamāka eḻutiyiruppataṉālum, atippaṟṟi muṭivāṉa oru apippirāyam namakku ituvari kiṭikkātataṉālum pūrva tamiḻ nūl muṟippaṭi uttamamāṉa oru muṟiyi ippōtu collavēṇṭiyatā yiṟṟu. ivikaḷippaṟṟit teḷivāy aṟintukoḷvataṟkup pōtumāṉa vitam taṅkaḷukkuc curukkamāka mūṉṟu pañcāyattārukkum nūl mukamākavum aṉupōka mūlamākavum eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉēṉ. atu tavira taṉittaṉi kēṭṭavarkaḷukkum viḷakkikkāṭṭiṉēṉ. pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta curutikaḷum nuṭpa curutikaḷum maṟṟum muṟikaḷum aṇup piramāṇamum tavaṟāmal taṟkālattil vaḻakkattilirukkiṟavi yeṉṟum, pūrvamāy vaḻaṅki vanta muṟikaḷi viḷakkic colla nūlkaḷillāmi yāl pala cantēkaṅkaḷ vantaṉa veṉṟum eṭuttuccoṉṉēṉ. piṉvarum pāṭalkaḷil varum curaṅkaḷ iṉṉaviyeṉṟu tāṅkaḷ kavaṉippīrkaḷāṉāl āyappāliyiṉ paṉṉiru curaṅkaḷē aṇuppiramāṇamum tavaṟāmal upayōkappaṭṭu vantaṉaveṉṟum, ammuṟiyē iṉṟaḷavum upayōkappaṭṭu varukiṟateṉṟum tāṅkaḷ teḷivāy aṟintu koḷvīrkaḷ” eṉṟum colli oruvar māṟṟi oruvar kirakacuram piṭittu āycciyar kuravi pāṭum muṟimiyil ‘kaṉṟu kuṇilāk kaṉiyutirtta māyavaṉ etc.,’ ‘pāmpu kayiṟāk kaṭal kaṭinta māyavaṉ etc.,’ eṉṉum iraṇṭu aṭikaḷiyum, ataṉpiṉ rikku vētattil iraṇṭu aṭikaḷiyum vīṇiyuṭaṉ piḷḷikaḷip pāṭumpaṭic ceytārkaḷ. yāvarum mikunta cantōṣattuṭaṉ kavaṉamāyk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. iṉimiyāṉa kītaṅkaḷil varum curaṅkaḷ āyap pāliyiṉ paṉṉiru curaṅkaḷil varātaviyeṉṟu oruvarum āṣēpaṉi collavilli.
appōtu paṇṭitar avarkaḷ “rikku vētattil vaḻaṅkivanta curaṅkaḷē taṟkālattilum pāṭik koṇṭirukkiṟōm. avikaḷ vekukālamāy kātiṉāl kēṭṭu nāḷatu variyum pēṇappaṭṭu nilittirukkiṟatu. appaṭiyē āycciyar kuraviyum riṣapa tivata kirāmaṅkaḷil ārampittu oruvar māṟṟi oruvar kuravi pāṭiṉārkaḷeṉṟum, ivi ca-pa muṟippaṭi yāṉa paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷil collappaṭukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum pūrva nūlkaḷ colvatōṭu taṟkālam aṉupavattālum kāṇkiṟōm. itaṟku maṟutalittu oru stāyiyil paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷit tavira vēṟuvitamākac curaṅkaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu oruvarum collamāṭṭōm. tāṅkaḷ ippōtu taṅkaḷ apippirāyatti piraciṭeṇṭ avarkaḷukku eṭuttuc colli eḻuttiṉmūlamāka koṭukka vēṇṭiya camayam. itil avaravarkaḷukku koṭukkappaṭṭa viṣayaṅkaḷic cantēkamaṟat terintu uḷḷatu uḷḷapaṭiyē muṭivāṉa apippirayāṅkaḷ colvīrkaḷeṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ. nammuṭiya apippirāyatti namatu piṉṉaṭiyārum caṅkītatti vicārikkum ulakatta varum kavaṉippārkaḷāṉatiṉāl taṅkaḷ apippirāyattiṟku vanta muṭivit terivikkumpaṭi kēṭṭukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ” eṉṟārkaḷ.
ataṉpiṉ tamiḻp pulavar pañcāyattiṉ cērmeṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cuvāmi viruti civa ñāṉayōkikaḷ caṅkītattip paṟṟic curukkamāka cila arumiyāṉa vacaṉaṅkaḷ colli taṅkaḷ apippirāyattiyum vācittu piraciṭeṇṭ avarkaḷukku rippōrṭ koṭuttārkaḷ. avi aṭiyil varumāṟu :-
tañci caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkam, ēḻāvatu kāṉpareṉsukku akkirācaṉātipatiyāyirunta parōṭā tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷukku tamiḻnūl vallōr pañcāyattiṉ piraciṭeṇṭ eḻutikkoṇṭa rippōrṭ.
tamiḻp pulavar pañcāyattil māṭci poruntiya rāja rājēcuvara cētupati makārājā avarkaḷ avit talivarāyum,
cuvāmi viruti civañāṉa yōkikaḷ amiccarāyum, pirammasrī R.irākaviyaṅkār mutal 14 peyar uṟuppiṉarāyumiruntaṉar. amiccarākiya eṉṉōṭu 15 peyarukkuc cilappatikāram, taṇṭiyalaṅkāram, tolkāppiyam, paripāṭal eṉṟa nūlkaḷil tamiḻicip paṟṟik kūṟappaṭṭiruppavikaḷip pārviyiṭṭuc collumpaṭi 48 kēḷvikaḷaṭaṅkiya acciṭṭa kēḷvit tāḷkaḷ koṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. akkēḷvittāḷkaḷ ivvuṟuppiṉarkkum, palvēṟu pulavarkkum oru vāra muṉṉarē aṉuppappaṭṭuḷatāyum terikiṟēṉ. akkēḷvikaḷil ikkēḷvip poruḷ iṉṉa nūl ip pakkattil ivviv varikaḷiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉaveṉat teḷivāṉa kuṟippukaḷ koṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. maṟunāḷ kūṭum aviyil viṭi yeḻutit taravēṇṭumeṉṟu uṟuppiṉaraṟivikkappaṭṭaṉar. kēḷvikaḷ kēṭkappaṭṭa 4 nūlkaḷum vēṇṭiya pañcāyattuṟuppiṉarkkuk koṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. paṇṭitar avarkaḷ 12 curaṅkaḷiyum, 24 curutikaḷiyum, nāṉku pālikaḷiyum naṉku viḷakkum cakkaraṅkaḷik kāṭṭi viḷaṅkap piracaṅkittārkaḷ.
tamiḻ nūlvallōr pañcāyattu.
akkirācaṉātipati māṭcimi poruntiya rāja rājēcuvara cētupati makārājā avarkaḷ.
1. amiccar cuvāmi viruti civañāṉayōkikaḷ.
pañcāyattuṟuppiṉar,
2. makāḷa-rāca-rāca-ciṟi R.irākaviyaṅkāravarkaḷ, cētu camastāṉam, tamiḻ vitvāṉ.
3.	”	S.S.pārati M.A., B.L., tūttukkuṭi.
4.	”	L.ulakanāta piḷḷiyavarkaḷ, tañcāvūr.

7.	”	vēṅkaṭacāmi nāṭṭāravarkaḷ, naṭukkāvēri.
8.	”	ṭākṭar caṇmukam piḷḷiyavarkaḷ, māyūram.
9.	”	cēturāma pāratiyār avarkaḷ, tañcāvūr.

vi. civañāṉayōki.
1916௵ 20² ākasṭu௴ kūṭiya avikkup pañcāyattut talivar māṭci cētupati maṉṉavaravarkaḷ varāmiyāl attalimiyi ēṟṟu naṭattumpaṭi amiccar vēṇṭappaṭṭut talimipūṇṭu muṭivuri kūṟi viṭikaḷiyum kāṉpareṉcut talivarkaḷiṭaṅkoṭuttaṉar.
cuvāmi viruti civañāṉayōkikaḷiṉ muṭivuri.
intat tamiḻnāṭu mikap paḻamiyāṉatu. māṇikkavācaka cuvāmikaḷ “pāṇṭi nāṭē paḻampati” eṉṟikkarutti viḷakkiyuḷār. ippoḻutu intu mākkaṭaluṇ mūḻkiyirukkum nilamākiya tamiḻakamē ulakil makkaḷ mutaliṟṟōṉṟiya viṭameṉṟu āṅkila nūlāciriyarākiya purōpacar ākkal (Prof.Haekel) um, makkaḷ nūl (Science of man) um iṉṉum pala āṅkila āciriyaruṅ kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. muṟkālattil kumari mutal āppirikkāviṉ kīḻkkari vari nilapparappāyiruntatu. intukkaṭal iruntatilli. atu nilamāyiruntatu eṉṟu pala āṅkilāciriyar kūṟiyirukkiṉṟaṉar. iṟiyaṉār akapporuḷ uriyil nakkīrar kūṟiyataṟkiṇaṅka kumarikkum - paḵṟuḷiyāṟṟukkum iṭiyil 700 kātam (7000 mil) nilapparappup parantu nīṇṭu kiṭantatu; atu tamiḻakameṉappaṭum. ataṉ teṉpakutiyilirunta teṉmaturiyil mutaṟ caṅkamiruntatu. atu iṟṟikkuc caṟṟēṟakkuṟiya 12000 āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉṟuvakki 4440 āṇṭu atil tiripurameritta viricaṭikkaṭavuḷum kuṉṟameṟinta kumaravēḷum, akattiyaṉār, vaṉmīkaṉār mārkkaṇṭaṉār, kutamaṉār mutaliya muṉivarum pulavarāy vīṟṟiruntaṉar. avar tamiḻiliyaṟṟiya nūlkaḷ irukku, yacur, cāmam pōṉṟa taliyāya vētaṅkaḷeṉṟum nacciṉārkkiṉiyar tolkāppiyavuriyiṟ kūṟiyiruk kiṉṟaṉar. akattiya muṉivar 12000 cūttiraṅkaḷuḷḷa akattiyam eṉṟa oru nūliyaṟṟiṉar. atil iyalici nāṭakam eṉṉum muttamiḻiṉ iyalpukaḷum viḷakkappaṭṭaṉa. accaṅkattil kaṭavuḷi vaṇaṅkataṟkup paṇkaḷōṭukūṭiya eṇṇiṟanta paripāṭalkaḷum tōṉṟiṉa. avikaḷum taliyāya vētattuṭ cārntaṉavē. avi akkāla mutal paṇṇōṭu ālayaṅkaḷiṟ pāṭappaṭṭu vantaṉa. avaṟṟuṭ cila viṉṟumirukkiṉṟaṉa. mutaṟ caṅkamirunta teṉ maturiyum iṭiccaṅkamirunta kavāṭapuramum kaṭal koḷḷappaṭṭoḻiyavē avaṟṟukku vatilāka tēvāram, tiruvācakam, tiruvicippā mutaliya tōṉṟi itukāṟum ālayavaḻipāṭṭil paṇṇōṭōtappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. civālayap piramōṟcavakālattil tikkuppaliyil tamiḻppaṇkaḷi yōta ākamam vitippatāl avvaṇṇamē naṭantu varukiṟatu. nārata parivirājakōpa niṣattil, “carvākamamayaciva:” ellā ākamavaṭivaṉ civaṉ eṉṟum civākamattiṟ kūṟappaṭuvatē ñāṉam eṉṟum pukaḻappaṭukiṟa civākamaṅkaḷē tamiḻ maṟikaḷip paṇṇōṭu pūjākālaṅkaḷil ōta vitippatāl tamiḻicikaḷ 12000 āṇṭukaḷukku neṭunāḷ muṉṉart tuvakki ōtappeṟṟu varum paḻamiyuṭiyaṉa veṉpatu teḷivām.
taliccaṅkattil akattiyantavirap peruṅkuruku, perunāri mutaliya ici nūlkaḷum iṭi kaṭiccaṅkaṅkaḷil ici nuṇukkam, ciṟṟici, pērici mutaliya nūlkaḷum iruntu iṟantaṉa. ippoḻutu icimarapu eṉṟa nūloṉṟirukkiṉṟatu. āṉāl muḻumiyumilli. kiṭitta pāṭṭukaḷil irupattiṉāṉku kēḷvikaḷ teḷivāyk kūṟappaṭṭiruppati nāṉē pārttirukkiṟēṉ. tiruvaṉ paṇṭitaravarkaḷ iciyippaṟṟi ārāynta nūl cilappatikāram; atu iciyik kūṟavanta nūlalla. āṉāl annūlil araṅkēṟṟukāti, vēṉiṟkāti, āycciyarkuravi eṉṟa pakutikaḷil āṅkāṅku icipaṟṟik kūṟappaṭum uriyiṟ kaṇṭavaṟṟi oruṅkutiraṭṭi nōkkit tamiḻici nūl uṇmikaḷiyaṟintu karuṇāmirta cākaram eṉṟa nūli yiyaṟṟiyirukkiṉṟaṉar. ippañcāyattiṟ kēṭkappaṭṭa 48 kēḷvi kaḷiṉ karuttellām curukki nōkkil 7 icikaḷum āya mutaliya 4 pālikaḷum avaṟṟiṟ payaṉpaṭum kēḷvikaḷum (curutikaḷum) cilappatikāram mutaliya 4 nūlkaḷiṟ kūṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉavā eṉpatē.
ivaṇ, “kuraṉ mutalēḻum” eṉṟatāl ēḻu ici (curaṅkaḷ) kūṟap paṭṭaṉa. iṭapa mutal 12 rāci vīṭṭil ca-pa vukku ovvoru vīṭum ri, ka, ma, ta, ni kaḷukku iraṇṭiraṇṭu vīṭukaḷum pakuttatu āyappāli. atu “ēttu miṭapa malavaṉuṭaṉ cīyaṅ-kōṟṟaṉuk kumpamoṭu mīṉamivi-pārttuk-kuraṉ mutaṟ ṟāra miṟuvāyk kiṭanta-niralēḻuñ cempāli nēr.” eṉpatu mutaliya vaṟṟāl viḷaṅkukiṉṟatu. ātalāl āyappālikku 12 ici.
12 vīṭṭiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷi (ca-pa muṟiyāy) paṉṉiru kāṟṟirikkap paṉṉiru pāliyum piṟakkum“ eṉṟamiyāl vaṭṭappāliyil 12 rāci vīṭṭiluḷḷa tirittaṟkētuvāṉa vīṭu tōṟum 2 alaku āka 24 alakukaḷ (kēḷvikaḷ) kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa.
ivvaṭṭapāliyil uḷḷa 24 kēḷvikaḷil 4 yāḻkaḷum, 4 vakic cātip paṇkaḷum pāṭumpoḻutu 2 kēḷvikaḷ kuṟittu 22 kēḷvikaḷ pāṭa vēṇṭum. aṅṅaṉam pāṭutal kalimali vamitiyēyaṉṟi vaḻuvaṉ ṟeṉṟu taṇṭiyalaṅkāram kalimalivamiti utāraṇattil,
		“kūṭam viravik kuṟinilattā ṉattiyaṉṟa
		pāṭa lamutam parukiṉāḷ”
eṉṟu kūṟi kuṟinilattāṉat tiyaṉṟataṉip pāṭalamutam eṉṟatu kalimalivāyiṉum puṉinturiyātaliṟ poruntuvatāyiṟṟu eṉṟuri yil viḷakkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. 7 curaṅkaḷil 2 curuti kuṟittamikkum poḻutu,
		“kuraṟutta nāṉku kiḷimūṉ ṟiraṇṭāṅ
		kuṟiyā puḻiyiḷi nāṉku-viriyā
		viḷariyeṉiṉ mūṉṟiraṇṭu tārameṉac coṉṉār
		kaḷaricēr kaṇṇuṟ ṟavar”
eṉṟa veṇpāvāl, kural mutal tāram vari muṟiyē 4, 4, 3, 2, 4, 3, 2 eṉṟu kikkiḷi viḷarikaḷil ovvoru kēḷvi kuṟikkil kuralē iḷi yākiya marutayāḻ ākiṟatu. itiṉiṉṟu,
		“kuraliḷiyiṟ pākatti vāṅkiyō roṉṟu
		variyātu tārat tuḻikkum-viriviṉṟi
		yettum viḷari kiḷikkīkka vēntiḻiyāy
		tuttaṅ kuralākuñ col.”
eṉṟu valamuṟi yiṭamuṟiyāka 12 pālikaḷum, 4 yāḻkaḷum, 4 cātikaḷum piṟakkiṉṟaṉa.
iṉi “nālvakic cātip perumpaṇkaḷ viḷinilam peṟa valivu melivu camameṉṉum mūvakiyiyakku muṟimiyilē ārāyntu pāṭip piṉṉar māttiri kuṟintatiṟ paṇṇippāṭu mēlvikkaṇ appaṇṇi iṉitākappāṭi” eṉṟa uriyāl, atiṉum nuṭpamākiya 48 pakutikaḷākiya tirikōṇappāli, atiṉum nuṭpamākiya 96 pakutikaḷākiya caturap pālip paṇkaḷum kuṟikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
		“āyañ caturan tirikōṇam vaṭṭameṉap
		pāya nāṉkum pāli yākum”
eṉṉappaṭum 4 pālikaḷum cilappatikārattiṟ kūṟappaṭṭaṉavē.
oru nilikkuk kēḷvikaḷ 24 eṉṟu teḷivāyk kūṟum icimarapu
		“āyattuk kīrā ṟaṟuṉāṉku vaṭṭattuk
		kēyuṅkō ṇattuk kiraṭṭipput-tūyavici
		nuṇmik katiliraṭṭi nōṉalaku mōrnilikkiṅ
		keṇmūṉṟu kēḷvikoṇ ṭeṇ.”
eṉṉum veṇpāvāl naṉku viḷaṅkukiṉṟatu. (ici nuṇmi-nuṇ pāli-caturappāli.)
mēṟkūṟip pōntavaṟṟāl oru stāyiyil (niliyil) āyap pālikkuriya 12 curaṅkaḷ ca-pa muṟiyāyum ca-ma muṟiyāyum kiṭikkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum vaṭṭappāliyil oru stāyi 24 curutikaḷākap pirikkappaṭṭu atil 2 curuti kuṟittu 16 cātip paṇkaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷ eṉṟum avaṟṟiṉum kuṟinta nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷōṭu tirikōṇappāli caturappālikaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷeṉṟum paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kuṟitta 48 viṉākkaḷā lum teḷivāy viḷaṅkukiṉṟatu.
vi. civañāṉa yōki.
ataṉpiṉ kaṇita pañcāyattiṉ cērmeṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi T.K.vēmpu aiyar avarkaḷ kaṇitattip paṟṟic cila vārttikaḷ colli piṉ varum rippōrṭṭik koṭuttārkaḷ.

Mr.paṇṭitaravarkaḷiṉ curutik kaṇakkukaḷum, aḷavukaḷum piṉ collap pōkiṟa mūṉṟu viṣayaṅkaḷi ātāramāka vittukkoṇṭu ceyyap paṭṭiruppatāka nāṅkaḷ kāṇkiṟōm.
(1) oru stāyiyil curaṅkaḷ eppaṭi amikkappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa veṉṟāl, entac curattilāvatu oru rākatti ārampittu yātāmoru oḻuṅkuṭaṉ ārōkaṇam ceyyum paṭcattil irākam eppōtum māṟāmal naṉṟāka irukkiṟatu.
(2) oru stāyiyiṉ curaṅkaḷ 12, allatu 24, allatu 48, allatu 96 tāṉ.
(3) taṟkālam karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curaṅkaḷukkum mēṟcoṉṉa curaṅkaḷukkum yātoru vittiyācamumilli.
Mr.cuppiramaṇiyac cāstirikaḷ tuvāvimcati curuti koḷkikkārar. avar muṉ coṉṉa mūṉṟu viṣayaṅkaḷum muṟṟilum tappeṉṟu apip pirāyappaṭṭār.
āṉāl maṟṟa āṟumemparkaḷum muṉcoṉṉa mūṉṟu viṣayaṅkaḷi yum cariyeṉṟu ātāramāka vittukkoṇṭu, paṇṭitaravarkaḷ oru stāyi yiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷiṉ vipirēṣaṉ Geometrical Progression paṭi mēlēṟic collavēṇṭiyateṉṟum, avikaḷukkuḷḷa kāmaṉ rēṣiyōvāṉatu 122 eṉṟu 12 curaṅkaḷukkum, 242 eṉṟu 24 curaṅkaḷukkum, 48 eṉṟu 48 curuti kaḷukkum 962 eṉṟu 96 curutikaḷukkumāy irukka vēṇṭiyateṉṟum colvatāṉatu muṟṟilum cariyeṉṟu oppuk koṇṭārkaḷ.
tantiyiṉ nīḷam atikamāka āka atiṉ vipirēṣaṉkaḷ oḻuṅkāy paṅku īṭṭukku ēṟkak kuṟikiṟateṉkiṟa viṣayam muṟṟilum cari. vipi rēṣaṉ kaṇakkukaḷum, tantiyiṉ aḷavukaḷum, curastāṉaṅkaḷ ēṟpaṭum iṭaṅkaḷum, maṟṟak kaṇakkukaḷum, tacāmca piṉṉaṅkaḷum ēḻu iṭam vari muṟṟilum cariyāyirukkiṟatākak kāṇkiṟōm.
mēlum, koṭukkappaṭṭa vīṇiyiluḷḷa tantiyiṉ aḷavukaḷum, avi kaḷukkuriya curastāṉaṅkaḷum Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ pustakattil koṭukkap paṭṭirukkum aḷavukku muṟṟilum ottirukkiṉṟaṉa. koṇṭu vantirukkap paṭṭa vīṇiyil vācikkappaṭappōkiṟa rākaṅkaḷum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷum caritāṉā eṉṟu kēṭṭuc colvatu caṅkītan terinta vitvāṉkaḷuṭiya kaṭami.
Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷuṭiya apippirāyattiṉpaṭi mattimattiṟkum, pañca mattiṟkum curastāṉaṅkaḷ muṟiyē .7491, .6674 eṉṟu varukiṉṟaṉa. ivikaḷ ēṟakkuṟiya muṟiyē 3/4, 2/3kkum cariyākiṉṟaṉa. āṉāl vitti yācam .001kkuk kuṟintē varukiṟatu. ākiyāl 32 aṅkulam nīḷamuḷḷa tantiyil inta vittiyācamāṉatu muṟiyē .027 aṅkulamum, .024 aṅkulamum ākum.
kāṉpareṉciṉ iraṇṭāvatu tiṉattil makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pāṭrāccāri yār avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi R.nārāyaṇacāmi aiyaravarkaḷum Rev.J.B ñāṉa oḷivu avarkaḷum ājarākavilli. ākiyāl muṉcoṉṉa ripōrṭ āṉatu kāṉpareṉciṉ piraciṭeṇṭavarkaḷukku eṉṉāl koṭukkap paṭṭatu.
T.K.VEMBU IYER.
Secretary.
caṅkīta pañcāyattāriṉ piraciṭeṇṭākiya makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cuyaṭi Rao Bahadur. V.A. vāṇṭiyār avarkaḷ aṭiyil varum rippōrṭṭip piraciṭeṇṭ avarkaḷukkuk koṭuttārkaḷ.
tañci caṅkīta vittiyā makājaṉa caṅkam.
ēḻāvatu kāṉpareṉs, 1916௵ākasṭu௴19,20 ²tētikaḷ
mūṉṟāvatu pañcāyattu.
pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki vanta curam curuti mutaliyavikaḷi vicārikka ēṟpaṭṭa capkamiṭṭiyiṉ rippōrṭL.
inta capkamiṭṭiyic cērnta mukkiya aṅkattiṉarākiya makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi A.G.piccamuttu avarkaḷ B.A.,L.T., cāmiyāpiḷḷiyavarkaḷ, viyiccēri appācāmi aiyaravarkaḷ, tirunelvēli intu kālēj makāliṅka aiyaravarkaḷ, harikēcavanallūr muttiyā pākavataravarkaḷ, tañci vīṇi vēṅkaṭācalamiyar avarkaḷ, vijayanakaram vīṇi vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās avarkaḷ, tañci pañcāpakēca pākavataravarkaḷ, tivāṉ V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ mutaliya kaṉavāṉkaḷ inta vivakāratti muṉṉamē naṉṟāy ārāyntu pārttu 24 curuti nuṭpa curutikaḷ ivikaḷiṉ uṇmiyi paṇṭitaravarkaḷiṉ rucukkaḷ mūlamāy nērē aṟintavarkaḷ. maṟṟavarkaḷukku ēṟkaṉavē iraṇṭu vārattukku muṉ accaṭittu cila kēḷvikaḷ maṟu moḻikkākak koṭukkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ākiyāl capkamiṭṭi memparkaḷil anēkar antak kēḷvikaḷukku maṟumoḻikaḷit tayārceytu koṇṭu vantiruntārkaḷ.
ārampattil Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ itu viṣayamāy vekunēram mika virivākap piracaṅkam ceytu cilappatikāram mutaliya ātittamiḻ nūlkaḷiṉ mūlamāyum cakkaraṅkaḷ aṭṭavaṇikaḷ mūlamāyum oru stāyiyil 7 mukkiya curaṅkaḷ uṇṭeṉṟum, āyappāliyil 12 curaṅkaḷ, vaṭṭap pāliyil 24 kāl curaṅkaḷ, tirikōṇappāliyil 48 arikkāl curaṅkaḷ, caturappāliyil 96 vīcam curaṅkaḷ uṇṭeṉṟum pēciṉārkaḷ. mēlum kirakam māṟṟuvatil uṇṭākum ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉiṉṟu piṟakkum cempāli, paṭumalippāli, cevvaḻippāli, arumpāli, kōṭippāli, viḷarip pāli, mēṟcempāliyākiya ivikaḷē taṟkālam vaḻaṅkum tīracaṅkarā paraṇam, karakarappiriyā, aṉumattōṭi, kaliyāṇi, arikāmpōti, naṭapiravi, cutta tōṭi eṉṉum irākaṅkaḷ eṉṟum eṭuttuk kāṇpittārkaḷ.
itu muṭintavuṭaṉ, inta apippirāyaṅkaḷi vīṇiyiṉ mūlamāyum, vāyppāṭṭiṉālum paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷākiya turipāṇṭiyaṉ marakatavalliyammāḷum, navamaṇi kaṉakavalliyammāḷum rucuppaṭutta ārampittārkaḷ. appōtu milāppūr P.A.cuntaram aiyar eṉpavar vīṇi yil toṉikkum ca-pa caṟṟu kuṟikiṟatu eṉṟār. avariyē collik kāṭṭak kēṭṭapōtu tāmatittār. piṟaku aṉucuraṅkaḷip piṭittuk kāṭṭiṉapōtu ca-pa pūraṇamāyiruntatu. makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatarkaḷum caṅkarāparaṇam, tōṭi, kaliyāṇi mutaliya irākaṅkaḷiṉ ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇaṅkaḷippāṭip paricōtittapōtu curaṅkaḷ cariyā yiruntatākak kāṇappaṭṭu capiyārāl aṅkīkarikkappaṭṭatu.
piṟaku paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷiyum, 24 kāl curaṅkaḷiyum vīṇiyōṭum, vīṇiyiṉ utaviyillāmalum varici yāyp pāṭik kāṇpittārkaḷ. capiyōriṉ āccariyamum cantōṣamum ivvaḷavu avvaḷavu eṉṟu collamuṭiyātu. piṟaku avarkaḷ anēka kīrttaṉaṅkaḷip pāṭik karnāṭaka caṅkītattil nālu pālikaḷil varum 24, 48, 96 mutaliya nuṭpa curaṅkaḷi antanta curaṅkaḷ ēṟpaṭum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ mūlamāy rucuppaṭuttik kāṇpittārkaḷ.
Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷuṭiya nūlākiya karuṇāmirta cākarattil collap paṭṭirukkiṟa aḷavukaḷ kaṇakkup pirakāram stāyiyiṉ 12 curaṅkaḷuḷ oṉṟākiya ātāra caṭjattiliruntu iraṇṭākiya tāra caṭjam vari paṭip paṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal uyarntu cellukiṉṟaṉa eṉṟu terikiṟatu. itaṟkēṟpa intac camayattiṟ keṉṟu tayār ceyyappaṭṭirunta vīṇiyil paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ tanta meṭṭukaḷi vēṇṭiya aḷavukkut taḷḷi vittup paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷukkum naṭuvil uṇṭākum nuṭpa curaṅkaḷākiya 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 mutaliya curutikaḷic camayattiṟkēṟṟa vitamāyp pāṭik kāṇpittārkaḷ. avikaḷi meṭṭukaḷillāmal kamakamākap piṭittum kāṇpittārkaḷ.
avarkaḷ tanniyāciyil ōr kīrttaṉam paṭittapōtu Mr. piratāpa rāmacāmi pākavatar kāntāram caṟṟuk kūṭi varukiṟateṉṟum atu caṟṟuk kuṟintirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟum coṉṉārkaḷ. appōtu                           Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ inta kāntāra niṣātaṅkaḷit tavira maṟṟa curutikaḷ 12 curaṅkaḷic cērntavikaḷ eṉṟu oppukkoḷḷukiṟīrkaḷā?” eṉṟu kēṭṭataṟku, avarkaḷ maṟu vārtti colla muṭiyavilli. piṟaku Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ Mr. piratāpa rāmasvāmi pākavatarip pārttu “tuvāvimcati curutippirakāram 2 mātattiṟkuḷ oru tukkaṭā pāṭuvatāka parōṭā kāṉpa reṉcil vākkuk koṭuttīrkaḷē atit tāṅkaḷ ippōtu pāṭikkāṭṭa vēṇṭum” eṉṟu kēṭṭataṟku avar oṉṟum patil urikkavilli.
mattiyāṉa mīṟṟiṅkil paṇṭitaravarkaḷ curutikaḷi aṟintiruppatiṉ vicēṣattip paṟṟi maṟupaṭiyum pēciṉārkaḷ. ati rucuppaṭuttuvataṟ keṉṟu srīmati marakatavalliyammāḷ putitāy uṇṭākkiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil 15 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷip paṇṭitaravarkaḷ aṉumatippaṭi pāṭik kāṇpittārkaḷ. avikaḷil āyappāliyiṉ curaṅkaḷum, vaṭṭappāli, tirikōṇappāli, caturappāli ivikaḷil varum ati nuṭpa curaṅkaḷum taṉittaṉiyē kāṭṭap paṭṭaṉa. putu irākaṅkaḷil kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ uṇṭupaṇṇum vitam vittuvāṉ kaḷukkut teriyāta kāriyamākiyāl capiyōr ivikaḷik kēṭṭavuṭaṉ piramittup pōṉārkaḷ. intak kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil oru picakāvatu oruvarālum kaṇṭupiṭikka muṭiyavilli. intap putiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ellām jīvacuram tāḷam mutaliyavikaḷ kuṟittu accaṭikkappaṭṭu ēṟkaṉavē capiyōrukkuk koṭukkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. intak kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ tivviya kāntāri, vaccira kānti, himāṅki, vivarttaṉi, āṉantatōṭi, tarmavati, mēkarañcaṉi, nākapūṣaṇi eṉṉum putu irākaṅkaḷil uṇṭākkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.
Mr. cuppiramaṇiya cāstirikaḷ inta capkamiṭṭiyil memparāka illā tiruntum aṭikkaṭi naṭuvil eḻuntu cattam pōṭa ārampittār. āṉāl avar muṟi tappip  pēciṉapaṭiyāl capkamiṭṭic cērmeṉ avari niṟutti viṭṭārkaḷ.
maṟunāḷil (20-8-16) paṇṭitaravarkaḷ maṟupaṭiyum itu viṣayattip paṟṟip pēciṉārkaḷ. Mr. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ rikku vētam ōtum muṟiyiyum āycciyar kuravi pāṭum vitattiyum ātit tamiḻ makkaḷ ca-pa muṟiyiṉ iṇic curaṅkaḷik koṇṭu pāṭiṉapirakāramāyp pāṭik kāṇpittārkaḷ. veku culapamāṉa intat tukkaṭākkaḷ ellārālum mikavum meccik koḷḷappaṭṭaṉa. piṟaku ovvoru cap kamiṭṭi memparum curuti viṣayamāyt tat tam apippirāyattik koṭukkumpaṭik kēṭṭuk koḷḷap paṭṭārkaḷ. pañcāyattil memparkaḷ mottam 13. ivarkaḷuḷ 6 pērkaḷ paṇṭitaravarkaḷ curuti muṟi muṟṟilum cariyeṉṟu oppukkoṇṭārkaḷ. nālu pēr anta muṟiyil pāti cariyeṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. iruvar anta muṟi muṟṟilum tappeṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. oruvar taṉ apippirāyatti veḷiviṭavilli. cap kamiṭṭi memparkaḷ aṭiyil varumāṟu :-













.
tokiyāka cilappatikāram, tolkāppiyam mutaliya pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷil kaṇṭapaṭi āyappāliyiṉ 12 curaṅkaḷum vaṭṭappāliyiṉ 24 curutikaḷum, tirikōṇa caturappālikaḷiṉ 48, 96 mutaliya curutikaḷum pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ kāṉattil vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟatākat terikiṟatu. itaṟkici vāka ici marapil uḷḷa aṭiyil varum cūttiramum irukkiṟatu.
		“āyattuk kīrā ṟaṟunāṉku vaṭṭattuk
		kēyuṅkō ṇattuk kiraṭṭipput-tūyavici
		nuṇmik katiliraṭṭi nōṉalaku mōrnilikkiṅ
		keṇmūṉaṟu kēḷvikoṇ ṭeṇ.”
nālu aṭṭavaṇikaḷilum koṭukkappaṭṭa nālu pālikaḷukku utāraṇamākap pāṭappaṭṭa 67 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷum taṟkāla karnāṭaka caṅkīta viti kaḷukku muṟṟilum aṉucaraṇiyākavēyirukkiṉṟaṉa. karnāṭaka caṅkītat tiṟku stāyiyi 12 allatu 24 allatu 48 allatu 96 nuṭpa curaṅkaḷāyp pirittāloḻiya kāṉam ceytal kūṭāteṉpatu apippirāyam.
mīṟṟiṅ muṭintavuṭaṉ inta capkamiṭṭiyiṉ cērmaṉāka irunta eṉṉāl kāṉpareṉciṉ cērmeṉ avarkaḷukku inta rippōrṭ koṭukkap paṭṭatu.
V.Avāṇṭiyār,
cērmeṉ.
itaṉ piṉ piraciṭeṇṭ avarkaḷ capiyōrip pārttu aṭiyil varumāṟu pēciṉārkaḷ.
“paṇṭitaravarkaḷ itu viṣayattil eṭuttukkoṇṭa arumpirayācam mikavum meccik koḷḷattakkatu. avikaḷiṉ perumiyi nāvāl colla muṭiyātu. kūṭi vantirunta capiyōrellārum inta iraṇṭu nāḷum naṭanta viṣayaṅkaḷip paṟṟi āṉantittārkaḷ eṉpataṟkuc cantēka milli. ellāruṭiya maṉatil iruppatiyum nāṉēyaṟintu collu kiṟēṉ. naṭanta tarkkaṅkaḷum, āṭcēpaṉi camātāṉaṅkaḷum yāvarukkum atika payaṉpaṭattakkaviyāyiruntaṉa. vanta viruntiṉarukkākac ceyyap paṭṭirunta upacāra ēṟpāṭukaḷiṉ oḻuṅkē evarukkum attiyanta cantōṣatti uṇṭākkukiṟatu. caṅkītam taṉakku ippōtu irukkum mēṉmi keṭṭuppōkāmal etu viṣayattil muṉṉukku varavēṇṭu meṉṟu terivataṟku curutikaḷip paṟṟiya cariyāṉa ñāṉamum ammuṟi yiṉ vitikaḷip paṟṟiya aṟivum irukka vēṇṭiyatu avaciyam. ippōtu paṇṭitaravarkaḷ ceyyum ipperiya vēliyāṉatu pūrvattil intu aracarkaḷāl ceyyappaṭṭu vantatu. avarkaḷē caṅkīta cāstirattiṟku vēṇṭiya utavi purintu vantārkaḷ. nāṉ eṉakkākavum, capiyōruk kākavum intiya caṅkīta viṣayamāyp paṇṭitaravarkaḷ uṇmiyāyc ceytu varum vēlikkāka avarkaḷukku naṉṟi celuttak kaṭamippaṭṭirukkiṟēṉ.”
piṟaku cērmaṉ avhkaḷukkup puṣpa āram cūṭṭi akkirācaṉam vakittataṟkāka vantaṉamaḷikkappaṭṭatu. puṣpatāmpūlātikaḷ vaḻaṅkiya piṉ mīṟṟiṅ muṭintatu. tāmpūlam vaḻaṅkukiyil srīrāmaccantiraṉuṭiya paṭṭāpi ṣēkattip paṟṟip pērpōṉa aruṇācala kavi ceyta kīrttaṉattip paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷ. kāṉpareṉcukku ājarāṉavarkaḷ ellārukkum vaḻakkampōl paṇṭitaravarkaḷāl viruntu ceyyappaṭṭatu.
N.P.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar,
cekriṭeri.

makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ C.I.E.,
paṅkaḷūr.
kaṉam poruntiya aiyā,
tāṅkaḷ piraciṭeṇṭāyirunta ēḻāvatu kāṉpareṉciṉ naṭavaṭikki kaḷiyum, kāṉpareṉcil niyamikkappaṭṭa mūṉṟu pañcāyattārkaḷiṉ tīrppu kaḷiyum taṅkaḷuṭiya pārvikku aṉuppiyirukkiṟēṉ. avikaḷip pārviyiṭṭut taṅkaḷiṉ apippirāyattit terivikkumpaṭi kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
taṅkaḷuṭiya apippirāyamāṉatu ippōtu accilirukkiṟa kāṉpa reṉs naṭavaṭikkikaḷuṭaṉ cērttuk koḷḷappaṭum.
ippaṭikku,
taṅkaḷ uṇmiyuḷḷa ūḻiyaṉ,
N.P.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar,
cekriṭeri.
mūṉṟu pañcāyattāruṭiya cākṣiyattiṉ pēril, kāṉpareṉciṉ piraciṭeṇṭavarkaḷākiya
makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ C.I.E., koṭutta muṭivāṉa apippirāyam.
piraciṭeṇṭavarkaḷiṉ apippirāyam.
ātikāla mutal uṇṭāyirukkiṟa caṅkīta cāstira vittiyit tirumpa uyirppittu atiṉ cāstira ātāraṅkaḷik kaṇṭupiṭippatil intiyāviṉ palapākaṅkaḷilum caṅkīta apimāṉikaḷ anēkar uḻittu varukiṟārkaḷ eṉpatu namakkut terinta viṣayam. appaṭi veku ciratti yuṭaṉ uḻittut taṉ kālattiyum, poruḷiyum, vārttiyiyum atu viṣayattil celavaḻittavarkaḷil tañci Rao Sahibāpirakām paṇṭitaravarkaḷ oruvar. ippōtu upayōkattilirukkum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅkum curam curutikaḷik kaṇṭupiṭippatil avarkaḷ koṇṭirukkum muṟiyāṉatu pala taṭavikaḷil rucuppaṭuttap paṭṭirukkiṟatu. antat taṭavikaḷilellām kūṭaviruntu avikaḷil āṉantikkumpaṭiyāṉa cilākkiyatti nāṉ aṭintēṉ. putu irākaṅkaḷil kītam kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ uṇṭupaṇṇum vitattiyum avarkaḷ anēkantaram collik kāṇpittirukkiṟārkaḷ. inta muṟikaḷiṉ vitikaḷellām eḻutappaṭṭu curappaṭuttap paṭṭatumallāmal avarkaḷuṭiya kalvittiṟami vāynta kumārattikaḷākiya srīmati marakata valliyammāḷālum, srīmati kaṉakavalliyammāḷālum veku aḻakāy rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭappaṭṭumirukkiṟatu. avarkaḷuṭiya muṟiyāṉatu pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷiṉāl uṟuti paṇṇappaṭukiṟatu eṉṟa viṣayamāṉatu 1916௵ ākasṭu௴ 19,20 tētikaḷil tañciyil kūṭiya kāṉpareṉciṉ pañcāyattā ruṭiya cākṣiyattiṉāl teḷivākiṟatu,
micūr camastāṉa viṇīka cirōmaṇiyākiya cēṣaṇṇā, vijaya nakaram camastāṉa vitvāṉ vīṇi vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās mutaliya pērpōṉa caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ avarkaḷ muṟiyic cariyeṉṟu oppuk koṇṭiruk kiṟārkaḷ eṉṟa viṣayamum eṉakkut teriyum.
His Highness keykvār makārājā avarkaḷ kūṭṭiya parōṭā āl-intiya caṅkīta kāṉpareṉcilum inta muṟiyāṉatu Mr. paṇṭitaravar kaḷālum, avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷālum vīṇi vāyppāṭṭu mūlamāy rucuppaṭuttappaṭṭatu. nāṉ atu camayam aṅku iruntapaṭiyāl kūṭivanta capiyōr evvaḷavu apimāṉattōṭum, viyappōṭum atikkēṭṭu āṉantittārkaḷ eṉpataṟku nāṉ cāṭci. atu tappeṉṟāvatu anta muṟi kūṭāteṉṟāvatu oruvarum āṣēpikkavilli.
(1) mutal pañcāyattār tīrmāṉikkumpaṭi kuṟikkappaṭṭirunta 48 kēḷvi kaḷukkum iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ eḻutiya cilappatikārattilum maṟṟum pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷilum ētāvatu ātāramirukkiṟatā eṉṟa viṣayattip paṟṟi antap pañcāyattukku cekraṭṭariyāyirunta makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi civañāṉa yōkikaḷu ṭiya rippōrṭṭi liruntu eṉṉa terikiṟateṉṟāl, 10 memparkaḷil 8 pēr anta 48 viṣayaṅkaḷukkum ātāramirukkiṟateṉṟum, oruvar 44 viṣayaṅ kaḷukku ātāramuṇṭeṉṟum, maṟṟavar 34-kku ātāra muṇṭeṉṟum colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. ākiyāl 12 curaṅkaḷ 24, 48, 96 mutaliya curutikaḷ muṟikku ātit tamiḻ nūlkaḷil ātāra muṇṭeṉṟu perumpāṉmi yōr oppuk koḷḷukiṟārkaḷ eṉṟu teḷivākiṟatu.
(2) inta 12 curam, 24 mutaliya nuṭpa curaṅkaḷukku Mr.paṇṭitaravarkaḷ koṭukkum logaritham kaṇakku mutaliyavikaḷ cariyā eṉṟu paricōtippataṟkum, tantiyiṉ paṟpala pākaṅkaḷilum paṟpala curaṅkaḷ pēcukiṉṟaṉavā eṉṟu paricōtippataṟkum oru pañcāyattu niyamikkappaṭṭatu. itaṟku kumpakōṇam kavarṇmeṇṭ kālēj Professor ākiya makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pāṭrāccāriyār M.A.,L.T., avarkaḷ cērmaṉākavum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi T.K.vēmpu aiyar B.A.,L.T., avarkaḷ cekriṭṭariyākavum iruntārkaḷ. ivarkaḷuṭiya rippōrṭṭiliruntu 7 pañcāyattārkaḷil oruvar tavira maṟṟellārum koṭuttirukkum kaṇakkukaḷum ataṟkēṟkat tantiyiṉ aḷavil pēcum curaṅkaḷum, curutikaḷum cariyāṉavi eṉṟum oppuk koḷḷukiṟārkaḷ eṉṟu terikiṟatu.
(3) vīṇiyil paṟpala iṭaṅkaḷil captikkum curaṅkaḷ ippōtu upayōkattilirukkum curaṅkaḷtāṉā eṉṟu tīrmaṉikkiṟataṟkuk kuṟikkappaṭṭa capkamiṭṭikku makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi Rao Bahadur V.A vāṇṭiyār avarkaḷ cērmaṉākavum, St.Peter’s High School heṭmāsṭar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi A.G.piccamuttup piḷḷiyavarkaḷ cekraṭṭariyākavum iruntārkaḷ. itil mottam 13 memparkaḷil 6 pēr anta muṟi muṟṟilum cariyeṉṟu apip pirāyappaṭukiṟārkaḷ. 4 pēr avikaḷil pāti cariyeṉṟum, iruvar anta muṟi muṟṟilum tappeṉṟum apippirāyappaṭukiṟārkaḷ. oruvar taṉ apippirāyattic collavilli. ākiyāl paṇṭitaravarkaḷ vīṇiyiṉ curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷum perumpāṉmiyōrāl oppuk koḷḷappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
intap paricōtaṉiyāṉatu atika tiruptikaramāy muṭintatu eṉṟu oppukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. nammuṭiya caṅkītatti curappaṭuttavum vīṇi mutaliya vāttiyaṅkaḷit tayār ceyyavum inta muṟiyi ellārum upayōkikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu nāṉ vaṟpuṟuttukiṟēṉ. intiya caṅkītatti eṭuttu stāpippataṟkāka makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi āpirakām paṇṭitaravarkaḷ ceyta muyaṟcikaḷ ivvaḷavu tūram citti aṭintataṟkāka nām Mr.paṇṭitaravar kaḷukkup perumiyāka vāḻttutal collukiṟōm.
V.P.mātavarāv,
President.



6 : makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷum, teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curutikaḷum.
1916ām ´ cepṭampar mātam 11 ām tētiyil teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curutikaḷip paṟṟi micūr camastāṉam, viṇīka cikāmaṇi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ muṉṉiliyil oru capi kūṭṭap peṟṟatu. appōtu parōṭā tivāṉ cākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi paḻamāṟaṉēri cāmināta aiyaravarkaḷum, vīṇi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi vēṅkaṭācalam aiyaravarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷum, vāyppāṭṭu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cāmiyāpiḷḷi avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi piccamuttupiḷḷi avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi P.V.kiruṣṇacāmi aiyar avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi rāmaṇṇā avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi N.P.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi captariṣi pākavatar avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēturāmapāratiyār avarkaḷum, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi ulakanātapiḷḷi avarkaḷum maṟṟum pala kaṉavāṉkaḷum ājarāyiruntārkaḷ.
makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷ akkirācaṉātipatiyāka irukka makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi P.V.kiruṣṇacāmi aiyar avarkaḷāl kēṭṭuk koḷḷappaṭṭu capiyōr yāvarālum aṅkīkarikkappaṭṭatu. appōtu paṇṭitar avarkaḷ piṉvarumāṟu coṉṉārkaḷ.
“kaṉavāṉkaḷē! akkirācaṉātipatiyavarkaḷē! teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curaṅkaḷip paṟṟiyum curutikaḷip paṟṟiyum niccayam colla muṭiyāmal palar pala vitamāṉa apippirāyam collum paṭiyāṉa cantēka niliyil nammuṭiya caṅkītamirukkiṟa teṉṟu colla vicaṉappaṭu kiṟēṉ. avikaḷ iṉṉaviyeṉṟu tiṭṭamāṉa aṟivukku varumpoḻutu iṉimēl paṭikkum piṉṉaṭiyārukku upakāramāka virukkum. piṟkālattil cantēkam uṇṭākāmalirukkum. ivikaḷi neṭunāḷ vicārittu varuki yil oru ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇattil kītaṅkaḷ eḻutavum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ceyyavum kūṭiya cila uttamamāṉa vitivakikaḷi putitākak kaṇṭu piṭittēṉ. ivikaḷip palamuṟi tañcāvūrukku vanta makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi viṇīkacikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ muṉṉiliyilum kāṭṭi avarkaḷum mikunta cantōṣamaṭintirukkiṟārkaḷ. avarkaḷ muṉṉili yil teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curutikaḷic colvatil mikunta cantōṣa muṭiyavaṉāka irukkiṟēṉ. nammuṭiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varuvatu paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷē. ivikaḷ ca-pa muṟiyāka ēḻāvatu ēḻāvatu curamākavum ca-ma muṟippaṭi aintāvatu aintāvatu curamākavum poruttamuṭiyavi. ca-pa, ca-ma muṟippaṭi cama aḷavāṉa ōciyuṭiyavi. itip pūrvattōr āyappāli eṉṟu vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷ. ivikaḷil kirakam māṟṟi ēḻu tāyirākaṅkaḷ pāṭivantirukkiṟārkaḷ. am muṟiyil taṟkālattiluḷḷa 72 mēḷakkarttā irākaṅkaḷumirukkiṉṟaṉa. ari ariyāṉa paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷil ivi pāṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟum vīṇiyiṉ paṉṉiraṇṭu stāṉaṅkaḷil niṟkum curaṅkaḷē avikaḷ eṉṟum ammuṟippaṭi cutta curaṅkaḷil nām taṟkālattil tīracaṅkarā paraṇam arikāmpōti, karakarappiriyā, naṭapiravi, aṉumattōṭi, mēcakalyāṇi, māyāmāḷavam mutaliya tāy irākaṅkaḷiyum kuntala varāḷi, karuṭat toṉi, kōkilattoṉi, cintumantāri, cintu kaṉṉāṭā mutaliya jaṉṉiya irākaṅkaḷiyum taṟkālam pāṭik koṇṭirukkiṟōm”
eṉṟum colla avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ variciyāka 12 curaṅkaḷiyum, cila kīrttaṉikaḷiyum pāṭik kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ.
ataṉpiṉ oru stāyiyil varum 24 curutikaḷiyum variciyākap pāṭikkāṭṭum poḻutu capiyār yāvarum mikunta cantōṣamaṭintārkaḷ. ataṟku tiṣṭāntamāka cāvēri, kikavaci, cakāṉā mutaliya irākaṅkaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.
tirikōṇappāliyil vaḻaṅki varum caṅkarāparaṇam, tanniyāci, caṇmukappiriyā, amcattoṉi mutaliya irākaṅkaḷil nāṟpatteṭṭil oṉṟāṉa curuti vaḻaṅki varuvatik kaṇṭu ellārum āccariya maṭintārkaḷ. tanniyāciyil kāntāratti piḷḷikaḷ kūṭap paṭikkiṟārkaḷ. atu cātāraṇa kāntārattiṟkum kuṟintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi paḻamāṟaṉēri cāmināta aiyar avarkaḷ metuvāka ārampikka ati makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ tāṅkip pēcip piṭilum vācittuk kāṇpittārkaḷ. appōtu pala vātaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭu pala kīrttaṉaṅkaḷiṉ mēṟkōḷiṉāl atu kūṭiyē varavēṇṭumeṉṟu paṇṭitar avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷiṉ utaviyāl tiṣṭāntappaṭuttik kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. appōtu caṅkīta kamiṭṭikkuc cērmeṉāṉa cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷum ‘atu kūṭiyē varavēṇṭum. cātāraṇa kāntārattiṟkuk kūṭivarāmaṟpōṉāl atu tanniyāciyākamāṭṭātu’ eṉṟu vaṟpuṟuttic coṉṉārkaḷ. paṇṭitar avarkaḷ niṣātam 41/2 alakāyk kūṭi varuvatu pōlavē kāntāramum 41/2 alakāyk kūṭi vara vēṇṭum. nām taṟkālattil irākam pāṭuvataṟkēṟṟa putu vitiḷi aṟiyāmalum, ataṉ jīvacuram iṉṉa teṉṟu aṟintu koḷḷa iyalāmalum irākaṅkaḷik keṭuttuk koṇṭirukkiṟōm. ammuṟi namakkut teriyumpoḻutu ippaṭippaṭṭa picakukaḷi nām teḷivāyk kāṇpōm eṉṟu colla āṣēpaṉi ceytavarkaḷ aṟintu aṭaṅkiṉārkaḷ.
itaṉmēl nālāvatāṉa caturappāliyil oru stāyiyil toṇṇūṟṟāṟil oṉṟāṉa vīcam curaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅki varum mattimāvati, tēvakāntāri, ārapi, kakaṉakutukalam, ceñcuruṭṭi, himāṅki mutaliya irākaṅkaḷil varum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. mika iṉimiyāṉa caturappāli irākaṅkaḷ pāṭi muṭintavuṭaṉ paṇṭitar avarkaḷ ‘nam intiya kāṉam iṉimiyuṭiya teṉṟu yāvarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭuvataṟku nuṭpa māṉa curaṅkaḷē kāraṇam. iṉimiyāṉa curaṅkaḷi iṉṉateṉṟu aṟintu koḷḷa iyalāmalum, piṟarukkuc colla ētuvillāmalumirukkiṟōm. itaṉāl namatu piṉṉaṭiyārumniccayam terintu koḷḷāmalum veku ciramam aṭiyavēṇṭiya tāyirukkiṟatu. maṟṟavarum kuṟi colla ētuvā yirukkiṟatu. nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷukku aṉupōkattiṟku ottuvarakkūṭiya oru muṟiyik kaṇṭupiṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu pirayācap paṭṭuk koṇṭiruntu pāṭik koṇṭirukkum irākaṅkaḷip paricōtaṉi ceytu avikaḷi nālu iṉaṅkaḷākap pirittu oruvāṟu niccayappaṭuttum poḻutu pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷil ivi āyappāli, vaṭṭappāli, tirikōṇappāli, caturap pāli eṉṟu nālu pālikaḷāka vakukkappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa veṉṟum oru stāyiyip paṉṉiraṇṭākap pirittu āyappāli eṉṟum irupattu nāṉkākap pirittu vaṭṭappāli eṉṟum, nāṟpatteṭṭākap pirittu tirikōṇappāli eṉṟum, toṇṇūhṟṟāṟākap pirittu caturap pāli eṉṟum teḷivākac colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟu kaṇṭēṉ. namatu aṉu pōkattil ippōtu irukkiṟavikaḷ pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vantavi eṉṟum, avikaḷ cāstira ātāramuṭiyavi yeṉṟum niccayamākac colvēṉ’ eṉṟum teḷivāka eṭutturittārkaḷ.
appōtu caṅkīta kamiṭṭikkuc cērmaṉāka irunta makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ eḻuntu niṉṟu capiyōrip pārttup piṉ varumāṟu pēciṉārkaḷ.
“kaṉavāṉkaḷē! vitvacirōmaṇikaḷē! nāṉ pala taṭavikaḷ paṇṭitar avarkaḷic cantittirukkiṟēṉ. avarkaḷ caṅkīta viṣayattil vittirukkum piriyattiṟkākavē nāṉ aṭikkaṭi pārkkap piriyappaṭukiṟēṉ. avarkaḷ pala taṭavikaḷil putitu putitākac caṅkītattil ceytirukkum vēlikaḷik kāṇpittirukkiṟārkaḷ. ippōtu curutikaḷip paṟṟi avarkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭittavikaḷic colla nām kēṭṭōm. ivviṣayam karukalāṉa teṉṟu nām aṟivōm. 22 curutikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟa muṟiyil nāṉum vekuvāy ārāycci ceytirukkiṟēṉ. avikaḷ oru muṭivukku varakkūṭiyavikaḷāka eṉakkut tōṉṟavilli. nām oru stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷ vittuk kāṉam ceytu varukiṟōm. ataṟkum oru stāyiyi 22 ākap pirittuk kāṉam ceyvataṟkum campantamiruppatākat teriyavilli. irupattu nāṉkākap pirippōmāṉāl accuraṅkaḷik kamakamāy nām pāṭivarum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil upayōkittu varukiṟōm eṉṟu niccayamāy aṟivōm. ippōtu accuraṅkaḷip piḷḷikaḷ taṉittu vāyiṉālum, vīṇiyiṉālum pāṭikkāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. 22 curuti eṉṟu cātikkiṟavarkaḷ appaṭi avikaḷip pāṭikkāṭṭaṭṭum. avikaḷ upayōkikkum iṭaṅ kaḷiyum collik kāṭṭaṭṭum. nāṟpatteṭṭu, toṇṇūhṟṟāṟāka vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpa curutikaḷ ippōtu pāṭikkāṭṭiya muṟippaṭi kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil kamakamāy vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉpataṟku yātoru āṣēpaṉiyumilli. kamakamāy varum curaṅkaḷiyum vīcam arikkālāṉa curaṅkaḷiyum tāṅkaḷ vācikkak kēṭṭīrkaḷē. avviṭaṅkaḷi aṟintu avvōcikaḷi vāyiṉāl collik kāṭṭiya piḷḷikaḷiṉ tiṟami rompa meccik koḷḷak kūṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ inta muyaṟci capi yōr yāvarālum naṉkumatikkak kūṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. curutikaḷip paṟṟiya vivātam oru nalla muṭivukku vantirukkiṟateṉpatip paṟṟiyum tamiḻ nūlkaḷil itaṟku ātāramirukkiṟateṉṟu kāṇpittataṟkākavum nāṉ mikavum naṉṟiyuḷḷavaṉāyirukkiṟēṉ”
eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ.
ataṉ piṉ parōṭā tivāṉ cākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ piṉvarumāṟu coṉṉārkaḷ :-
“kaṉavāṉkaḷē! 
paṇṭitar avarkaḷ curuti viṣayamākac ceṉṟa kāṉpareṉcil aṉupōka pūrvamāyk kāṭṭiyatu pōlavē micūr camastāṉa vitvāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi viṇīkacikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ muṉṉili yilum iṉṟu naṭattik kāṭṭiyataṟkāka nāṉ mikavum cantōṣappaṭukiṟēṉ. makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷi neṭunāḷāka nāṉ aṟivēṉ. avarkaḷuṭiya caṅkītat tiṟamiyippaṟṟi nīṅkaḷ yāvarum naṉṟāy aṟivīrkaḷ. ataṉāl nāṉatikam collavēṇṭiyatilli. avarkaḷ muṉṉiliyil oru stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷ uṇṭeṉṟum 24 curutikaḷum 48, 96 āṉa nuṭpa curutikaḷum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭi avarkaḷum oppukkoṇṭatāṉatu eṉakku mikunta cantōṣattit tarukiṟatu. paṇṭitar avarkaḷ ivikaḷit taṟkālattil pāṭik koṇṭirukkum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ mūlamāka rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭiyatōṭu cumār 2000 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉuḷḷa tamiḻ nūlkaḷil collappaṭukiṟa teṉṟu rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭuvatāṉatu nām āccariyappaṭak kūṭiyatā yirukkiṟatu. ātit tamiḻ makkaḷ oru stāyiyi 12 curaṅkaḷāy 24 curutikaḷāy atilum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷāka vakuttu tāṅkaḷ kāṉam ceytu vantirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉpati nām aṟiyumpoḻutu caṅkītam pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷāl mikunta tērcciyaṭin tirukkiṟateṉṟu kāṇkiṟōm. appaḻami yāṉa muṟippaṭi iṉṟuvariyum nam aṉupōkatti lirukkiṟateṉṟu rucup paṭuttik kāṭṭuvatu nammellārukkum mikunta cantōṣattit tarum. avarkaḷ curuti muṟik kaṇakkum avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭiya muṟiyum iṅkē vantirukkum caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ yāvarum oppuk koṇṭu cantōṣippārkaḷeṉṟu nāṉ nampukiṟēṉ” eṉṟārkaḷ. ataṉpiṉ vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷukkum kaṉavāṉkaḷukkum puṣpa tāmpūlam vaḻaṅkap peṟṟatu.

makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi viṇīka cikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ rippōrṭṭi itaṉpiṉ pārkka.
The opinion of M.R.Ry. Vynika Sikamani Seshanna Avl., of Mysore, on the Question of Srutis.
It gave me great pleasure to attend the Music Conference held on the 11th September last in Tanjore by Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avergal and preside over the Committee of experts appointed to examine the Srutis used in Indian Music. Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avl. has been making research in the field of Music for several years past and in testing the accuracy of scientific propositions he has had a peculiar advantage in the skilful and marvellous singing of his dughters who have attined high proficiency in the science and art of music. The question that was to be settled in the Conference was one relating to the number of Srutis used in our Music and Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avergal’s exposition of them in the light of ancient Tamil works was quite in keeping with the practice now obtining according to those works, the Sthayi being divisible into 24 Srutis and not 22 as given in Sanskrit works. Half of the 24 coincide with the 12 notes now in use and the other half distribute themselves between these. According to our knowledge the 22 Srutis will not coincide with the 12 Swarams. The 24 Srutis can become 48, or 96 as per Tamil works, and there is no hesitation in saying that the 24 Srutis are correct.
These 12 Srutis are found used in some of the modern Ragas and the division of the Octave into 24 Srutis is quite a practical way of dividing the Sthayi; the Tamil works go still further and state that those 24 Srutis are divisible into 48 and even 96 Sub Srutis.
I do not doubt that the sub-division is reasonable. I am led to think that the correct intonation of the fundamental 12 notes is a work of great labour and skill, and that of the24 Srutis also. The 24 Srutis are attinable after a very high degree of proficiency. Though some of the 48 or 96 Srutis are skipped over while singing or playing, it is almost impossible to locate them definitely and point them out to the observer. For the requirements of the musician, it is enough if he can master the 24 Srutis. But I must not fail to note that the voices of the dughters of Abraham Pandither Avergal are flexible to a wonderful degree and they may, with further cultivation of the art, be able to sound the series of the 48 Srutis also. To the average musician the subject will be a sealed book.
All lovers of music must, therefore, be grateful to the learned Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avergal for the unselfish work he has been doing in the cuse of Music.
(Sd.) VYNIKA SIKAMANI SESHANNA.
Mysore.
curutikaḷip paṟṟi micūr viṇīka cikāmaṇi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷuṭiya apippirāyam.
cepṭampar௴ 11௳ tañciyil rāv cāyap M.āpirakām paṇṭitaravar kaḷāl kūṭṭappaṭṭa caṅkīta kāṉpareṉcil ācarāyirunta intiya caṅkīta curuti vicāraṇikkeṉṟu ēṟpaṭuttappaṭṭa kamiṟṟikku nāṉ piraciṭeṇṭā yirunta viṣayamāṉatu eṉakku mikunta cantōṣattit koṭuttatu.
paṇṭitaravarkaḷ caṅkīta viṣayattil anēka varuṣaṅkaḷāy uḻittu vantirukkiṟārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ ceykiṟa cāstira viṣayamāṉa caṅkatikaḷ caritāṉāveṉṟu cōtittuppārppatil avarkaḷukku atika mukkiyamāṉa oru cātakam ēṟpaṭṭirukkiṟatu. ateṉṉaveṉṟāl caṅkīta cāstirattilum ataṉi aṉupōkattilum atikamāyt tēṟiyirukkiṟa avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ pāṭum aticayikkattakka arumiyāṉa caṅkītamē.
intak kāṉpareṉcil niccayikkumpaṭi kuṟikkappaṭṭa viṣayam eṉṉa veṉṟāl, nam caṅkītattil upayōkikkappaṭum curutikaḷ ettaṉi yeṉpatē. itu viṣayattil paṇṭitaravarkaḷ paḻamiyāṉa tamiḻ nūlkaḷi ātāramākak koṇṭu curutikaḷi vistarittatu taṟkālam annūlkaḷiṉ pirakāram aṉupōkattilirukkum muṟikku muṟṟilum ottatākavē yiruntatu.
avarkaḷ vistaritta muṟippaṭi stāyiyi camaskiruta nūlkaḷ colvatu pōl 22 eṉṟu pirikkāmal 24 eṉṟu pirikkiṟārkaḷ. inta 24 il pāti curaṅkaḷ taṟkālam aṉupōkattilirukkum 12 curaṅkaḷtāṉ. maṟṟa 12um ivikaḷukkiṭiyē niravappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. namakkut terinta variyil 22 curuti muṟikkum 12 curutikaḷukkum oru nāḷum poruttam varātu. tamiḻ nūlkaḷil colliyirukkiṟapaṭi inta 24 curutikaḷ, 48 ākavum 96 ākavum varalām. 24 curuti muṟi cariyāṉateṉṟu oppuk koḷvataṟkuk koñca mēṉum taṭiyilli.
taṟkālam pāṭappaṭum anēka irākaṅkaḷil inta 12 curaṅkaḷ upayōkattilirukkiṉṟaṉa. stāyiyi 24 ākap pakuppatu muṟṟilum aṉupōkattiṟku otta cariyāṉa muṟiyē. āṉāl tamiḻ nūlkaḷil colliyirukkiṟapaṭi intac curutikaḷ itilum nuṭpamāka 48 curutikaḷākavum 96 curutikaḷākavum pirikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
ippaṭi nuṭpa curutikaḷākap pirikkiṟatu niyāyantāṉ eṉpataṟkuc cantēkamilli. 12 curaṅkaḷi variciyāyc colluvatu atikak kaṣṭam. tiṟamiyuḷḷavarkaḷ māttiram appaṭic colla muṭiyum. 24 curutikaḷic colluvatum appaṭiyē. āṉāl atikamāyt tērnta vitvāṉkaḷ tāṉ itic cātaṉi ceyya muṭiyum. pāṭumpōtum, vāttiyam vācikkum pōtum, 48, 96 eṉṟa atika nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷik kamakamākak kāṇpikka lāmē yoḻiya antac curutikaḷ pēcum iṭaṅkaḷik kuṟippiṭṭu kēṭpavar aṟiyumpaṭi collutal kūṭāta kāriyamāyirukkiṟatu. āṉāl caṅkīta vitvāṉukku 24 curutikaḷip pāṭam paṇṇiviṭṭāl atuvē caṅkīta viṣayattiṟkup pōtum.
paṇṭitaravarkaḷuṭiya kuḻantikaḷiṉ cārīram eppērppaṭṭa caṅkītat tiṟkum vaḷintu koṭukkakkūṭiya āccariyappaṭattakka iṉimiyuḷḷatu. (ippōtu avarkaḷ 24 curutikaḷi variciyāyc collukiṟārkaḷ.) āṉāl iṉṉum koñcam pirayācattuṭaṉ muyaṟcippārkaḷāṉāl avarkaḷ 48 curuti kaḷiyum kūṭa variciyāyc collakkūṭiyavarkaḷ. āṉāl mattimamāṉa caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷukku inta vitti oru nāḷum varātu.
ākiyāl caṅkītatti virumpum yāvarum kalviyil ciṟanta nammuṭiya (Rao Sahib) paṇṭitaravarkaḷ yātoru naṉmiyiyum karutāmal caṅkītattiṟkeṉṟē ceytu varukiṟa vēlikkāka naṉṟi pārāṭṭak kaṭamip paṭṭirukkiṟārkaḷ.
(oppam) viṇīka cikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā,

Translated from English.			(True Copy)
The Opinion of M.R.Ry. Vynika Stromani Venkataramanadas Avl.,
Samasthana Vidwan, Vizianagaram.
RESPECTED AND DEAR SIR,
We are all well here and I request you to let me know often about your welfare.
I was very anxious to attend the 7th Conference of the Tanjore Sangeetha Vidva Mahajana Sangam which was held at Tanjore on the 19th of August 1916. But I was detired here owing to the marriage of the Yuva Raja of this Samasthanam. I regret I had no opportunity to pay you a personal visit owing to the constant musical engagements I had here since the wedding.
I feel glad that I hav had the privilege of travelling with you to Baroda to attend the All India music Conference held there in March of last year, to have heard your discourse on Srutis at the sid Conference and to have been present at the demonstrations made by Srimati Maragathavalli Ammal and Kanagavalli Ammal on the Srutis of Karnatic music both at Baroda and at Madras in the presence of M.R.Ry.Sabesa Iyer Avargal.
I can assure you that the 12 Swarams you demonstrated on the Veena are the Swarams of modern Karnatic music. The minuter Srutis used in connection with these Swarams are generally played as Gamakams. But the only mistake in modern music is that the Gamaka Swarams are mentioned as having different kinds of measurements having different irregular intervals. We who have practised the 12 ancient Srutis on the Veena, were ignorant as to how the 22 Srutis should be adjusted on it, and were in doubt for years as to what the 22 Srutis were.
I was very much pleased when you proved before the Vidwans at Baroda that the 22 Srutis system of Saranga Dev was incorrect, that there were only 12 Swarams to the Octav by the SA-PA principle, that each of these Swarams was divided into2 Srutis thus foring the series 24, that ganam was made in the minuter Srutis 48 and 96 of the Octave. I was also cleared of the doubt as regards the 22 Srutis. But my joy reached its utmost limit when Keertanams were sung where these 12, 24, 48 and 96 Srutis were used. This demonstration is beyond the imagination of any Vidwan nor could it be sung by any.
Wheni Srimathi Maragathavalli Ammal and Kanagavalli Amal sang Keertanams in the minute Srutis I was carried into the regions of ecstasy. I have seen many places from the Himalayas to Cape Comorin and I have made the acquaintance of many a musical expert. But I have not found any one to equal Srimati Maragathavalli Ammal in musical ear. When the audience at Baroda listened to her singing how she brought into prominenc even the most insignificant Sruti their joy knew no bounds. Many clapped hands out of sheer joy, spoke words of deep appreciation, an sid that a new era had dawned for the musical worl. I was lost in admiration when I witnessed all this novelty.
I was anxious to see how this demonstration work would come off in the Tanjore Conferenc. So I regret very much that I was unable to be present. I was also sorry that I had to disappoint you twic owing to my indisposition. I am explining your system of Srutis to many an inquirer. I am eagerly looking forward to meting you in person and enjoy the music. I wish God’s blessings on your dughters and other children.
VIZIANAGARAM, 									I remin,
17th May 1917 								Yours sincerely,
								(Sd.) VENKATARAMANADAS

ivviṭam ṣēmamm, ṣēmamttiṟku aṭikkaṭi terivikkumpaṭi kēṭṭukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ.
1916 ām varuṣam ākasṭu mātam 19m tēti tañciyil naṭanta caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattiṉ ēḻāvatu kāṉpareṉsukku nāṉ vara mikavum piriyamāyiruntēṉ. āṉāl ivviṭam camastāṉattil yuvarājā vukku kaliyāṇamāṉatāl nāṉ varakkūṭavilli. ataṟkuppintiṉa nāṭkaḷil kaccērikaḷ aṭikkaṭi ēṟpaṭṭukkoṇṭiruntatāl ituvariyum varukiṟataṟku cantarppamumilli eṉṟu varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ.
1916ām varuṣam mārccu mātattil parōṭāvil naṭanta āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉsukku taṅkaḷōṭu payaṇam ceyyavum, curutikaḷip paṟṟi kāṉpareṉsil tāṅkaḷ ceyta piracaṅkattik kēṭkavum srīmati marakatavalli ammāḷ, kaṉakavalli ammāḷ karnāṭaka kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil varum nuṭpa curutikaḷippāṭi vīṇiyil rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiṉa poḻutum ataṉ piṉ paṭṭaṇattil vantu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi capēciyar avarkaḷukku nuṭpa curutikaḷi rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiṉa poḻutumkūṭa irukkumpaṭiyāka nērnta tippaṟṟiyum eppoḻutum cantōṣamaṭintu koṇṭirukkiṟēṉ.
tāṅkaḷ vīṇiyil rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiya 12 curaṅkaḷum nam karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varukiṟa curaṅkaḷē. atōṭu vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpamāṉa cila curaṅḷi kamakamāy nām vaḻaṅki varukiṟōm. āṉāl kamakamāy varukiṟa curaṅkaḷ peritum ciṟitumāṉa iṭiveḷikaḷuṭiyaṉavāy pala aḷavil collappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. 12 curattiṉ pūrva vaḻakkattiyum vīṇi yiṉ amippiṉpaṭi paḻakiya nāṅkaḷ 22 curutiyi itil amikkat teriyā malum paḻaka muṭiyāmalum 22 curuti iṉṉateṉṟu collamuṭiyāmalum anēka nāḷ kalaṅkiṉōm.
tāṅkaḷ parōṭā kāṉpareṉsil vitvāṉkaḷ muṉ oru stāyi yil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu coṉṉa caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟi cariyāṉatallaveṉṟum pūrva tamiḻ nāṭṭiṉ muṟippaṭi oru stāyiyil ca-pa muṟiyāy 12 curaṅkaḷ tāṉ amikiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum ovvoru curamum iraṇṭu alakāyp pirikkappaṭṭu 24 curutikaḷāka vaḻaṅki vantārka ḷeṉṟum atōṭu oru stāyiyi 48 ākavum 96 ākavum pirittu nuṭpa curutikaḷil kāṉam ceytārkaḷeṉṟum rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiyapoḻutu nāṉ mikunta cantōṣamaṭintēṉ. oru stāyiyil 22 curuti yeṉṟa mayakkam eṉiviṭṭu nīṅkiṟṟu. atōṭu 12, 24, 48, 96 eṉṟa curuti muṟiyil taṉit taṉi pala kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ pāṭi tiṣṭāntap paṭuttiṉapoḻutu nāṉ aṭinta cantōṣattiṟku aḷavilli. itu enta vitvāṉkaḷiṉālum maṉatiṉāl niṉikkakkūṭiyatumalla vāyiṉāl collikkāṭṭakkūṭiyatumalla.
srīmati marakatavalliyammāḷum, kaṉakavalli ammāḷum nuṭpa curutikaḷil collik kāṭṭiyapoḻutu mey maṟantu paravacamāṉēṉ. nāṉ kaṉṉiyākumari mutal imayamali variyum pala iṭaṅkaḷ cuṟṟip pārttirukkiṟēṉ. anēka caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷōṭum, cura ñāṉikaḷōṭum pala nāḷ paḻakiyirukkiṟēṉ. āṉāl srīmati marakatavalli ammaḷippōla nuṭpa curañāṉamuṭiyavarḷi nāṉ pārttatilli. nilippaṭāta nuṭpa curaṅkaḷil kārvi koṭuttu collikkāṭṭiyatip pārtta capiyār yāvarum āṉantamaṭintārkaḷ. āṉantattiṉāl ki koṭṭiṉārkaḷ. āci moḻikaḷ palavum kūṟiṉārkaḷ. caṅkītattiṟkup putiya ulakam tōṉṟiyirukkiṟateṉṟu colli āṉantittārkaḷ. ivikaḷellām eṉakku āccariyamum nūtaṉamu māyt tōṉṟiṉa.
tañci caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattil ivikaḷ eppaṭi rucuppaṭuttappaṭumō eṉṟu pārkka āvalāyiruntēṉ. āṉāl eṉṉāl varakkūṭāmal pōṉatippaṟṟi mikavum varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ. atōṭu nāṉ varukiṟēṉ eṉṟu iraṇṭu taṭavi eḻutiyum varakkūṭāmal acukkiyam ēṟpaṭṭatip paṟṟi mikavum vicaṉikkiṟēṉ. curutiyip paṟṟi vicāritta palarkkum taṅkaḷāl collappaṭṭapaṭiyē viḷakkic collik koṇṭum varukiṟēṉ. kūṭiya cīkkirattil avviṭam vantu mukkiyamāy nēril vicārittu cantōṣappaṭa viruppamuḷḷavaṉāyirukkiṟēṉ. kuḻantikaḷukku eṉ ācīrvātam.

iti vācikkum kaṉavāṉkaḷē!
ituvariyum colli vantavikaḷil cilappatikārattiṉ utaviyāl teḷivākat terintavikaḷiyum teḷivāy arttam ceyyakkūṭiyavi kaḷiyum pala kuṟippukaḷiṉāl ivikaḷāka irukkalāmeṉṟu niccayikkak kūṭiyavikaḷiyum maṭṭum iṅku eḻutiṉēṉ. taṟkāla caṅkītattiṟkum aṉupavattiṟkum ottuvarāta evvita apippirāyamum illi eṉṟu kāṇkiṟēṉ. aṉupavattiṟku varakkūṭiyavikaḷ evikaḷō avikaḷi māttiram eṉṉāl kūṭiyavari pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ ātārattuṭaṉ colli yirukkiṟēṉ. aṅkuc colliyiruppavi mika nuṭpamākaviruntālum avaṟṟiṟkuc colliyirukkum virivāṉa aṉupavam yāvum avikaḷi liruntu arttamākak kūṭiyavikaḷē yoḻiya vēṟilli. pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta curuti muṟi mikunta tērcciyum atika nuṭpamum teḷivum uṭiyateṉṟu nāṉ tuṇintu colvēṉ.
atōṭu ivikaḷ ellāvaṟṟiyum nāṉ oruṅkē aṟintapiṉ innūl eḻutavilli. appōtikkappōtu teyva kirupiyiṉāl teḷivāy viḷaṅkiṉa ovvoṉṟiyum eḷitil viḷaṅkumpaṭi pala mukamāyc colla nēriṭṭatu. appaṭi nāṉ colliyintālum ēṟṟa camayattil kiṭitta pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ ātārattiṉ karuttum atuvā yirukkiṟateṉṟu kaṇṭu mikunta cantōṣamaṭintēṉ. pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ karuttukaḷi ārāyumpoḻutum avikaḷit tiṣṭāntappaṭuttik kāṭṭum poḻutum eṉṉōṭu kalantu cantōṣikkum oruvar illāmal varuntuki yil teyvam tāmē kūṭaviruntu appōtikkappōtu pūrvamāyuḷḷa mēṟkōḷkaḷik kāṇumpaṭi ceytatikkoṇṭu ūkkamaṭintēṉ. eḻutiyavikaḷ yāvum kūṭiyavari cariyāyirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu eḻutiyapiṉ kiṭitta mēṟkōḷkaḷiṉāl aṟintēṉ. avikaḷil pustakam muṭintapiṉ curutikaḷippaṟṟi cuvāmi viruti civañāṉayōkikaḷ, tañcāvūr caṅkīta vityāmakājaṉa caṅkattil coṉṉa ici marapu veṇpāvi iṅkuc colvatu yāvarukkum upayōkamāyirukkumeṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ.
		“āyattuk kīrā ṟaṟunāṉku vaṭṭattuk
		kēyuṅkō ṇattuk kiraṭṭipput-tūyavici
		nuṇmik katiliraṭṭi nōṉalaku mōrnilikkiṅ
		keṇmūṉṟu kēḷvikoṇ ṭeṇ.”
itaṉāl oru stāyiyil āyappālikkup paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅka ḷeṉṟum vaṭṭappālikku irupattu nāṉku curutikaḷ eṉṟum tirikōṇap pāliyil 48 curutikaḷ, eṉṟum caturappāliyil 96 curutikaḷ eṉṟum vaḻaṅki vantārkaḷeṉṟu teḷivāka aṟikiṟōm.
ici nuṇmi eṉṟatāl ataṟku mēṟpaṭṭut teḷivākac collavum, kātiṉāl kēṭkavum muṭiyāteṉṟu variyaṟuttuc coṉṉatāka niṉikkakkūṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. itaṉ muṉ curutikaḷip paṟṟic collumiṭattil curutikaḷ oṉṟutāṉ. curutikaḷ iraṇṭutāṉ. curutikaḷ mūṉṟu vitam, curutikaḷ nāṉku vitam, curutikaḷ oṉpatu vitam, curutikaḷ irupattiraṇṭu vitam, curutikaḷ aṟupattāṟu vitam, curutikaḷ aṉantantāṉ eṉṟu curutikaḷiṉ niccayam iṉṉateṉṟu teriyāmal coṉṉa vārttikaḷum curutikaḷ 25, 27, 53, 42, 66 eṟu coṉṉavarkaḷiṉ aṉupōkattiṟku varāta niccayamillāta vārttiyumpōl illāmal itu mikat teḷivākavum aṉupōkattiṟku varakkūṭiyatākavum tiṭṭamākavu mirukkiṟatu.
curutikaḷ aṉantantāṉ eṉṟu colliviṭṭapiṉ evar etic coṉṉālum atellām poruntum eṉṟu arttamākiṟatu. itu cantēkap paṭṭavarkaḷ oḷintu koḷḷa aṭikkalastāṉam pōliruntatiṉimittam curutikaḷippaṟṟi mayakkam uṇṭāyiṟṟu.
āṉāl ici nuṇmi atāvatu iciyil nuṭpamāṉa aḷavu oru stāyiyil 1/96 eṉṟu colvati nām kavaṉikkum poḻutu kātiṉāl kēṭkavum vāyiṉāl collavum kūṭāta ōci ataṟku mēlilli eṉat teḷivāka variyaṟuttuc colliyirukkiṟār eṉṟu terikiṟatu. pala ōciyiṉ alikaḷ cērntu oru curutiyāṉālum 1/96 āṉa ici nuṇmikku mēl ōciyiṉ ali collavum kēṭkavum kūṭiyatalla eṉṟu vīṇiyil, nām pirattiyaṭcamāy aṟivatē pōtum eṉṟu niṉikkiṟēṉ. ataṟkuk kuṟinta curuti illi yeṉpatu niccayam.
teḷivākac collum icit tamiḻ nūlkaḷ muṉṉāṭiyē namakku kiṭikkātataṉāl virivāka eḻuta vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu. icittamiḻ nūlkaḷil oṉṟākiya icimarapu eṉṉum nūliṟ cilapakutikaḷ tiruvāvaṭu tuṟi ātīṉattic cārnta puttakacāliyil iruppatākak kēḷvip paṭukiṟōm. icceyyuḷil collappaṭum curutik kaṇakkukaḷi aṉucarittē itaṉmuṉ pala pākaṅkaḷ collappaṭṭiruppataṉāl aṟivāḷi kaḷukku itu pōtumeṉṟu niṉikkiṟēṉ.
2. ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉ peyar pūrva tamiḻp peyarē camaskiruta peyaralla eṉpatu.
curaṅkaḷip paṟṟiyum curutikaḷip paṟṟiyum nāṉ eḻuti varum puttakattiṉ nōkkamaṟiyāta cilar taṟkālam vaḻaṅki varum caṅkīta muṟikaḷi māṟṟiyirukkiṟēṉ eṉṟum māṟṟappōkiṟēṉ eṉṟum camaskiruta pāṣiyil eḻutiya caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷi muṟṟilum māṟṟi viṭṭēṉ eṉṟum pala āṣēpaṉi collit tamiḻil taṅkaḷit tērntavarkaḷeṉṟu collikkoṇṭu vēṇṭumeṉṟē tamiḻ moḻiyōṭu pala aṉṉiya moḻikaḷik kalantu tamiḻik keṭuttuk koṇṭirukkum tamiḻ vitvāṉkaḷ cilarik kutarkkam ceyyumpaṭit tūṇṭiviṭṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kēṭṭa pala kēḷvikaḷukkut takunta patil appōtik kappōtu colliyirukkiṟēṉ.
atil oruvar ‘ca ri ka ma pa ta ni’ eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷum ṣaṭjamam, riṣapam, kāntāram, mattimam, pañcamam, tivatam, niṣātam eṉṟa camaskiruta vārttikaḷiliruntu piṟantirukkiṉṟaṉa. camaskiruta uccarippiṉpaṭi ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉa. tāṅkaḷ ivikaḷukku nūtaṉamāy vēṟu peyarkaḷ koṭuttu viṭṭāl mikavum naṉṟāyirukkum’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. ṣaṭjama, riṣapa, kāntāra, mattima, pañcama, tivata, niṣātaṅkaḷiliruntē ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa eḻuttukkaḷ vantirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu palarum eṇṇuvatiṉāl avi appaṭiyalla veṉṟu teḷivuṟac colla vēṇṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. 60m pakkattil ivikaḷip paṟṟic ciṟitu colliyiruntālum, ivikaḷiyum cērttup pārppatu cantēka nivarttikku ētuvākumeṉṟu eṇṇukiṟēṉ.
ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum mutal mutal tamiḻ moḻiyilēyē vaḻaṅki vantaṉaveṉṟum caṅkīta cāstiram mut tamiḻil oṉṟāyirunta teṉṟum pala kuṟippukaḷāl aṅkaṅkē colli yirukkiṟōm. avaṟṟuḷ,
		“ca ri ka ma pa ta ni yeṉ ṟēḻeḻuttāṟ ṟāṉam
		variparanta kaṇṇiṉāy vittut - terivariya
		vēḻiciyun tōṉṟu mivaṟṟuḷḷē paṇpiṟakkuñ
		cūḻmutalāñ cuttat tuḷi”
eṉṟu cikaṇṭi māmuṉivar coṉṉa veṇpāvik kavaṉikkum poḻutu iṭiccaṅka kālattilēyē, ca, ri, ka, ma pa ta ni eṉṟu ēḻu curaṅkaḷ collum vaḻakkamiruntatākat terikiṟatu.
iṭiccaṅka kālattilirunta ivarukku muṉṉum mutaṟcaṅka kālattil akattiyarālum avarukku muṉṉirunta kalivallōrālum tamiḻ nāṭṭilēyē iyal ici nāṭakameṉṉum muttamiḻum vaḻaṅki vantaṉaveṉṟu teḷivāy aṟiyakkūṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. akkālattu nūlkaḷ namakkuk kiṭikkavilli. āṉālum mutaṟcaṅkattil vaḻaṅki vanta muṟippaṭiyē iṭiccaṅkakālattum vaḻaṅkiyirukka vēṇṭum. ammuṟi yiyē cikaṇṭi māmuṉivarum iṭiccaṅka kālattilum coṉṉār.
camaskiruta pāṣiyil caṅkīta nūl eḻutiya aintām nūṟṟāṇṭi liruntu paratar, patiṉmūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta caṅkīta ratṉākarar pōṉṟavarkaḷukku vekukālattiṟku muntiyatu immuṟiyeṉṟu aṟivōm. pūrvamāyuḷḷa tamiḻ nāṭṭiṟkup pēccup paḻakttilillāta ēṭṭu moḻiyik koṇṭu vanta āriyar tamiḻ nāṭṭil vaḻaṅkumpala kalikaḷi yum, taṅkaḷ pāṣiyil tiruppuvataṟkāka ariya vēlikaḷ ceytu vantārkaḷ. avarkaḷil caṅkīta ratṉākarar oruvar. avar tamiḻ moḻiyil vaḻaṅkum caṅkītattiṟku nūl eḻutukiyil tamiḻ nūlukkum, camaskiruta nūlukkum vittiyācam tōṉṟumpaṭi pala kāraṇap peyarkaḷiyum, kati kaḷiyum colliyiruntālum avikaḷ muṟṟilum poruntātavikaḷ eṉṟu teḷivāka aṟikiṟōm. utāraṇamāka, tiruveṇkāṭu (cuvētā raṇiyam,) maṟikkāṭu (vētāraṇiyam,) tiruviyāṟu (pañcanata ṣēttiram,) kuṭamūkku (kumpakōṇam,) tiruvāvaṭutuṟi (kōmutti ṣēttiram,) tiruviṭimarutūr (mattiyārccuṉam,) puliyūr (viyākkirapuram) ciṟṟampalam (citamparam,) tāyumāṉavar (mātarpūtīsvarar) mutaliyavi tamiḻ vārttiyiṉ nērāṉa moḻipeyarppeṉṟum aṟivōm. ivikaḷippōlavē itaṉ muṉṉum irākaṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷi māṟṟi vittiruppatākac colliyirukkiṟōm. karuṇāmirta cākaram mutal puttakam mūṉṟām pākam kāṇka.
māṟṟiya ūrp peyarkaḷik kavaṉikkiyil avikaḷ pūrvamāy mikap paricuttamāka eṇṇappaṭṭaṉaveṉṟum kaṭavuḷaruḷ peṟṟa periyōrāl pāṭal peṟṟaviyeṉṟum tamiḻ makkaḷāl koṇṭāṭap paṭṭaviyeṉṟum nām aṟivōm. tiruviyāṟu eṉum col aintu paricuttamāṉa natikaḷ ōṭum iṭam eṉṟu poruḷ paṭukiṟatu. itiyē pañcanata ṣēttirameṉṟu peyar māṟṟi vaḻaṅkiṉālum taṟkāla tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki varukiṟa peyar pūrvat tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta paḻiya peyarēyoḻiya camaskirutatti liruntu vanta peyaralla veṉṟu teḷivāka aṟivōm. appaṭiyē atil eḻuntaruḷi teyvattiṟku aiyāṟappaṉ eṉṟu peyar vaḻaṅkukiṟatē.
icit tamiḻil vaḻaṅki varum ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu kuṟip peḻuttukkaḷiṉ viparam icittamiḻ nūlil virivāyc colli yirukkalām. avikaḷ ippoḻutu kiṭikkātataṉāl nām pala vitamāy niṉikka ētuvākiṟatu. caṅkīta ratṉākarar ṣaṭjamam, riṣapam, kāntāram eṉum curaṅkaḷukku oru vitamākavum, mattimam pañcamam eṉṉum curaṅkaḷukku vēṟu oru muṟiyākavum tivatam niṣātaṅkaḷukku maṟṟoru vitamāka vum kāraṇam kāṭṭip peyar kaṟpittār.
mattiyāy varuvataṉāl atāvatu ātāra caṭjattukkum mēl caṭjat tukkum naṭuviluḷḷa tantiyil caripātiyil varuvatāl mattimam eṉkiṟār.
ēḻu curaṅkaḷil aintāvatāy varuvataṉāl pañcamam eṉṟār. āṉāl ari cura muṟippaṭi ēḻāvatāka varukiṟatu. itupōlavē nālāvatākavum, āṟāvatākavum, mutalāvatākavum, kaṭiciyākavum varuvataṟkum peyar kaṟpittiruntāl naṉṟāyirukkum.
iṉṉum riṣapattiṉ kurali ottiruppataṉāl riṣapam eṉṟār. maṟṟiya eḻuttukkaḷukkum itu pēril kāraṇam kāṭṭi yāṉiyiṉ (kajam) kurali ottiruppatāl niṣātatti ka eṉṟum, kutiriyiṉ (asvam) kurali ottiruppatāl tivatatti a eṉṟum, kuyil (kōkilam) ōciyi ottiruppatāl pañcamatti kō eṉṟum, kiravuñcapaṭciyiṉ ōciyi ottiruppatāl mattimatti ki eṉṟum, mayiliṉ (mayūram) ōciyi ottiruppatāl ṣaṭjamatti ma eṉṟum collalāmē, itupōl iv veḻuttukkaḷi mutalākat toṭaṅkum vārttikaḷ ettaṉiyō irukkiṉṟaṉavē.
mēlum ka ca ṭa ta pa ṟa eṉṟa valleḻuttukkaḷ melleḻuttukka ḷōṭum, iṭi eḻuttukkaḷōṭum, maṟṟa uyirmey eḻuttukkaḷōṭum moḻikku mutalilum - naṭuvilum ōci māṟupaṭṭu vevvēṟu vitamāy uccarikkappaṭuvati aṟiyāmal ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉ mutal curamāṉa sa camaskiruta eḻuttāyirukkiṟataṉāl camaskirutattiliruntē curaṅkaḷ vantirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟum anēkar collik koḷḷukiṟārkaḷ.
ṣaṭjamam eṉpatu āṟu curaṅkaḷi aṭakkikkoṇṭiruppateṉṟum āṟu iṭaṅkaḷiliruntu piṟappatiṉāl ataṟku ṣaṭjamam eṉṟu peyar vantateṉṟum ākiyiṉāl curaṅkaḷ camaskirutattilintu vantaṉaveṉṟum palar collak kēṭṭirukkiṟēṉ. caṟṟuk kūrntu kavaṉittāl appaṭiyalla veṉpatu teḷivākat teriyum.
eppaṭi eṉṟāl ṣaṭjamam eṉpatiluḷḷa ṣaṭu, ṣaṭvarkkam, ṣaṭūrmi, ṣaṭrākam, ṣaṣṭi eṉum vārttikaḷilpōla āṟu eṉṉum poruḷik kuṟikkiṉṟatu. jam eṉpatu piṟakkiṟatu, piṟappikkiṟatu, piṟakkiṟataṟku iṭamā yirukkiṟatu eṉṟu arttamām. ṣaṭjamattiliruntu ri ka ma pa ta ni ca eṉṟa ēḻu curam piṟantāl māttiram oru stāyi pūraṇamākum. mutal ātāra ṣaṭjamam tāyāṉāl atiliruntu
ri ka ma pa ta ni ca eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷum piḷḷikaḷākap piṟakkum. ēḻu piḷḷikaḷiliruntu tāyiyotta ca eṉṟa peṇṇiṉāl maṟṟum ēḻu curaṅkaḷ piṟakkum. tāyippōl oru peṇkuḻanti piṟakkāmal pōṉāl tārastāyiyum, mantara stāyiyumillāmal pōkumē.
mēlum ṣaṭjam āṟu iṭattiliruntu piṟakkiṟateṉṟu collukiṟārkaḷ. pāṣiyiṉ eḻuttukkaḷ palavum āṟu iṭaṅkaḷiṉ utavi yiṉāl uccarikkap paṭukiṉṟaṉavaveṉṟu colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. āṉāl ṣa eṉṟa eḻuttu āṟu iṭattiliruntu uṇṭākiṟatākac collappaṭa villi. aṭittoṇṭi, uṇṇākku, nuṉinākku eṉṟum mūṉṟu mukkiya māṉa iṭaṅkaḷil iraṇṭoru aṅkaṅkaḷ cērntu ōcikaḷ piṟakkumē yoḻiya āṟu iṭaṅkaḷilumiruntum oru eḻuttup piṟappatu kūṭāta kāriyam. 
mēlum ṣaṭjam eṉṟa vārttiyiṉ mutal eḻuttukkum sa ri ka ma eṉṟa curaṅkaḷiṉ mutal eḻuttukkum evvita campantamumilli. ṣa, sa vāka vaḻaṅkukiṟataṟku evvita ātāramumilli. āṉāl ca eṉṟa tamiḻ eḻuttu sa vāka melintu varukiṟataṟkup pala utāraṇam colli yirukkiṟēṉ. (karuṇāmirta cākaram mutal puttakam nāṉkām pākam 59-m pakkam kāṇka.) tamiḻ vaḻakkiṉpaṭi sa eṉṟu varalāmēyoḻiya camaskiruta muṟippaṭi appaṭi varuvataṟku koñcamēṉum niyāyamilli.
ruṣapam eṉṟa vārttiyiliruntu ri eṉṟa meyyeḻuttu varuvataṟku evvita ātāramumilli. kāntāram eṉṟa colliṉ mutal eḻuttu ka eṉṟu varuvataṟku tivatam eṉṟa vārttiyiṉ ti eṉṟa mutal eḻuttu ta eṉṟu āvataṟkum ātāramilli. itaṉāl ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa eḻuttiṟkuk kāraṇam kaṟpikka vantavar colliya kāraṇam cariyāṉatalla veṉṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu.
itōṭu ka, pa, ta eṉṉum curaṅkaḷ camaskiruta eḻuttukkaḷiṉ mūṉṟām ōciyiyuṭiyavikaḷāka vaḻakkattilirukkiṉṟaṉa. itaṉāl camaskirutattiliruntē curaṅkaḷ vantirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu yāvarum eṇṇa iṭamākiṟatu. āṉāl valleḻuttiṉ ōci muṉ piṉ varum melleḻuttāl camaskiruta eḻuttukkaḷiṉ ōcipōl uccarikkappaṭukiṟa teṉṟu itaṉmuṉ karuṇāmirta cākaram mutal puttakam iraṇṭām pākattil pala utāraṇaṅkaḷōṭu colliyirukkiṟōm.
kāntāram, taṉakkup piṉvarum ma eṉṟa melleḻuttālum, pañcamam taṉakku muṉ varum ma eṉṟa melleḻuttālum tivatam taṉakkup piṉvarum na eṉṟa melleḻuttālum ōci māṟuvatiyum itupōl anēka iṭaṅkaḷil ōcimāṟi tamiḻil veku vārttikaḷ pūrvakālan toṭṭu vaḻaṅki varuvatiyum kavaṉittāl iccantēkamum nīṅki viṭum.
3. capta curaṅkaḷippaṟṟi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi nārāyaṇa cāstirikaḷ apippirāyam
curaṅkaḷiṉ ōcikaḷippaṟṟi nāṉ oruvāṟu colliyiruntālum, ivikaḷi ārāya vēṇṭumeṉṟu tiruviyāṟu ḷuyaḷēmacavi College Senior Professor āṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi nārāyaṇa cāstiri avarkaḷukkut terivittu caṅkīta ratṉākarar eḻutiya iraṇṭu pustakattiyum koṭukka avarkaḷ avvāṟē ārāyntu eḻutiyirukkum kaṭitam aṭiyil varumāṟu :-
“makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi rāv cāyap M.āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷ naṉku ārāyntu ippōtu iyaṟṟiya karuṇāmirta cākarameṉum caṅkīta cāstiratti naṉṟāy uṇarntu cāraṅkatēvar ceyta caṅkīta iratṉā karatti ārāyntu pārttatil tōṉṟiṉa viḷakkatti ulakattōrkaḷ aṟiyap piracurap paṭuttukiṟēṉ. atāvatu :-
cāraṅkatēvar vivaritta ca, ri, ka, ma, pa, ta, ni eṉkiṟa ēḻu curak kuṟikaḷ kāraṇap peyaruḷḷavikaḷeṉpatu. iṭukuṟippeyar eṉṟu meyppittu viḷakkukiṟa B.c. ilirunta cikaṇṭimāmuṉivar aruḷic ceyta icinūlukku virōtappaṭukiṉṟatu. aṉṟiyum ṣaṭjā eṉṟa patattiliruntu ca vum ruṣapa eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ri yum, kāntāra eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ka vum mattima eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ma vum, pañcama eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu pa vum, tivata eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ta vum, niṣāta eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ni yum, vantaṉa eṉṟu urikkil kṣa eṉkiṟa camaskiruta aṭcaram sa eṉkiṟa māṟutali aṭivataṟkum, ru eṉkiṟa camaskiruta uyir eḻuttu ri eṉṟu camaskiruta meyyeḻuttāka māṟukiṟataṟkum kā eṉkiṟa tīrkkam ka eṉṟu kuṟukuva taṟkum, tivata eṉpatil ta eṉṟu akāra vaṭivamintu varuvataṟkum yātoru camaskiruta viyākaraṇa piramāṇam kāṇamuṭiyāmiyālum ṣaṭja mutaliya ēḻu pataṅkaḷum kāraṇac coṟkaḷ eṉṟu kāṭṭuvaṟkāka riṣapa, kāntāra, tivata eṉkiṟa mūṉṟu pataṅkaḷiṉ poruḷ ārāycciyil curaṅkaḷi cammantittavikaḷākavē cāraṅkatēvar vivarippatāl ṣaṭja mattima, pañcama, niṣāta eṉkiṟa urikaḷ curaṅkaḷiyē cammantittateṉak kūṟuvatu kiramamillāmiyum apanniyāyattiyum ṣaṇṭa, rutam, kātram, maturam, paṭṭalam, tiriyam mutalāṉa camaskiruta pataṅkaḷil mutal akṣaramāka atippiracaṅkippatālum tirāviṭarkaḷ amitta iṭukuṟip peyari māṟṟuvataṟkeṭutta puraṭṭupāyameṉṟu tīrmāṉikkappaṭukiṟatu.
ca, ka, ta eṉkiṟa ōcikaḷ tamiḻp pāṣikkuriyatallāviṭilum kirantāṭcarattil paḻiya cāmavēta ēṭukaḷil hūm eṉṟu eḻutiyatu him eṉṟu olippatupōl tamiḻilum ciṟcila cantarppaṅkaḷil ca, ka, ta, ja, ta, pa, ṭa, pa olippatu tiṭṭameṉṟu Mr. Rao Sahib paṇṭitar avarkaḷ ௸ karuṇāmirta cākarattil eṭuttu vivarittiruppatu mika viyakkattakkatu. mataṅkar mutaliya varkaḷ urittālum niyāyattiṟku iciyāmiyāl mūṭa paktiyi māttiram muṉṉiṭṭu inta irupatām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ nākarīkattil nili niṟutta muṭiyātu. nāratar mutaliya māmuṉivarkaḷ aruḷicceyta camas kiruta caṅkīta nūlkaḷ piṟkālattiya vitīka camaskiruta paṇṭitarkaḷ caṅkītatti tuvēṣittatāl pulappaṭātu uṇmiyillāmiyi tākkuvatā yiṟṟeṉṟu tiṭṭamāy eṭutturikkat tuṇiyalāṉēṉ.
